izzyondroid:it.kapfer.digitalesamt.liber.description:
Digitales Amt Liberator is an Xposed module that removes root and bootloader checks from Austrian e-government apps. These are
 Digitales Amt by Bundesministerium für Digitalisierung und Wirtschaftsort
 FinanzOnline [+] by Bundesministerium für Finanzen
 The problem 
 When your Android phone is rooted or its bootloader unlocked, the app starts, but it doesn't allow users to connect their ID Austria to it (for "security reasons"), or it already denies starting for the same reason. This makes the e-government app basically useless.
 The solution 
 Digitales Amt Liberator removes any calls in supported Austrian e-government apps to root and bootloader checks and therefore provides a tailored solution to running the app on rooted devices.

fdroid:com.leastauthority.destiny.name: Destiny
fdroid:com.leastauthority.destiny.summary: Send files with end-to-end encryption without revealing your identity
fdroid:com.leastauthority.destiny.description:
Destiny is an end-to-end encrypted file transfer app. It allows people to securely send files without needing to reveal their identity to each other, or the service provider. No sign-up is needed.
The user selects a file on their device and shares the generated code with the intended recipient for safe delivery.
Destiny is based on the Magic Wormhole protocol.
Key security features:
- End-to-end encryption: Files are end-to-end encrypted and only the sender and recipient can read them.
- Identity-less: No need to disclose identity information (such as name, email address, or phone number) to be able to transfer files.
- Peer-to-peer file transfer: Destiny attempts to make a direct network connection to the other party. When this isn’t possible (for example, if neither party has a public IP address), then our relay server is used. However, that server sees only encrypted packets.
- Full-strength keys: Although our codes are short and human-memorable, they are part of an online “Password Authenticated Key Exchange” (PAKE) which only allows a single guess – and yields a 256-bit full-strength symmetric key.

fdroid:com.vadhod.apkextractor.name: Vadhod APK Extractor
fdroid:com.vadhod.apkextractor.summary: Offline, privacy-first APK extractor with proper split-APK support.
fdroid:com.vadhod.apkextractor.description:
Vadhod APK Extractor is a beautiful, privacy-first tool to extract and back up the APK of any app installed on your device — completely offline.
Modern apps ship as "split APKs". Vadhod handles them properly: simple apps export as a clean single .apk, while split apps are bundled into one reinstallable .apks archive automatically. Your backups actually reinstall.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
* 100% offline — the app has NO internet permission at all.
* No tracking, no analytics, no ads, no accounts.
* Nothing ever leaves your device. Files are saved only to the folder you choose.
EXTRACT & BACK UP
* Browse every installed app, split into System and User tabs.
* Search and sort by name, size, install date or last update.
* Extract a single app, or select many and batch-extract at once.
* Save to any folder using Android's Storage Access Framework.
SPLIT-APK AWARE
* Export the base APK, or bundle base + splits into a reinstallable .apks archive.
INSPECT & SHARE
* See version, size, min/target SDK, install dates.
* View the signing certificate (SHA-256) and the APK's contents.
* Share an extracted APK, or export any app's icon as a PNG.
BEAUTIFUL
* A soft, calm pastel design with light and dark themes.
Vadhod APK Extractor is open source and built to respect you: minimal permissions, minimal footprint, zero data collection.
Note: The "Query all apps" (QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES) permission is used solely to list the apps installed on your device so you can extract them. This information stays on your device and is never collected or transmitted.

fdroid:io.github.digvijaylp.OpenTeleScop.name: Open TeleScope VR
fdroid:io.github.digvijaylp.OpenTeleScop.summary: A VR-based digital telescope camera application for people with low vision
fdroid:io.github.digvijaylp.OpenTeleScop.description:
Open Telescope VR is a specialized VR-based accessibility camera application for people with low vision. The app lets one use their smartphone as a digital telescope, by mounting it into a standard VR viewer and connecting an external keyboard, remote or gamepad. This allows people with low-vision to attend lectures, conferences and meetings.
Key Features:-
1. Immersive VR Mode: The camera feed is shown in a stereoscopic side-by-side view. The application defaults to a "Hide Everything" UI state, with no on-screen buttons and menus, to provide a clean, viewfinder for VR headsets.
2. Telephoto Support: Supports switching to the telephoto lens (if present) on most newer Android devices. 
3. Digital Zoom Boost: Increase maximum zoom-levels for each camera-lens.
4. External Hardware Control: Fully mapped to work with wired or wireless keyboards and gamepads, allowing you to control the zoom-levels and color-filters while it is strapped to your head.
5. Experimental: Unlocking Telephoto Access: Supports manually adding camera Lens ID to bypass OEM restrictions hiding these lenses (like telephoto and periscope cameras) from third-party apps.
Open TeleScope VR is based on Open Camera (v1.56.2) code base and is under GPLv3 license.

fdroid:page.ooooo.geoshare.name: GeoShare: Jump Between Maps
fdroid:page.ooooo.geoshare.summary: Open map links in other map apps and copy coordinates
fdroid:page.ooooo.geoshare.description:
Share a map link with GeoShare and the app will open it in another installed map app.
 Supported map links 
- Google Maps
- Apple Maps
- 2GIS
- Amap (AutoNavi)
- Baidu Map (beta)
- Cartes IGN
- CoMaps
- HERE WeGo
- Kagi Maps
- Magic Earth
- MapQuest
- Maps.me
- Mapy.com
- OpenStreetMap
- Organic Maps
- OsmAnd
- Plus Codes (global only)
- Urbi
- Waze
- Yahoo! Maps
- Yandex Maps
- coordinates
GeoShare is not affiliated with or endorsed by any of the services mentioned.
 Example use cases 
When someone sends you a Google Maps link, but you prefer using OpenStreetMap, you can quickly open the same location in OsmAnd or Organic Maps.
When you like Google Maps for finding places, but you prefer a different app for navigation, you can easily switch from Google Maps to your favorite navigation app .
 Other features 
- Shows the geographic coordinates of a map link and allows copying them to clipboard in various formats, for example as a geo: link.
- Shows all points of a place list link.
- Allows performing an action automatically when a map link is processed. (Pro feature)
- Allows launching navigation in all apps that support it, including TomTom.
- Allows opening a location in web maps , pre-installed ones or your own. (Pro feature)
- Allows saving a location as a GPX file .
- Allows sending a location via a messaging app .
- Allows saving a location to a contact .
- Retries on patchy internet connection .
- Allows pasting map links directly into the app, instead of sharing them with it.
- Interface adapts to tablets .
 How it works and privacy considerations 
GeoShare converts map links (e.g. https://maps.app.goo.gl/...) into geo: links that can be opened by other map apps. To create a geo: link, geographic coordinates are required. GeoShare reads them from the map URL.
However, not all map URLs include coordinates. In such cases, GeoShare will prompt you for permission to connect to the map service (Google Maps, Apple Maps, etc.) and read the coordinates from HTTP headers, HTML document, or an API. For more detailed information, check the app’s FAQ screen.

apple-macos:6787310678.name: Tap the World: Country Quiz
apple-macos:6787310678.description:
Tap the World is an educational game that teaches world geography through play. It works like a map quiz: the game names a country, you find it on an interactive globe, and every answer teaches you something new. Then practice flags and capitals with Geo Flashcards. There is no time limit, so you can learn at your own pace.
HOW TO PLAY
• Choose the whole world or a single region, and the game asks you to find a country. Tap it on the globe.
• Switch to Flags to turn the map quiz into a flag quiz: find each country by its flag and learn flags as you play.
• Every correct answer shows the country's name and its capital.
• A wrong tap shows which country you actually picked, so you learn from your mistakes too.
• Each game gives you 3 lives, so you can make a couple of mistakes and keep going.
• Tap any country you have already found to see its name and capital again.
• Even the smallest countries are easy to tap.
GAME MODES
• World: more than 220 countries and territories in one game.
• Regions: Europe, Africa, South America, North & Central America, Central & West Asia, South, East & Southeast Asia, and Australia & Oceania.
• US States: all 50 states plus Washington, D.C.
LEARN FLAGS AND CAPITALS
• Practice in four directions: country to capital, capital to country, flag to country, and country to flag.
• See the question, recall the answer, then flip the card to check yourself.
• Cards you are still learning come back for another look, and the ones you know are set aside.
• Your progress is saved, so you can continue where you left off.
A LEARNING GAME FOR GEOGRAPHY STUDENTS
Tap the World turns geography lessons into a game. Play it to prepare for a geography test, review what you covered in class, or finally remember where every country is and what its capital is called. Start with one region, then play through all the countries of the world as you learn.
LEADERBOARD
Post your best World score on the Game Center leaderboard.
EXPLORER MODE
Unlock Explorer Mode to remove ads and play in Training mode: unlimited attempts and hints that turn the globe to the country you are looking for. Training is pure practice, so the leaderboard stays fair for everyone.
Learn geography in 10 languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian, Japanese and Chinese.

Attach photos to items so whoever shops gets exactly the right product -- right brand, right size, every time.
EVENT PRESETS

flathub:com.cburch.Logisim.name: Logisim
flathub:com.cburch.Logisim.summary: Logisim a graphical tool for desigining and simulating logic circuits
flathub:com.cburch.Logisim.description:
Logisim is an educational tool for designing and simulating digital logic circuits. With its
 simple toolbar interface and simulation of circuits as you build them, it is simple enough to
 facilitate learning the most basic concepts related to logic circuits. With the capacity to
 build larger circuits from smaller subcircuits, and to draw bundles of wires with a single
 mouse drag, Logisim can be used (and is used) to design and simulate entire CPUs for
 educational purposes.
 Logisim is used by students at colleges and universities around the world in many types of
 classes, ranging from a brief unit on logic in general-education computer science surveys, to
 computer organization courses, to full-semester courses on computer architecture.

flathub:com.transmissionbt.Transmission.description:
BitTorrent is a peer-to-peer file-sharing protocol that is commonly used to
 distribute large amounts of data between multiple users.
 Transmission is a BitTorrent client with an easy-to-use interface on top of a
 cross-platform backend.
 Native interfaces are available for macOS, Linux, and Windows, as well as command line binaries and
 a web GUI.
 Notable features of Transmission include support for Local Peer Discovery, encryption,
 DHT, µTP, PEX and Magnet links.

flathub:org.kde.drawy.description:
Drawy lets you create ideas, diagrams, and visual notes on an infinite whiteboard with a smooth
 and responsive canvas. You can draw with pressure-sensitive tablet support, add text, insert images,
 and use basic shapes such as rectangles, ellipses, arrows, and lines to organise your content clearly.
 You can choose your own color palette and export your work as image files whenever needed. Drawy
 is built to stay lightweight and fast, making it easy to capture ideas and work freely without
 distractions.

flathub:org.subtitld.Subtitld.name: Subtitld
flathub:org.subtitld.Subtitld.description:
Subtitld times subtitles on the audio's waveform and shows them over the video as they will
 be seen. It transcribes speech into timed subtitles, translates them, and dubs them with synthetic
 voices, one for each speaker.
 Move and retime subtitles on the waveform, snapping to their neighbours or to a grid of frames
 Work down the subtitles on a vertical timeline beside the list
 Give each speaker a face, a colour and a track of their own
 Check reading speed, duration and line length as you go
 Keep translations beside the original, in the list and on the timeline
 Mix the video's sound and the dubs, with EQ, compressor and gate per track
 Export the dub as WAV, FLAC or MP3, mixed or a track per speaker
 Open and save SRT, WebVTT, TTML, SAMI, SCC and more
 Speech recognition, offline translation and more voices, voice cloning among them, come as add-ons
 installed from inside Subtitld. Many of them run fully offline.

flathub:so.onekey.Wallet.name: OneKey
flathub:so.onekey.Wallet.description:
OneKey is the easiest solution for keeping and trading crypto assets and NFTs, and tracking account dynamics. Instead of managing various assets on various decentralized platforms, you'll have a one-stop solution here that could meet all your needs about crypto asset management.
 OneKey is designed intentionally to keep things simple. That's why sometimes users who leave in search of "more features" end up coming back because other wallets are too complex, and these users are firmly committed to using our wallets ever since.
 Top-notch crypto investors, individual users of giant whales, exchanges, internet companies, institutional investors... Nearly a million users from 166 countries on five continents are using OneKey, and we have users from every walk of life.
 Ditch frustrating and inefficient decentralization and take security and efficiency to the next level with OneKey's one-stop solution.
 You need to install PCSC daemon to use this app.

fedora-packages:lhapdf/lhapdf.name: lhapdf
fedora-packages:lhapdf/lhapdf.description: LHAPDF is a general purpose C++ interpolator, used for evaluating PDFs from discretized data files. Previous versions of LHAPDF were written in Fortran 77/90 and are documented at http://lhapdf.hepforge.org/lhapdf5/. LHAPDF6 vastly reduces the memory overhead of the Fortran LHAPDF (from gigabytes to megabytes!), entirely removes restrictions on numbers of concurrent PDFs, allows access to single PDF members without needing to load whole sets, and separates a new standardized PDF data format from the code library so that new PDF sets may be created and released easier and faster. The C++ LHAPDF6 also permits arbitrary parton contents via the standard PDG ID code scheme, is computationally more efficient (particularly if only one or two flavors are required at each phase space point, as in PDF reweighting), and uses a flexible metadata system which fixes many fundamental metadata and concurrency bugs in LHAPDF5. Compatibility routines are provided as standard for existing C++ and Fortran codes using the LHAPDF5 and PDFLIB legacy interfaces, so you can keep using your existing codes. But the new interface is much more powerful and pleasant to work with, so we think you'll want to switch once you've used it! LHAPDF6 is documented in more detail in http://arxiv.org/abs/1412.7420

firefox-addons:3023367.name: Privacy for WhatsApp Web (Auto Blur WA)
firefox-addons:3023367.summary: Automatically blurs messages, media, names, and more, on WhatsApp Web until you hover. Actively maintained community fork
firefox-addons:3023367.description:
Privacy for WhatsApp Web (Auto Blur WA) protects your screen from shoulder-surfing and prying eyes at work, cafe or coffee shops, or any public places. This extension automatically blurs your WhatsApp, instantly revealing items only when you hover your mouse cursor over them.
 Note: This project is an actively maintained community fork of the original open-source extension, updated to fix recent layout bugs and keep our privacy tools working smoothly. 
It adapts to your needs by letting you decide which elements you want to blur. 
Your options:
- All messages in chat: Blurs all messages in the current chat.
- Last messages preview: Blurs all message previews on the left.
- Media preview: Blurs all images, videos, stickers, etc. in separation from the text.
- Media gallery: Blurs all small icons of images, videos, etc. while viewing an image, video, etc.
- Text input: Makes the color in your input field lighter to make it hard to read.
- Profile pictures: Blurs all profile pictures.
- Group/Users names: Blurs all group and usernames.
- No transition delay: Allows you to turn off the delay before revealing an item on hover.
- Unblur all on app hover: Unblurs all elements when you hover over the WhatsApp Web app.
- Blur WhatsApp on Idle: Blurs WhatsApp when there is no mouse/keyboard activity after a certain time.
- Advanced Settings: Customize the blur amount (in pixels) for various elements independently and set the idle timeout duration.
- Theme Toggle: Switch between Light, Dark, or System Preference theme for the extension.
 Quick Toggle Shortcut 
Quickly toggle all blur effects on or off globally using the button in the extension menu or via a keyboard shortcut (Default: Alt+X). To customize this hotkey, navigate to: "about:addons" -> Settings icon on the top right -> Manage Extension Shortcuts
 No Tracking 
This extension does not collect any information about you, your settings, or your messages. Everything stays locally in your browser.
 MIT Licensed 
Proudly running as an open-source continuation fork under the MIT license.
 Disclaimer: WhatsApp is a trademark of WhatsApp Inc., registered in the U.S. and other countries. This extension is an independent, community-driven open-source project and has no official relationship to WhatsApp or WhatsApp Inc.

Your bookmark data stays in your browser. The extension does not require an account, does not use analytics, does not use advertising SDKs, does not use AI APIs, and does not send bookmark data to any external server.
Key features:
- Browse bookmark folders in a clean dashboard
- Search bookmarks by title, URL, domain, folder, or tag
- Add local tags to bookmarks
- Review duplicate bookmarks before deleting anything
- Check invalid URLs, empty folders, untagged bookmarks, old bookmarks, and large folders
- Move bookmarks and folders with safer controls
- Use custom trash before permanent deletion

All metadata such as tags, folder colors, folder icons, trash records, settings, backups, and activity history is stored locally in the browser.

firefox-addons:2874604.name: Accessible Shortcuts
firefox-addons:2874604.summary: Enables the creation of accessible keyboard shortcuts for focusing on elements within a web page.
firefox-addons:2874604.description: With this extension you will be able to easily create shortcuts to focus elements on a web page. Just use the Tab key to focus on an element on the page and then use the add shortcut shortcut. A sound will be played and you must press the key combination that will be the shortcut to the element in focus. By default, the shortcut to add a new shortcut is “Alt + Control + Shift + A”. After executing this shortcut, make the desired combination for the focused element, such as “Alt + j”. A confirmation box will be displayed, press the “Ok” button to confirm or activate the “Cancel” button so that the shortcut is not created. Settings page: The default shortcut to access the settings page is “Alt + Control + Shift + C”. When you run it, the extension page will open and you can check the created shortcuts as well as the default shortcuts. Managing shortcuts: Shortcuts created: On the settings page, find the “Created Shortcuts” heading. If you have created any shortcuts, there will be a table containing all those that have been added. In the “Action” column, you can activate the “Delete” button to delete the corresponding shortcut. Default shortcuts: In the same way, you will be able to find the title “Default shortcuts” and the corresponding table with the shortcuts to add a new shortcut and the shortcut to open the settings page. You can activate the “Edit” button in the “Action” column to configure a new key combination for the corresponding shortcut. For example, when you activate the “Edit” button for the add new shortcut shortcut “Alt + Control + Shift + A”, a sound will be played and you must press the new key combination to become that shortcut. So, if you press the “Alt + a” keys, this will be the new shortcut to create shortcuts. A confirmation box will be displayed before the new key combination is registered. Other information: Subscribe to the channel Continue Desenvolvendo on Youtube and access the website Juliano Lopes - Atalhos Acessíveis (Accessible Shortcuts) to stay informed about any updates.

firefox-addons:3019023.name: UnitNormalize - Shopping Tool
firefox-addons:3019023.summary: Finally, something that fights shrinkflation. Instantly calculates and displays real price-per-unit badges on Amazon search results, so you always know the real deal.
firefox-addons:3019023.description:
Supermarkets and brands have quietly been shrinking product sizes while keeping prices the same — or raising them. UnitNormalize fights back.
The moment you search on Amazon, UnitNormalize scans every product on the page, extracts the weight, volume, or count from the product title, does the math instantly, and injects a price-per-unit badge directly under the price. No clicking. No copying numbers into a calculator. Just the truth, right there on the page.
How it works
UnitNormalize reads the product title locally in your browser — things like "32 oz", "6-pack (12 fl oz each)", "500g", or "96 count" — calculates the real unit price, and displays it in a small green badge beneath the listed price. The product with the lowest price-per-unit on the page gets a special "Best" highlight so the winner is always obvious at a glance.
Features
• Instant price-per-unit badges on Amazon search results
• Handles weight (oz, g, kg, lb), volume (fl oz, ml, L, gal), and count (tablets, pods, wipes, rolls, etc.)
• Understands multi-packs — "12 × 500ml", "4-pack 16 oz each", "6-count" all parsed correctly
• Best Value highlight — the lowest unit price on the page is automatically flagged
• Switch between Imperial (per oz / per fl oz) and Metric (per 100g / per 100ml) in one click
• Works on infinite scroll and paginated results via live page monitoring
• Fully isolated badges — never broken by Amazon's own CSS
Privacy
UnitNormalize does all calculations instantly inside your browser. It reads nothing except the product titles and prices already visible on the page. No data is collected, stored remotely, transmitted, or shared. Ever. This is declared explicitly in the extension manifest.
Permissions
UnitNormalize only requests access to Amazon search result pages and local browser storage for your unit preference (imperial or metric). No other permissions are needed or requested.

firefox-addons:419210.name: All Tabs Helper
firefox-addons:419210.summary: Provides list-style menu to do closing, loading, unloading, moving of single/multiple tabs. Search tab titles/urls, search content in all loaded tabs, visited tabs history, find duplicate tabs. (Window-centric except moves tabs across windows)
firefox-addons:419210.description:
(Note: ATH versions >= 1.1.1 will not work on Firefox versions < 58.)
 Summary 
This addon provides a list-style UI for tab management. Designed mainly for high-volume tab users.
The ATH UI can be accessed 3 ways: From the toolbar button popup, in the sidebar, or in the management window (aka "full view" window). Each UI provides 4 different views, also referred to as "menus":
 all - All tabs are displayed in tabs bar order, or can be filtered by title and url by typing in the search box.
 recent - Lists tabs in order from most recently accessed first.
 dups - Duplicate tabs are displayed. (See caveat*)
 search - Tabs can be searched by tabs content of loaded tabs.
The screenshots and captioned instructions give a good introduction to using ATH.
Note that ATH is window-centric, ie, menu only applies to the window it is in. The only cross-window support is the ability to move multiple tabs across windows. Demonstration for this is also shown in the screenshots.
(EDIT: ATH now has multi-window functionality, however it is experimental and currrently considered "unsupported". Must be enabled in Options.)
* caveats :
Dup tabs - Note that dup tabs list is generated by searching for tabs with identical URLs. It is possible for two tabs to have the same URL but different content, eg the case where the page is generated based on form or cookie data. Use with awareness when removing tabs.
 Reasons for permissions :
 Access your data for all websites - Listing and searching tabs - used for the highlighting within the page that is used in the "Search all tabs" feature when the user clicks on a search result in the ATH UI.
 Read and modify browser settings - ATH option "Open new tab next to current" changes FF pref
 Read the text of all open tabs - Searching tabs content ("search" menu)
 Access recently closed tabs - Used to store data that is window oriented, such as window title names
 Access browser tabs - Listing and searching tabs
(Note: To be clear, ATH does not modify any part of any page for spoofing, nor scavenge any user input, in order learn any user information, including but not limited to passwords etc.)
Note for Legacy Firefox users: I am making a few concessions to allow ATH to run on Firefox 56 (the last legacy version.) I'd like to make it clear that I am officially not supporting Firefox 56. Some features will not work, or be inapplicable, due to the lack of APIs in Firefox 56. I have only made attempts to allow what will work to work, without breakage, however I am not taking the time to make a customized UI. Thus you may find options, features or context menu items listed that won't apply to you. You may also find bugs which won't be fixed.
In this same paradigm, I cannot guarantee that all future updates of ATH will continue to work on Firefox 56 (or variants.) To be safe you may want to turn off automatic updates and only do updates where you can monitor which is the last version that will work for you.

bluejetty:00030912:ios.name: Mariana Bass Synthesizer
bluejetty:00030912:ios.summary: Mariana is a new software bass synthesizer from Moog Music capable of reaching the deepest depths of low-end tone and weight. Moog has long been a pioneer in electronic bass, from the iconic Minimoog Model D to the Taurus Bass Pedals, Sub P
bluejetty:00030912:ios.description:
Mariana is a new software bass synthesizer from Moog Music capable of reaching the deepest depths of low-end tone and weight. Moog has long been a pioneer in electronic bass, from the iconic Minimoog Model D to the Taurus Bass Pedals, Sub Phatty, and Minitaur. Mariana continues this tradition in the form of a groundbreaking software synthesizer for iOS, MacOS, and Windows. Optimized for vibrant bass sounds that sit perfectly in the mix, Mariana is a powerful tool for artists and musicians across all genres and workflows.
Mariana is a dual-layer synthesizer, allowing you to mix together two completely different synthesizer sounds and process each layer individually. Each layer is built around two oscillators with precise and inventive controls to dial in your bass tone to make it punch through a mix and stand out from the rest, with a sub-oscillator adding even more low-end weight. Two resonant Moog filters and a third filter specifically for the sub-oscillator let you shape your sound, adding warmth while rolling off high frequencies or pushing up the resonance for added bite. With stereo crossover functionality, Mariana is optimized for quickly dialing in stereo content while simultaneously preserving a strong mono bass foundation.
Warm saturation and a tight compressor add extra punch to your bass lines while an illuminating real-time metering section lets you monitor your sounds and dial them in to a professional standard. Flexible built-in delay and chorus effects operate on separate layers and can expand the stereo image of your sounds or preserve a solid mono signal. Whether designing your own bass tones from scratch or using one of the 200 included presets as a starting point, Mariana is an accessible and versatile tool for any modern production environment.
Mariana is fully equipped with three LFOs, three envelopes, and two random generators per layer and a creative and extremely deep modulation editor. Nearly every parameter of Mariana can be modulated internally, via MIDI, or via virtual CV from the Moogerfooger Effects Plug-ins, and Mariana's modulation sources can be sent to and received from the Moogerfoogers for a self-contained modular Moog ecosystem right in your DAW. With an optimized user interface and seamless integration into any DAW (digital audio workstation), Mariana is the most accessible way to add the unmistakable Moog bass sound to your productions.
Features:
• Modern Moog Bass: Mariana pulls from the lineage of classic Moog bass instruments to deliver a new bass synthesizer with cutting-edge features for sculpting powerful bass lines.
• Dual Layers: Two separate synthesizer layers allow for complementary sound stacks or independent duophonic playing that can be mixed together.
• Deep Modulation: A vast array of modulation sources, destinations, controllers, and functions with a deep mod matrix editor allow for complex modulation of nearly every parameter of Mariana.
• Intuitive Interface: A beautiful, resizable, and user-friendly interface gives you effortless control over your bass sounds.
• Metering and Compression: Built-in effects, compression, and metering let you add punch to your bass sounds and dial them in to a professional standard.
• Interconnectivity: Mariana can interact with the Moogerfooger Effects Plug-ins via virtual CV, creating a modular Moog ecosystem right in your DAW.
• Flexibility: Mariana can be used as a standalone app or a plug-in inside your favorite DAW, supporting powerful AUv3 compatibility.
• Preset Library: A vast library of presets covering a wide range of musical styles and genres provides a starting point for users to dive right into musical creation - or transform stock presets into something completely unique.
Supports:
• AUv3 Audio Unit Extensions
• MPE Controller Support
• 7 and 14-Bit MIDI
• MIDI Program Change Support
• Share over Mail or other iOS applications

bluejetty:00144299:ios.description:
Meet Malaa: your all-in-one financial app that helps you track, save, and grow your money!
Effortlessly integrate your bank accounts, view your spending patterns, and boost your savings through investments. Regulated under Saudi Central Bank's guidelines and Saudi Capital Market Authority, our priority is helping you understand your financial data, not capitalizing on it.
+ Monitor all your bank accounts:
Our integration brings together all your bank accounts in one place, so you can see your spending and earnings at a glance. No more logging in to multiple accounts or manually entering transactions. We automate the expense tracking to help you stay on top of your finances. Malaa integration with your bank is compliant with the Saudi Central Bank's guidelines for open banking, so you can rest assured that your financial data is encrypted.
+ Know where you spend your money:
Our new categorization engine will automatically categorize your transactions so you can see exactly where your money is going. No more guessing! you can create budgets for different categories of spending, like groceries, transportation, and entertainment. Then, our engine will automatically allocate each transaction to its corresponding budget, so you can easily control your spending.
+ Take a deeper look at your finances: 
Get key insights about your finances so you can make smart decisions. Customize your analytics report to track what's most important to you, and quickly view balances, categories across all of your accounts. See past transactions to understand your spending and make sure you're on track to reach your financial goals.
+ Grow your savings with investments:
with just a few questions, our algorithm will create a personalized investment portfolio that meets your risk tolerance and financial goals. You can deposit money easily with Mada, Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, or bank transfer. And our team of investment experts will manage your portfolio for you, so you can relax and focus on other things. Our investments have been reviewed by the Shariyah Review Bureau making it Shariah compliant, we also automatically calculate and pay your zakat for you, so you don't have to worry about it.
Malaa offers the lowest annual management fee in Saudi Arabia at 0.35%. You can start investing today with as low as 1000 SAR for your initial deposit, and 50 SAR for subsequent deposits.

Built with the best of e-commerce practices, the app offers a modern interface, personalized dashboard, simplified fund discovery, and guided decision-making – everything you need to plan, track, and grow your wealth.
Quick, Easy & Secure Access
No more remembering multiple passwords. Log in effortlessly using:
● Fingerprint / Face ID (device dependent)
● 4-digit M-PIN
● One-time OTP login
All-in-One Dashboard & Portfolio View
Get a consolidated, insightful view of your investments:
● Track overall portfolio, returns, SIP vs Lumpsum, and asset allocation
● Smart prompts for SIP renewals, pending transactions & key updates
● Link and manage family members’ portfolios for goal-based investing
Smart Fund Discovery & Faster Decisions
Find the right fund in just a few clicks:
● Search by category, asset class, investment objectives, or risk profile
● Explore Top Trending Funds and personalized recommendations
● DIY tools like Compare, Fund Performance Tracker, SIP & Lumpsum Finder, and Future Value Calculator
● Add to Watchlist and invest when you’re ready
● Goal Planner to estimate how much to invest and track progress toward your goals
Smarter Transactions Made Simple
Start your investment journey instantly with Digital KYC and transact seamlessly:
● Invest via Lumpsum, SIP, Redemption, and Switch
● Cart Buying: Purchase multiple funds in one go
● Schedule future transactions with ease
● Pause SIP temporarily or repeat previous transactions
● Resume pending or unfinished transactions anytime
● Make payments securely via UPI, Net Banking, NEFT, RTGS, or Bank Mandates
Comprehensive Service Suite
Manage your investments with powerful self-serve features:
● Download account statements or capital gain statements instantly
● Access full transaction history with success/rejection filters
● Track NAV and dividend history in real time
● Update nominee, bank, or contact details directly in-app
● Enable/disable biometric login and change M-PIN/Password anytime
● Dedicated Helpdesk with live chat, service request tracking, or instant call back
Why Choose Nippon India Mutual Fund App?
● Simple, secure, and seamless investing
● Personalized dashboard for smarter insights
● Easy fund discovery with filters & trending funds
● Fast transactions and multiple payment options
● Complete control of your mutual fund investments in one app

bluejetty:00097968:ios.description:
Lenna is a media player software designed specifically for movie and TV enthusiasts. It is especially suitable for users who store their media content on a home NAS or cloud drive. Lenna supports managing multiple Emby/Jellyfin servers simultaneously, as well as direct video playback from WebDAV, SMB, 115 Drive, and Aliyun Drive sources. It offers powerful browsing, playback, and synchronization features, allowing you to easily enjoy high-quality home entertainment.
Media Library Features:
 - Seamless connection to Emby, Jellyfin, WebDAV, SMB, 115 Drive, and Aliyun Drive servers.
 - Browse poster walls to quickly view all your media content.
 - Efficient search to easily find the movie or TV show you're looking for.
 - Categorized management to keep your media library organized.
 - Modify media library passwords to protect your personal content.
Playback Features:
 - Background playback for uninterrupted streaming while multitasking.

bluejetty:00025239:ios.description:
For countless years the villagers of Vamp’Ire have enjoyed a life of peace and happiness. But now, rumors are spreading about a wielder of dark magic - a Witchmaster. Fearing the rumors to be true, the village musters a militia to prepare for the worst. You are a recruit enrolling to defend the village. Little do you know, fate has something special in store for you…
Vampire’s Fall: Origins is a 2D open-world RPG with turn-based combat. Create your character, choose your bloodline and venture out in the world. Will you wreck havoc in the land, or be the hero people are longing for? Will you use your powers to battle other players or to hunt ferocious monsters?
• Open world
• Fully customizable characters
• Turn-based combat
• Immersive stories
• Dialogue choices
• PvP battles
• In-game chat
• Skills and abilities to shape your character
• Choose your bloodline: Nosferatu, Ranjeni, Magistrav or Equides
• Over 150 graphically unique weapons and armor
About us
Vampire's Fall: Origins has been in development for three years. We set out to create a serious RPG for mobile phones without the usual mobile game mechanics. There's no energy system. There's no 50-click tutorial. There's little hand holding. There are, in our opinion, interesting battle mechanics, funny dialogues and a sense of wonder in the world. From our three indie-dev hearts, good luck and have fun!

bluejetty:00161849:ios.description:
Enhance Your Medical Vocabulary and Boost Your Exam Success!
Welcome to Medical Findings, the ultimate game-based learning companion designed specifically for healthcare students and professionals. Whether you're studying Nursing, Medicine, Medical Assistance, Pharmacy, Medical Coding, Paramedicine, or other healthcare courses, our app provides an engaging and effective way to master essential medical terminology.
Why Choose Medical Findings?
► Tailored for Healthcare Students & Professionals: Specifically crafted content to meet the educational needs of nursing students, medical students, medical assistants, pharmacists, coders, paramedics, and more.
► Comprehensive Topic Coverage: Gain in-depth knowledge with topics organized by:
- Word Parts (Prefixes, Suffixes, Word Roots)
- Medical Abbreviations
- Anatomy
- Pharmacology
- Diseases
- Procedures
► High-Yield Notes Offline: Access concise, high-yield notes for each medical term even without an internet connection. Perfect for on-the-go study sessions and quick reviews before exams.
► Precise Pronunciation Guides Offline: Learn correct, manually curated pronunciations for each term, available offline to ensure confident communication.
► Quick Search Functionality: Instantly find specific terms with our powerful search tool, making your study sessions faster and more productive.
► Three Engaging Modes:
- Play Mode: Enjoy interactive scrambled word games that reinforce memory and retention.
- Study Mode: Master terms with easy-to-use flashcards for focused learning.
- Exam Mode: Put your skills to the test with exam-style multiple-choice questions to evaluate understanding and boost confidence.
► Expertly Curated Content: All content is meticulously researched and reviewed by medical education experts to ensure accuracy, reliability, and exam relevance.
► Interactive & Supportive Features:
- Flexible letter gameplay with revert and shuffle buttons.
- Hint feature to assist with challenging terms.
- 'Ask a Friend' option to collaborate and share via Facebook Messenger or SMS.
► User-Friendly & Customizable: Easily adjust sound, music, and vibration settings for a personalized learning experience.
Upgrade to PREMIUM ACCESS and Maximize Your Learning:
Enjoy exclusive benefits including:
- Unlock All Topics: Full access to TERMINOLOGY, ANATOMY, PHARMACOLOGY, DISEASES, and PROCEDURES.
- Unlock All Modes: Study & Game Mode
- Ad-Free Learning: Study uninterrupted without distractions.
- Bonus Coins: Receive 10,000 coins instantly to enhance gameplay.
- Double Rewards: Earn double coins for every correct answer.
- Unlock All pronunciations.
- High-yield notes on around 5,000 terms now available offline for Premium users!
- Continuous Updates: Stay current with new terms and updated content.
Medical Findings is more than an app—it's your personal gateway to mastering medical terminology efficiently and effectively.
Download now and elevate your medical knowledge today!

bluejetty:00043136:ios.description:

- Deposit, receive, transfer and spend money using your mobile number. 
- Conveniently use "Group send money" option that allows you to send money to multiple recipients at once, such as family members, colleagues or loved ones. 
- Make scheduled payment & automatically settle your payments on a regular basis.
- Make payments at shops/convenient stores via QR codes, 
- Easily conduct cashless transactions and receive international remittance 
- Just click and purchase Ethio telecom Airtime and Packages
- Tap and Pay for goods and services, your school fees, tickets and different purchases anywhere anytime 
- Enjoy secured transactions and a seamless digital payment experience

bluejetty:00179982:ios.name: Story Planner for Writers
bluejetty:00179982:ios.summary: Story Planner is an easy-to-use yet powerful tool that helps you plot novels, screenplays, RPG campaigns, essays, and any kind of writing project. Whether you’re outlining a new idea or organizing a complex fantasy novel, Story Planner make
bluejetty:00179982:ios.description:
Story Planner is an easy-to-use yet powerful tool that helps you plot novels, screenplays, RPG campaigns, essays, and any kind of writing project. Whether you’re outlining a new idea or organizing a complex fantasy novel, Story Planner makes the writing process clear, flexible, and fun.
Writers, screenwriters, producers, directors, and game masters—every kind of storyteller will find a powerful ally in Story Planner. Whether you’re a professional writer or just starting your first draft, Story Planner helps you focus on what really matters: your stories. Create projects your way, keep your notes and research at hand, and stay in control with quick and intuitive organization. Sync across all your devices and export to your favorite formats—so you can keep writing wherever you are.
OUTLINE AND ORGANIZE YOUR WRITING
• Create custom projects for novels, screenplays, essays, research, and more.
• Add your own sections to any project: characters, plots, scenes, objects, worldbuilding, notes—whatever your story needs.
• Customize each card: choose which fields appear, reorder them, and add new ones for the details you care about.
• Attach images everywhere: characters, locations, scenes, notes… even in your custom tabs!
• Organize projects with tags and archive what you don’t need right now.
• Take notes on your ideas within each project.
• Easily switch between the different parts of your project.
BRING YOUR STORIES TO LIFE
• Link the main elements of your story to your story structure.
• Develop characters with depth, tracking traits, fears, favorite foods, or magical items.
• Create detailed locations and attach reference images.
• Organize your plot lines and assign them a color.
• Divide your structure into acts, parts, chapters, or episodes.
• Develop the structure scene by scene.
• Write your scenes in any order and reorganize later with Drag & Drop.
• Assign tags to any element in the story for better organization.
STAY IN CONTROL
• See the big picture with Revision Mode.
• Track different threads with colors and tags.
• Set goals and follow your writing progress.
• Understand your story better with detailed stats.
• Use widgets and shortcuts on iOS and Mac to boost your productivity.
• Work distraction-free with Light or Dark Mode.
• Personalize the app with your favorite color theme.
• Sync your projects via iCloud across iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
EXPORT YOUR WORK
• Export to Word, Scrivener, Final Draft, Ulysses, and more.
• Print or create PDF files for sharing.
• Choose what to export and customize the style of your files.
PRIVACY FIRST
• Story Planner respects your privacy—we don’t collect or see your data.
• All your work stays on your device, synced only through your iCloud account.
• Protect your projects with Face ID / Touch ID and automatic backups.
ONE PURCHASE, A LIFETIME OF WRITING
• Buy once, enjoy forever—no subscriptions, no in-app purchases.
• One purchase for iPhone & iPad, a separate purchase for Mac.
THANK YOU!
We’ve spent thousands of hours building Story Planner, and we keep improving it thanks to your feedback. If you enjoy the app, please take a moment to leave us a review—it really helps. And if you have ideas for new features, we’d love to hear from you.

bluejetty:00119365:ios.summary: Zoho Forms is a free app used to create forms, collect and analyze data, and generate insights. Our form builder is packed with powerful features that simplify data collection—even when you're offline—making it the perfect forms app for bus
bluejetty:00119365:ios.description:
Zoho Forms is a free app used to create forms, collect and analyze data, and generate insights. Our form builder is packed with powerful features that simplify data collection—even when you're offline—making it the perfect forms app for businesses of all sizes.  
Experience the convenience of generating and distributing paperless forms among your team members in an instant—all without coding. Build forms that are optimized for seamless usage on iPhone and iPad devices, enabling you to automate your business workflows anytime.
Key features that set Zoho Forms apart:
• Offline mode: Seamlessly switch to offline mode when facing low internet data or network issues. Zoho Forms works efficiently as an offline data collection app, allowing you to create and collect data offline, then automatically sync with your data in the cloud when you're back online.
• Kiosk mode: Transform your device into a data-collection kiosk, facilitating the seamless collection of form responses at events.
• Barcode and QR code scanning: Automatically populate form fields by scanning codes with your device's camera, enhancing data accuracy and efficiency.
• Business card scanning: Quickly collect leads' contact details by scanning their business cards to streamline lead generation.
• Signatures: Collect digital signatures to streamline workflows and process online documents.
• Capture locations: Capture a device's location coordinates to auto-fill address details on forms, enhancing accuracy and convenience.
• Folders: Organize all your forms efficiently with folders, simplifying form management for everyone in your organization.
• Record layout: Choose from a variety of available layouts to optimize your data for review.
What makes Zoho Forms the best choice for your data collection needs?
Form builder:
With 30+ field types at your disposal, it's easy to create the right type of form with our no-code platform. Collect data in the way that best suits your needs by using field-specific properties.
Media fields:
Embrace versatile data collection with media fields enabling users to upload images, audio files, videos, and more.
Sharing options:
Share your form with your team, publish it on a website, circulate it on social media, and distribute it via email campaigns.
Notifications:
Stay informed about new submissions and updates to records with email, SMS, push, and WhatsApp notifications.
Conditional logic and formulas:
Implement conditional logic to trigger smart operations and set up formulas to perform calculations based on respondents' input.
Approvals and tasks:
Collaborate with your team, delegate entries as tasks, and configure multi-level approval workflows for form submissions.
Tools to view and export data:
Filter entries, export them as CSV or PDF files, and send them to your business apps for further processing.
Zoho Forms is free to use forever, with subscription plans available for organizations with more complex needs.
Visit our pricing page for detailed information: https://www.zoho.com/forms/pricing.html
We are committed to making your data-collection process easy and efficient. If you have any questions or concerns, reach out to us at support@zohoforms.com.
Privacy Policy: 
https://www.zoho.com/privacy.html
Terms of Service:
https://www.zoho.com/forms/terms.html

Make Your Message Stand Out

A quiet vibration lets you know when the message has finished scrolling

What Users Say

*****Happy

ScrollIt Features

• Unlimited message length
• Built-in emoticons and full emoji support
• Live preview to adjust color and scrolling speed
• Vibration or sound alert when scrolling ends

• Recently used messages with one-tap reuse

bluejetty:00022545:ios.name: Dream Journal Ultimate
bluejetty:00022545:ios.summary: Dream Journal Ultimate is the largest dream database in the world. Enter as many dreams as you would like for free, no limits. Secure your dreams and use Face ID or Touch ID to quickly unlock your journal. We use the power of artificial int
bluejetty:00022545:ios.description:
Dream Journal Ultimate is the largest dream database in the world. Enter as many dreams as you would like for free, no limits. Secure your dreams and use Face ID or Touch ID to quickly unlock your journal. We use the power of artificial intelligence to provide dream analysis and interpretation.
For any dream you enter, you can keep it private or share it to the Dream Wall, a dream based social network where you can share your dreams with other users to get feedback. Share as many or as little as you want.
The worlds largest dream database gives an unparalleled connection between dreams around the world. Have an interesting dream last night? Dream Journal Ultimate will automatically analyze your dream for common themes and show you similar dreams from around the world.
With Dream Journal Ultimate you can:
• Sync Dreams: Keep your dreams close at hand and in sync with all your devices. Never lose a dream again with Dream Journal Ultimate!
• Dream Vault: Your dreams are private and protected with multiple security options. Secure your journal with a pin, Face ID, or Touch ID.
• Dream AI Interpretation: Uncover hidden meanings in your dreams with AI-powered analysis and interpretation. Explore the depths of your subconscious and discover more about yourself!
• Dream AI Visualization: Bring your dreams to life with stunning, AI-generated images that visualize your deepest desires and fears.
• Dream Symbol Dictionary: Look up the meaning of any dream symbol with our comprehensive dictionary. Discover the psychological significance behind the images in your dreams.
• Lucid Dreaming Academy: Learn proven lucid dreaming techniques with step-by-step lessons including Reality Testing, MILD, WBTB, SSILD, and FILD. Track your progress as you master each technique.
• Reality Check Alarms: Set customizable reminders throughout the day to check if you're dreaming. Build the habit that leads to lucid dreams with a built-in progress tracker.
• Dream Tags: Categorize your dreams with tags for easy reference and analysis. Keep track of recurring themes and symbols!
• Dream Insights: Discover patterns and insights with an easy-to-understand graph that shows the most common themes across all your dreams.
• Dream Wall: Share your dreams with the world on the Dream Wall, where you can read others' public dreams and connect with a community of dreamers.
• Dream Community: Engage with other dreamers by commenting and liking their dreams on the Dream Wall. Join the conversation and explore different perspectives!
• Dream Connections: Discover new insights into your own dreams by viewing dreams that are similar to yours. Expand your understanding of yourself and the world around you.
• Dream Reminders: Never forget to write in your dream journal with customizable reminders. Keep your dream practice consistent and reap the rewards of deep self-knowledge!
Dream Journal Ultimate is the perfect app to help you get into lucid dreaming. Keeping a dream journal helps increase dream recall, self-awareness, and the chances of having a lucid dream by allowing the individual to reflect on their dream experiences and track their progress.
Dream Journal Ultimate is free to download and use. You can support the further development of Dream Journal Ultimate with a monthly auto-renewing subscription. This will help us build more features and pay for server usage.
Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will not be able to cancel a subscription during the active period. You can manage your subscriptions in your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Use: http://dreamjournal.co/terms_of_service.html
Privacy Policy: http://dreamjournal.co/privacy_policy.html
If you like the app, please support it by rating and writing a review.

Kontro is the ideal solution
bluejetty:00162054:ios.description:
Kontro – Inventory, Sales & Profit Control
Kontro is the all-in-one app to manage your business and boost sales with an online product catalog.
Inventory management and virtual catalog in the palm of your hand.
Kontro is the ideal solution for retailers, independent sellers, and small businesses looking for a simple and efficient way to manage inventory, sales, customers, and profit.
Online product catalog to grow your sales
Create your online catalog with product photos, prices, and descriptions, and share it easily with your customers. In just a few taps, your store is ready to sell online.
Smart and easy inventory management
Add products, track stock levels in real time, record stock entries and exits, monitor movements, and always know what’s available. Built for real stores and real business needs.
Customer credit (pay-later) management
Manage pay-later sales with ease. Register customers, track outstanding balances, receive partial or full payments, and view a complete transaction history.
Free sales and inventory tools with professional features
Record every sale with important details such as payment method, shipping, discounts, and more. Access reports and track your business growth with a clear focus on profit.
Profit and margin always visible
Kontro automatically calculates profit per product and per period. Use markup tools to adjust prices strategically and increase profitability.
Receipts, billing, and product label printing
Generate receipts automatically after each sale. Send them via WhatsApp or print directly from the app.
Print product labels and price tags to organize your inventory and speed up daily operations.
Built for business owners who need speed and control
- Online product catalog with images and descriptions
- Real-time inventory control
- Customer credit (pay-later) management
- Barcode scanner
- Customer and supplier management
- Sales, profit, and cost reports
- Receipt and product label printing
- Receipt sharing via WhatsApp
- WhatsApp support
- Integrated Web version
Catalog, inventory, sales, and profit — all in one app.
No complicated systems. Kontro is simple, fast, and built for businesses that need quick results.
Payment is charged to your Apple account with automatic renewal. You can cancel the renewal at any time in your Apple account settings.
All basic app features are free. Subscription prices may vary by country.
Privacy Policy:
https://kontro.com.br/politica-de-privacidade
Terms of Use:
https://kontro.com.br/termos-de-uso
Take Kontro(l) of your business today!

bluejetty:00017694:ios.summary: The CBI Bank & Trust App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can st
bluejetty:00017694:ios.description:
The CBI Bank & Trust App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact CBI Bank & Trust customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the CBI Bank & Trust App, you must be enrolled as an CBI Bank & Trust Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00184158:ios.description:
Do your banking anywhere and at any time with the Great Southern Bank Mobile Banking app. Check your balances, schedule payments, pay bills on the go, and use PayID to send and receive money using a mobile phone number or email address instead of remembering a BSB and account number.
Security features:
• Change your password after you log in
• Reset your debit card PIN
• Fingerprint login and Face ID on supported devices 
• Lock your debit card temporarily if you misplace it
Other features
• The Vault allows you to hide your savings account to help you reach your savings goals faster
• Activate your debit card
• Search pending payments and transactions
• Add and delete scheduled payments
• Delete payees and billers
• Add your debit cards to your Apple Wallet and use before the physical card arrives
• Make fast payments using the New Payments Platform (NPP). Transfer funds in under a minute between participating Osko financial institutions [1]
• View interest rates for home and personal loans
• View your loan redraw amount
• Contact us via phone or email
More features at www.greatsouthernbank.com.au/digital-banking/mobile-banking
Note: For the best possible experience, we recommend using the app on your iPhone.
Getting started
Download the app and click the ‘Register’ button on the login page.
Alternatively, you can register online at www.greatsouthernbank.com.au/ob-register, call us on 133 282 or drop into your local branch.
If you’re already registered for digital banking, simply download the Great Southern Bank Mobile Banking app and you’re ready to go. The first time you log in you’ll need your existing Great Southern Bank customer number and password. After that, you can save your details securely.
Important Security Information
Great Southern Bank Mobile Banking provides the same high level of protection as our online banking service. To stay secure, we recommend that you:
• Keep your password and customer number secret
• Always log out once you’ve finished your banking
Remember, we will never send you emails, SMS messages, or call you to ask for personal information such as your customer number or password. If you receive any suspicious communications, do not respond or click on any hyperlink or attachment included in the message, as it could be an attempt to obtain your personal information or fraudulently access your account. If you’re in doubt, please call us immediately on 133 282.
Important Information
Your use of the app, and any specific products or services that you may access using the app, is subject to our Terms & Conditions. Before downloading this app, please read both the Terms & Conditions and the security tips – available at www.greatsouthernbank.com.au/security-tips
Any reference to digital banking in the Terms & Conditions also applies to the use of this mobile banking service. By clicking download and installing, you agree to the Terms & Conditions.
The Great Southern Bank Mobile Banking app is provided by Great Southern Bank, a business name of Credit Union Australia Ltd ABN 44 087 650 959, AFSL and Australian Credit Licence 238317. This is general information and does not take into account your objectives, financial situation or needs. Consider whether this service is appropriate for you before deciding to download the Great Southern Bank app.
Apple, Apple Wallet and iPhone are trademarks of Apple Inc., registered in the U.S. and other countries.
[1] Refer to New Payments Platform and Osko NPP Terms at www.greatsouthernbank.com.au/npp-terms.
There’s no fee for accessing your Great Southern Bank accounts using our mobile banking app. Mobile network provider charges may apply. Access is subject to availability and maintenance, refer to our website for more information.
BETA operating system software is not supported by Great Southern Bank, please refer to our Terms and Conditions.

bluejetty:00132249:ios.description:
Stay safe and ahead of the storm with the WRAL Weather app. Get the most accurate, local weather forecasts for Raleigh, Durham and across central and eastern North Carolina straight from the WRAL Severe Weather Center. The app features real-time radar, custom alerts and daily forecasts from trusted local meteorologists. 
Key Features: 
Live local forecasts 
· Get accurate hourly and 7-day forecasts for your current location and favorite saved locations. 
· Access in-depth weather updates, handwritten with insights from six local meteorologists, not generated by computer models. 
· Watch WRAL News+ for live updates. 
· View daily video forecasts available on demand. 
Real-time weather alerts 
· Get push notifications based on your location for dangerous weather conditions, including storms, hurricanes, floods and more. 
· Add locations to Warnings based on your location. 
Interactive radar map 
· Track rain and severe weather with high-resolution radar. 
· Change views to see conditional layers including lighting strikes, wind speed, air quality index and more. 
· Use DualDoppler5000, the only dual-pol radar covering Wake County, for unmatched storm tracking speed and accuracy.
· See future weather patterns with Futurecast. 
Other special features 
· View live cams across the region. 
· Share weather photos and reports directly with WRAL. 
· Use the Hurricane Center to track tropical storms and hurricanes. 
· Access closings & delays from schools and local businesses. 
Download the WRAL Weather app now for the most trusted local weather in North Carolina. Whether you’re checking today’s forecast or tracking an approaching storm, stay informed wherever you are.

bluejetty:00039958:ios.description:

Spirit Fast is your #1 Christian fasting app designed to help you humble your soul and live in total submission to the will of God for your life. The spiritual fasting app seamlessly combines Bible journaling, Christian Bible meditation, daily fasting devotionals, fasting buddies, Christian prayer journal and everything the Bible teaches about fasting — all to help you align your heart & mind with God’s Word and the plans He has for your life. Spirit Fast Christian Fasting Tracker is definitely what you want to improve your relationship with Jesus!
Spirit Fast app contains various fasting plans that are suitable for beginner and experienced, men and women. With the ability to add your fasting buddies, you’ll find the motivation and support you’re looking for. 
Spirit Fast was developed from the first principles of true Biblical Fasting— what the Bible teaches about fasting. It also based on the research made by influential Christian leaders including John Piper, Derek Prince, Jentezen Franklin and Pastor Vlad Savchuk. 
As a Christian, when was the last time you fasted? Jesus expects His followers to fast, and even promises it will happen. He doesn’t say “if,” but “when you fast” (Matt 6:16). And He doesn’t say His followers might fast, but “they will” (Matt 9:15). Spirit Fast Christian fasting app will help you make fasting not just a one-time act but a lifestyle.
Fasting removes the barriers to communication with God and allows the spirit man to commune directly with the heavenly Father – without disturbance. When a person makes a determination to fast, they are making a determination to remove the obstacles in their life to total submission to the will of God. 
What are the benefits?
 • Strengthen your prayer (Ezra 8:21-23) 
 • Seek repentance and return to God (1 Samuel 7:6) 
 • Beseech God for revival, and spiritual awakening (Joel 2:12) 
 • Overcome sin and temptation (Matthew 4:1-11) 
 • Hear God more clearly and/or discover His will (Acts 14:23) 
 • Humble and quiet your soul (Psalm 35:13) 
 • Prepare for ministry (Acts 13:1-3) 
 • Express your deep sorrow (2 Samuel 1:11-12) 
 • Worship God (Luke 2:37)
 • Beseech God for healing, restoration & deliverance: Jeremiah 8:22, James 6:14-16, Psalm 3:7-8 
 • Crucify your fresh and place yourself in submission to the Spirit of God. 
 • Divide your bread with the poor. (Isaiah 58:6-7).
Why Spirit Fast?
 • For both beginners and experienced fasters
 • Water Tracker – Logs your water intake and sends reminders
 • A step-by-step biblical guide to do fasting
 • A smart fasting tracker & timer
 • Custom plans – Create a personalized fasting plan that aligns with your goals
 • Schedule your fasting plan

 • Christian Journal with prompts –Reflect on how you feel and record what God is telling you
 • Fasting statistics - Chart your progress and map your fasting journey
 • Sets your daily fasting reminders

 • Tasks –Add and track your fasting day schedule
 • One tap to start/end your fasts
 • A Christian fasting app free of ads
 • Adjust fasting period
 • Testimonies – Read and share uplifting fasting testimonies
 • Continuous app development and feature updates

If you're looking to earn national dental assisting certification, the Dental Assisting National Board (DANB) is the national certification board for dental assistants. - General Chairside Assisting (GC)
- Infection Control (ICE)
- Radiation Health and Safety (RHS)

bluejetty:00015880:ios.description:
The WordWeb English dictionary and thesaurus: fast searching, spelling suggestions, definitions, usage examples, synonyms, related words - and no adverts. An offline audio version is available separately.
The comprehensive WordWeb dictionary database includes:
 - 285,000 words, phrases and derived forms
 - 225,000 word sense definitions
 - 70,000 usage examples
 - 85,000 text pronunciations
 - Synonyms, similar and related words
 - N. American, British, Australian and international English
A version with 70,000 professionally recorded audio pronunciations is available as a separate product.

Additional features include the ability to drill down on any word in a definition, full bookmark support and history.
Search features include:

 - Spelling suggestions
 - Sounds-like and often-confused
 - Fast pattern-matching search (*, ?, vowel and consonant)
 - Filter search results by noun, verb, adjective, adverbs
 - Customize search options (case, derived forms, etc)
No Internet connection is required to use WordWeb, and it's free. 
Chambers dictionary and thesaurus are also available, and you can cross-reference to both Chambers and old Oxford dictionary apps from WordWeb.

bluejetty:00135455:ios.description:
Feeltracker: 4.8 stars with 23K+ ratings • 800K+ downloads • 250K+ users/year • 5M+ saves/year • 96% satisfaction
Simply point your camera at your blood pressure monitor and let AI instantly capture and analyze your readings. Blood Pressure Journal combines cutting-edge scanning with AI chat, hands-free voice conversations, and on-device intelligence to make cardiovascular tracking effortless—and help you understand what your numbers really mean. Whether you're managing hypertension or maintaining heart health, get clarity you can trust.
COMPREHENSIVE HEART HEALTH TRACKING:
• Log systolic, diastolic, and pulse readings with ease
• Scan blood pressure monitors with your camera for instant, accurate entry
• AI scanning works with Omron and other BP monitor brands
• Track multiple daily readings for accurate averages
• Add notes about activities, stress, or symptoms
YOUR PRIVACY, PROTECTED:
• No account required—start tracking immediately
• Apple Intelligence (iOS 26+): run AI fully on-device, 100% offline and private
• Automatic iCloud sync keeps readings secure across devices
• Export reports in PDF, CSV, Excel, or JSON formats
DESIGNED FOR DAILY MONITORING:
• Beautiful Liquid Glass design with eye-friendly Dark Mode
• Color-coded readings show normal, elevated, or high ranges
• Quick-entry widgets for logging from home screen
• Smart reminders, 24-hour clock option, localized in-app FAQ
• Full integration with Apple Health
UNDERSTAND YOUR HEART HEALTH:
• Detailed trends reveal blood pressure patterns
• Interactive charts—tap any point to view detailed readings instantly
• Weekly, monthly, and six-month averages for doctor visits
• Generate professional reports for healthcare providers
AI-POWERED FEATURES:
• Voice Chat: hands-free two-way conversations with the AI
• Ask a Question: instant answers about your blood pressure data
• Chat: interactive cardiovascular health conversations
• Voice Summary: audio summaries of your trends
• Pattern Detective: discover correlations affecting your readings
• Goal Assistant: personalized blood pressure goals
• Doctor Summary: professional summaries for doctor visits
• Pro Health Report & Deep Research Report for deep analysis
• Sick Note: documentation based on your records
• Song Recommendations: music matched to your health data
• Personalized Quiz, Make Me Laugh, Calm Me Down for Sleep
• Personalized greeting shares the meaning of your name
• Optional profile context (age, gender, sleep schedule, weather) for sharper insights
FREE WITH PRO OPTIONS:
• All core tracking features completely free
• Pro unlocks the full Health Report, Doctor Summary, deep AI analysis, and Apple Intelligence mode
• Affordable pricing for lifelong heart health management
IMPORTANT HEALTH DISCLAIMER:
This app is for personal tracking and informational purposes only. AI insights and recommendations do not constitute medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider before making health decisions. In a medical emergency, contact emergency services immediately.

bluejetty:00100254:ios.description:
Soothe your hearing and comfort your heart with the remembrance of Allah.
We present to you the "Audio Library of the Holy Quran" app, your comprehensive oasis for listening to the Book of Allah recited by elite and renowned Qaris from across the Islamic world. Make the Quran the spring of your heart and the light of your path. Download the app now and embark on an endless spiritual journey accompanied by the Book of Allah.

bluejetty:00099354:ios.summary:
Yoomla – Your Smart Recipe Keeper & Manager
Discover, save, and organize all your favorite recipes in one place! Whether you're exploring new dishes or managing your go-to meals, Yoomla makes it easy to keep your culinary inspiration at you
bluejetty:00099354:ios.description:
Yoomla – Your Smart Recipe Keeper & Manager
Discover, save, and organize all your favorite recipes in one place! Whether you're exploring new dishes or managing your go-to meals, Yoomla makes it easy to keep your culinary inspiration at your fingertips.
SEARCH FOR RECIPES
Smart Filters – Find recipes instantly by name or narrow your search with filters like cooking time, ingredients, allergies, diet, and more.
Meal Ideas – Explore curated categories like Main Dishes, Desserts, Salads, Breakfast, Soups, and more for endless inspiration.
Recommended Dishes – Get personalized recipe suggestions based on your preferences and saved recipes.
IMPORT RECIPES FROM ANYWHERE
From Websites – Download recipes directly from your favorite cooking blogs and websites with just a few taps.
From Photos – Upload a photo of a recipe from a magazine, cookbook, or even handwritten notes – Yoomla extracts all the details automatically.
From Social Media – Discover recipes on Instagram, Facebook, or TikTok and effortlessly transfer them to the app in an easy-to-read format.
COOKING ASSISTANCE
- Step-by-Step Mode – Follow detailed instructions with a complete ingredients list for quick reference.
- AI Chef – Ask questions about any recipe or get immediate help while cooking. Need a substitution? Not sure about a technique? Just ask!
- Grocery List – Automatically generate a shopping list with all ingredients needed for your chosen dishes.
FOR HOME COOKS
"I saw a recipe on Instagram – now what?"
Save it instantly! Import recipes from social media in seconds. No more screenshots or forgotten bookmarks.
FOR BUSY FAMILIES
"What can I cook with what's in my fridge?"
Use ingredient-based search to discover recipes with ingredients you have. Create grocery lists and plan meals for the week.
FOR HEALTH-CONSCIOUS EATERS
"Is this recipe keto-friendly?"
Check nutrition info, filter by dietary preferences, and adjust portion sizes to match your goals.
FAQ
Q: Where can I import recipes from?
A: Anywhere – websites, social media, photos, or manual entry.
Q: Does photo import work with handwritten recipes?
A: Yes! Snap a picture – our text recognition extracts everything automatically.
Q: Can I add recipes manually?
A: Yes, absolutely!
Q: Can I scan a recipe with my camera?
A: Yes! Any printed or handwritten text can be scanned and imported.
Q: How does Yoomla help with cooking?
A: Step-by-step mode + AI Chef for instant help with substitutions or techniques.
Q: Can I create my own folders?
A: Yes! Organize recipes into custom Cookbooks by cuisine, meal type, or any system you prefer.
Q: What's in the free version?
A: Save up to 5 recipes with all basic features – import from websites, photos, and social media.
WHY YOOMLA?
All-in-one solution – Import, save, organize, and cook – all in one beautifully designed app.
Import from anywhere – Websites, photos, social media, or manual entry. No more scattered bookmarks or forgotten screenshots.
Smart organization – Find any recipe in seconds with powerful filters and search. Your personal cookbook, always at your fingertips.
Cooking help – Step-by-step instructions with hands-free mode and AI help when you need it. Like having a sous chef in your pocket.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The cost of renewal depends on your subscription plan. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal can be turned off in your Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.
Terms of Use: https://reciport.com/terms-conditions 
Privacy Policy: https://reciport.com/privacy-policy
Support: support@reciport.com

bluejetty:00082171:ios.developer: YAMY STUDIO YAZILIM VE OYUN GELISTIRME ANONIM SIRKETI
bluejetty:00082171:ios.summary: Help an Innocent Prisoner Break Free! Step into the shoes of a determined prisoner in Prison Breakout, where survival is about more than just staying inside the prison walls. This unique escape game challenges you to dig your way out while
bluejetty:00082171:ios.description:
Help an Innocent Prisoner Break Free! Step into the shoes of a determined prisoner in Prison Breakout, where survival is about more than just staying inside the prison walls. This unique escape game challenges you to dig your way out while balancing the harsh realities of prison life during the day. Every decision counts as you guide the innocent prisoner through this journey of freedom. Your skills, patience, and strategy will be the key to breaking free.
Experience the thrill of planning an epic escape while living the daily routines of prison life. With each day that passes, you're one step closer to completing your daring dig and reaching freedom. But beware—each night brings the risk of getting caught, and freedom won’t come easy!
Immersive Escape Adventure • Live the double life of a prisoner – dig tunnels at night and work in the prison during the day. • Help an innocent prisoner fight for freedom through four challenging blocks. • Master unique mechanics in the game designed to simulate the tension and stakes of a real escape.
Engaging Prison Tasks by Day To survive in the prison and maintain your cover, you’ll have to complete daily chores: • Distribute food in the cafeteria. • Wash clothes in the prison laundry. • Clean the yard to blend in with the daily routines.
Risky Escape by Night The real challenge begins when night falls. Dig your way through the prison blocks, but be extremely cautious! Getting caught could mean starting all over. • Plan your dig carefully. • Avoid the guards and obstacles. • Keep your escape efforts hidden from the watchful eyes of the prison.
Why You’ll Love Prison Breakout
* Experience the tension of a high-stakes prison escape.
* Strategic gameplay that requires both skill and patience.
* Navigate the prison’s various tasks by day and dig your way to freedom by night.
* Each block presents new challenges and mechanics to master.
* The most satisfying reward is seeing the innocent prisoner finally escape!
Features • Idle gameplay – progress even when you’re not actively playing. • Rich visuals and immersive environments that bring the prison setting to life. • Easy-to-learn controls with challenging levels that will test your strategy and focus. • Dynamic progression – as you dig, every decision and task can make a difference in your success. • Realistic prison jobs to give you an authentic experience while keeping the prison guards at bay.
In Prison Breakout, the journey to freedom is filled with tension, strategy, and heart-pounding moments. Every task completed and every inch dug brings the innocent prisoner closer to breaking out. Will you have what it takes to see the escape through?
Help him dig through the tough conditions, avoid the guards, and finally reach freedom. There’s no better time to play Prison Breakout!
