bluejetty:00142693:ios.description:
With myCAMS, stay connected to your Mutual Fund investments anywhere, anytime
myCAMS brings a host of features - get a one view of your MF portfolio, open new folios, purchase, redeem, switch, set up SIP and more. The app facilitates faster, easier and smarter ways to transact in Mutual Funds.
myCAMS is your single gateway to multiple Mutual Funds which includes Aditya Birla Sunlife MF, Bandhan MF, DSP MF, HDFC MF, HSBC MF, ICICI Prudential MF, 360 One MF, Kotak MF, Mahindra MF, PPFAS, SBI MF, Shriram MF, Tata MF, Union MF, WhiteOak Capital MF,Franklin Templeton MF,Navi MF,Helios MF ,Zerodha fund house , Angel One Mutual Fund ,Jio BlackRock Mutual Fund ,Taurus Mutual Fund ,Choice Mutual Fund , Unifi Mutual Fund ,AlphaGrep Mutual Fund and ASK Mutual Fund.
Awards and Accolades
- Won Best Financial App Award at GMASA for three consecutive years since 2015
- Best use of Digital Platform for Mutual Funds at Drivers of Digital Awards 2017
- Winner of Best Application of Technology at CX Strategy Summit and Awards 2018
myCAMS is secure and does not store any information on your device or SIM card. Download and stay connected to your Mutual Fund investments…. always.
KEY FEATURES
Access your investments across multiple Mutual Funds through a Single Gateway; No more managing multiple PINs, Folios numbers, login ids
• Biometric/MPIN login – Simplified your myCAMS login process now. Just pick your preferred login methods – Biometric, MPIN or Password right away
• Two factor authentications for enhanced security
• PAN Level Portfolio View – Track and manage your family wrap portfolio conveniently
• First time investor into CAMS serviced Funds - open a new folio and update FATCA with ease, without forms, cheques
• NFO schemes - Purchase NFO schemes directly from the myCAMS app
• Submit additional purchase, redemption, and switch instructions effortlessly
• SIP – is intuitively designed to bring speed and ease to commencing new SIPs. It innovatively uses the power of prefilled forms in combination with electronic payment options. Also use net banking, existing common mandate and register new eMandate to start a new SIP
• Lump sum purchase with Mandate – By-pass net banking and do lump sum purchase choosing common mandate
• Redemption Guide - Select investments with the most economical exit implications
• Manage your Systematic transactions - Keeping track of multiple SIP/STP/SWP is a breeze, now
• myFavourites – Save your favourite transactions, view the preferred ones on the main menu and alter the transaction amount as desired using myFavourites.
• myWishlist – Monitoring your investments got even easier. Just add the schemes you want to track to ‘myWishlist’ and view their performance on the go.
• Scheduled Transaction option will allow investors to set up future Mutual Fund transactions
• Consolidated Realized Gain Statement - Now includes LTCG on equity-oriented schemes
• Grandfathered statement - Single view of equity schemes investments with 31st Jan’18 NAV and valuation
• Get a one view of your ELSS investments with a customized statement

bluejetty:00080162:ios.summary:

Step into the enchanting world of Florescence: Merge Garden, a u
bluejetty:00080162:ios.description:
This game is truly unique combination of a merge game with some roleplay elements: you can level up your plants, buy new pots or dress up your gardeners to gain more reward! 
Step into the enchanting world of Florescence: Merge Garden, a unique flower merge game where gardening meets mystery and art. As the heir to a quaint Floral studio, your journey involves reviving a legacy through the magic of flower merging. This is more than a garden; it’s a story waiting to bloom, filled with rare flowers and hidden secrets.
Floral Challenges Await:
- Master the art of flower merging to craft stunning bouquets and uncover the secrets of a forgotten garden.
- Engage in intricate puzzles and watch your garden transform with each successful merge.
- Enjoy unlimited gameplay in a world where merging is limitless and every flower tells a story.
Gardening with a Twist:
- Nurture and flourish your skills, merging a variety of plants and rare flowers.
- Explore the art of flower merging and turn plant growth into a thriving business.
- Design and decorate your inherited Flower store, showcasing your unique style.
A Story Rooted in Mystery:
- Unravel a tale of family secrets starting with your grandma’s sudden departure.
- Delve into a mysterious saga beyond being a dedicated plant nanny.
- Discover the real reason behind the legacy handed over to you, one merge at a time.
Game Features and Fun:
- Perfect your merge skills and become the renowned Lord of the Bloom in your town.
- Collect and merge plants to finance the transformation of a chaotic shop into a floral paradise.
- Unlock new rooms, customize your shop, and create never-before-seen flowers through artificial selection.
Join the Merge Frenzy:
- Merge flowers to unlock secrets and evolve your boutique into a blooming marvel.
- Challenge your mind beyond the mansion’s garden and complete quests for exciting rewards.
- Experience the joy of being a chef of bouquets, merging ingredients for perfect arrangements.
A Journey of Growth and Discovery:
- Indulge in the relaxing yet challenging blend of Merge and Match-3 puzzles.
- Help your devoted greenhouse helper and upgrade your shop to new heights.
- Lead a successful flower merge journey, from a novice gardener to a maestro.
Ready to Bloom?:
Join us in Florescence: Merge Garden, where every flower merge is a step into a world of color, mystery, and creativity. Free to play with optional in-app purchases, this game offers a journey through a saga where you are the protagonist, merging flowers and unraveling stories. Grab your gardening gloves and let your flower merge adventure begin!

bluejetty:00187558:ios.summary: Zoho Inventory is a powerful, online inventory management app designed to simplify order management, stock tracking, and warehouse operations for businesses of all sizes. Whether you manage retail, wholesale, or ecommerce, Zoho Inventory he
bluejetty:00187558:ios.description:
Zoho Inventory is a powerful, online inventory management app designed to simplify order management, stock tracking, and warehouse operations for businesses of all sizes. Whether you manage retail, wholesale, or ecommerce, Zoho Inventory helps you stay in control of your inventory and sales anytime, anywhere—on your iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch.
Here's how Zoho Inventory makes inventory operations simple and effective.
Dashboard - Monitor your complete inventory cycle, from sales orders to current stock, through a real-time dashboard.
Inventory management - Add and manage items, group them into categories, and track your kits and assembly items right from the app.
Barcode scanning - Simplify your order processing using the built-in barcode scanning option. Use your iPhone or iPad to scan barcodes and streamline your orders.
Order management - Generate and manage sales and purchase orders with just a few taps. Add contacts and select items effortlessly.
Picklists and packages - Pick items from your warehouses using your mobile phone. You can scan SKUs and serial and batch numbers during the picking process. Generate package slips on the go, too.
Real-time shipping - Generate labels from shipping carriers, track orders, and send real-time shipment updates to your customers.
Inventory tracking - Stay on top of your inventory using serial numbers and batch tracking to track item movement and expiration dates.
Warehouses - Add multiple warehouse or store locations, and track stock by location. Transfer stock between warehouses based on stock requirements.
Bin locations - Organize and manage stock within warehouses using bin locations. Sort your items into bins and manage them effortlessly. Conduct periodic stock counts for more accuracy.
Multi-channel sales - Selling online? Orders from your ecommerce platforms automatically sync into the app, and your inventory updates across all your sales channels.
Online payments - Keep tabs on invoices, record bill payments, and share invoice links via iMessage for quicker settlements.
Reports - From sales to stock movement, get reports that help you make smarter business decisions.
Got a question or a suggestion? We’d love to hear from you! Just drop us an email at support@zohoinventory.com.
Zoho’s Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions:
- https://www.zoho.com/privacy.html
- https://www.zoho.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00076596:ios.description:
Target the Fish. Master the Waters.
FishAngler is your AI-powered fishing guide — the fishing app that gets smarter with every catch you log. Personalized game plans. Verified spots. Real-time weather forecast. Built for anglers who want to master the waters.
Meet FINN™ — your personal fishing guide. Every catch you log feeds FINN™ with data about your spots, species, and local conditions. FINN™ analyzes that history alongside real-time fishing weather to generate personalized game plans for every trip. Not generic advice. Your data. Your patterns. Your edge.
FREE WITH EVERY ACCOUNT
FIND YOUR FISHING SPOTS
Explore fishing activity at lakes, rivers, streams, inshore and offshore waters across the US and worldwide. Community-driven fishing spots near you. Discover access points, boat ramps, kayak access, fishing piers, marinas, FADs, oil platforms, buoys, depth gauges, and underwater structure (shipwrecks, fish attractors and artificial reefs) — all on one fishing map.
KNOW BEFORE YOU GO
Local fishing reports, freshwater and saltwater fishing maps, plus 7-day weather forecasts with tide charts and moon phases. Stop making trip decisions blind.
LOG EVERY CATCH
Track every fish in your fishing logbook with 45+ attributes — species, bait used, weather, GPS location, and more. Every entry deepens your fishing insights. The more you log, the smarter you fish. Automatic angler catch stats sharpen your FINN™ guide.
AI FISH ID — 866+ SPECIES
Snap a photo. Instantly identify any fish — freshwater to saltwater — powered by advanced AI species recognition.
KNOW YOUR BOUNDARIES
Property lines and land access data so you always know where you can fish — and where you can't.
YOUR ANGLER COMMUNITY
Join angler groups for bass, redfish, trout, carp, salmon, and catfish fishing, follow local waters, share catches, and get fishing tips from anglers who fish your exact spots.
IGFA WORLD & STATE FISHING RECORDS
Built-in IGFA world fishing records and USA state fishing records.
GO VIP — FISH ON ANOTHER LEVEL
FINN™ CREDITS
Get 500 AI credits that refill monthly.
FISHFORECAST™ SOLUNAR BITE WINDOWS
Know exactly when fish will feed, down to the hour. Enhanced bite predictions powered by advanced AI and solunar science, tide fishing forecasts, and moon phases.
BAIT & LURE INTELLIGENCE
Species-specific top baits and lures based on season, conditions, and real catch reports from anglers fishing your local waters.
VERIFIED CATCH LOCATIONS
Exact GPS coordinates of recent confirmed catches — logged by real anglers. Know where to drop in, not just where to look.
PREMIUM 3D LAKE & OCEAN CONTOUR MAPS
3D lake maps, depth charts, ocean floor mapping, and Garmin Navionics bathymetric nautical fishing charts. Explore structure and depth like a pro.
14-DAY FORECAST + ANIMATED WEATHER LAYERS
Extended marine weather with animated weather radar, wind, currents, and tidal overlays — see conditions in motion, not just numbers.
PRIVATE WAYPOINTS & PERSONALIZED MAP MODES
Keep your secret spots private. Save custom map setups for instant one-tap access on the water.
MEMBER PERKS & AD-FREE
Exclusive discounts with brands, outfitters, and fishing experiences. Plus an ad-free experience.
RATED #1 FISHING APP
By millions of anglers worldwide.
Bad trips happen when you go in blind.
Great trips happen when you have a guide.
Download free.
Questions? Email us: support@fishangler.com

bluejetty:00142794:ios.description:
recoupling - Your Key to a Happier Relationship
recoupling is your daily companion for a more fulfilling love life. It makes relationship care easy and fun. Our approach uses engaging questions, scientifically backed exercises, and motivating challenges to strengthen your partnership sustainably. Our AI provides personalized content and helpful tips to prevent relationship problems before they occur. With over 50,000 downloads and daily user growth, we're helping countless couples achieve their dream relationship.
- Developed by couples therapists and psychologists
- Noticeable improvements within 2 weeks
- Featured on VOX, BZ, Stern, Focus, Gründerszene, and Jolie
MORE QUALITY TIME, LESS ARGUMENT
Improve your communication, question and change your relationship patterns, discover new conversation topics, and strengthen your connection with your partner using recoupling. Our users report fewer arguments, deeper conversations, and improved relationship quality in a short period.
FOR EVERY COUPLE, IN EVERY PHASE
recoupling has suitable content for every relationship phase, whether you're newly in love or have been together for years. Developed by couple therapists, recoupling promotes relationship care not only when problems arise, but ideally continuously. It makes this process easy and, above all, fun! 
WHAT DO OUR USERS SAY?
"I didn't expect it, but my boyfriend and I improved our communication within a few weeks using the app. I highly recommend it!" - Sophie
"Through the app, we've discovered new aspects of ourselves and our needs. I recommend it without reservation! 5 stars from me/us!" - Finn
"We love recoupling! We've been using the app for 4 weeks and our conversations have deepened. As a young family, couple time is limited, but the exercises are quick and effective. We always look forward to the new exercises each week. We just love recoupling." - Moritz
IS RECOUPLING FREE?
You can download recoupling for free and start with daily questions and mood tracking. You can share the results with your partner, but you can only see the results if you have also shared the question/exercise.
The recoupling premium version gives you additional access to:
- Over a thousand profound questions
- More than a hundred exercises
- Exclusive premium features
Do you have any questions or suggestions? Feel free to contact us at any time at info@recoupling.de. We look forward to hearing from you.

No more being sent to a website. Every article opens instantly inside the app with a clean, distraction-free reading experience.

PODCASTS & VIDEOS
Listen to the latest audio podcast or watch recent YouTube videos without ever leaving the app.
MERCH STORE
Shop End Time Headlines merchandise directly from the app.
PUSH NOTIFICATIONS
Get notified the moment breaking news drops. Tap any notification to open the article directly in the app.
End Time Headlines has been covering Bible prophecy and end times news since 2010. Download the app and stay informed.

bluejetty:00090916:ios.description:
[ANNOUNCEMENT]
Capture studio quality 360° images and videos with just one click. You no longer need the professional skills to take high quality photos for your eCommerce store.
We have taken in consideration the bugs for the previous version and have updated the Foldio360 app version. Most of the issues you submitted are resolved and we will continue to work on it to enhance your Foldio360 experience.
Foldio360 app controls the Foldio360 turntable and Foldio360 Smart Dome to create 360° visuals. Create high quality 360 images/videos/ GIFs and share them on your website.
[FEATURES]
- Automatic shooting system controlled by Bluetooth connection
- Control real time brightness and color temperature
- Foldio360 device control
- 360 degree shot/image supporting function
- Simple and intuitive (easy to navigate) editing tools
- Upload/share your image on Spinzam.com* (360 image platform by ORANGEMONKIE)
- Background filter : Edit background to pure white (in-app purchase)
- Radar: Automatically relocate the object to the center (in-app purchase)
- High resolution support / 1080 / 2160 / 3024 px (in-app purchase)
[HOW TO USE]
1. Connect your compatible Foldio360 product with the Foldio360 app by bluetooth. 
2. Set up your product for the photoshoot. 
3. Capture automatic 360° visuals by simply clicking the red capture button. 
4. Edit your 360° visuals on the app. 
5. Share your image on your eCommerce page with our plugins, or export as photo, video, GIF, or All files expert. 
[FOLDIO360 : THE SMART TURNTABLE & THE SMART DOME]
Compatible Foldio360 products can be used with smartphones or DSLR through bluetooth/IR connection. Once you click the start button, Foldio360 automatically rotates and creates 360 degree images of the object.
*Create awesome 360 images of your favorite object and share them on Spinzam.com! Spinzam.com is a 360 image platform made by ORANGEMONKIE. Upload your 360 image and Spinzam.com will generate shareable link that can be embedded on your social media, image libraries, e-commerce platform or anywhere you prefer.
Please visit http://www.orangemonkie.com for more information 
[System Requirements]
1. Smartphone bluetooth version: Bluetooth 4.0 (BLE) or higher (LE version required) 
2. Minimum requirement: iPhone 6S or higher (works best with iPhone X or higher)
3. OS Version: Minimum requirement is iOS 10.0 or higher (works best with iOS 12.0 or higher)
4. DSLR - IR remote mode available

bluejetty:00029379:ios.summary: Introducing a smart, intuitive and easy-to-use app that helps you stay on top of your health and wellness goals by tracking your daily calories, water intake and activity levels. Our app is designed to make it simple for you to maintain a h
bluejetty:00029379:ios.description:
Introducing a smart, intuitive and easy-to-use app that helps you stay on top of your health and wellness goals by tracking your daily calories, water intake and activity levels. Our app is designed to make it simple for you to maintain a healthy lifestyle by keeping track of your diet, exercise, and hydration levels.
With this app, you can easily log your daily meals, snacks, and drinks to get an accurate picture of your calorie intake. You'll see detailed breakdowns of your macronutrient intake (proteins, carbs, and fats), and get instant feedback on how well you're sticking to your goals. It's a food diary that fits right into your pocket!
Additionally, our activity tracker can intelligently interpret your movement and workout data, so you can see what your physical activity actually translates into in terms of calories burned. You can log anything from your yoga sessions to your daily steps and check how it affected your health goals. With our app, you get tailored insights and easy-to-understand reports.
Last but not least, our water tracker is designed to help you stay hydrated throughout the day. You can set your daily water intake goals and track how much water you've consumed by logging your water consumption. The app will also remind you to drink water if you're not getting enough H2O throughout the day.
Our app is perfect for anyone who's looking to keep track of their health and wellness goals with ease. With its intuitive interface and personalised tracking, you'll have everything you need to stay on track with your diet, exercise, and hydration goals. Download it today and start living your best life!
There is also Apple Health app integration available so you can sync all your data.
You can buy PRO via in–app purchases within the app. Nutrilog PRO is cheaper than similar apps for diet and weight loss.
There are four different PRO subscriptions:
- 1 week (weekly subscription)
– 3 months (quarterly subscription)
– 6 months (semi-annual subscription)
– 1 year (annual subscription)
Also you can buy Pro for a lifetime
By buying Nutrilog PRO, you'll gain access to all premium features. PRO will be charged directly to your iTunes account. You can manage or cancel your PRO subscription in your iTunes Account settings at any time. The subscription will be auto–renewed shortly before the subscription period ends, maintaining the same price and subscription type you previously purchased, unless you unsubscribe no later than 24 hours before the subscription ends. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription. You can also pay for your subscription with App Store Gift Cards. At the time of purchase or renewal, a valid payment method must be deposited. By subscribing to PRO, you are agreeing to the terms of the Apple App Store and Nutrilog's Terms of Service & Privacy Policy.
Privacy policy: https://nutrilog.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/nutrilog/privacy.html
Terms of use: https://nutrilog.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/nutrilog/terms.html

bluejetty:00132304:ios.description:
Cross-Platform Brilliance
—Every detail of beauty deserves close appreciation.
Experience seamless gameplay across platforms with stunning 4K graphics, from hair and fabric rendering to realistic weather system. Invite your besties to interact in your personalized haven!
Next-Gen Character Customization
—127 new facial customization options to level up your beauty.
Sculpt the perfect look from forehead to chin, eyebrows to lips. Fine tune details in a larger and freer range. Your dream face is just a touch away!
Infinite Palette, Your Digital Wardrobe
—Unlock "infinity" for your digital wardrobe and RBG palette.
From dresses to lace trims, color and style fashions from 3-star tier to 6-star tier. Unlock breathtaking color-shifting effects with X Palette and X Starlight!
Design Your Own Fashion
—Become the chief designer of your own brand studio.
Select fabrics, adjust patterns, and create exclusive prints. Bring your designs from sketch to runway-ready reality.
Enhanced Photo-Shooting Experience
Capture your style with our upgraded photo system. Enjoy freed camera movement, advanced editing tools, and showcase your beauty with any form of composition. 
Home Build 2.0: Advanced and Freed
—Advanced Build mode and building blocks.
Build your dream space with our grid-free placement system. Stack furniture, adjust heights, and rotate items at will. Plus, use our new building blocks with 144 color options for fantastic structures!
Lifelike Pet Companions
Immerse in ultra-realistic pet interactions. Feel the softness of a kitten's fur or gaze into a puppy's soulful eyes. Capture the cuteness firsthand and with no filter! Our highly free pet customization and AI-driven genetics system ensure each pet is uniquely yours.
Bring All Freedom-lovers Together
Share, inspire, and connect in Vvanna Community. Host virtual gatherings to catch up with your long-missed friends. Visit each other, cook dishes, decorate rooms, and save memories into your group photos.
A place of endless possibilities for every girl, Life Makeover endorses every dream and ignites every potential!
Official Website: https://lifemakeover.archosaur.com/
Official Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/LifeMakeover
Official Discord: https://discord.gg/Rj4dYTgw3s

iOS: iPhone 7 or above.
Supported system: iOS 10.0 or above.

bluejetty:00145961:ios.summary:
AI Video Generator – Create Videos from Text and Images with AI

bluejetty:00145961:ios.description:
AI Video Generator – Create Videos from Text and Images with AI
AI Video Generator is a powerful AI-driven tool that transforms your ideas into videos in just a few simple steps. Whether you need to convert text into video (Text to Video) or animate images into video (Image to Video), our AI-powered features enable you to produce professional, engaging, and dynamic videos effortlessly. Your AI video maker: go from prompt to video or photo to video in a few taps.
What Can You Do with AI Video Generator?
Bring Your Stories to Life
Use Text to Video technology to turn your ideas into captivating videos that engage your audience. Write in your own language; dialogue in quotes is spoken as written.
Create Social Media Content
Generate visually appealing portrait or landscape videos for your social media feeds.
Produce Educational and Presentation Videos
Enhance your presentations by animating images using the Image to Video feature.
Develop Creative Projects
Combine text, images, styles, and camera moves with AI to craft unique and visually compelling videos.
Advantages of AI Video Generator
Sound Generated with Your Video
AI creates sound along with each video, including spoken dialogue. You can also turn it off.
Text to Video: Fast Video Generation from Text
Simply type your idea, and AI will transform it into a video.
Image to Video: Animate Your Images
Turn static images into dynamic animations with AI.
A Variety of Video Styles
Choose from Film, Anime, 3D, Clay, Realistic, and Vintage styles to match your content.
HD and 4K Quality
Create in 720p or 1080p, or in 4K with Cinematic quality, then save and share your videos.
Templates and One-Tap Effects
Start from ready-made scenes such as street interview, talk show, and podcast, or upload one photo and pick an effect: bring an old photo to life, dance, look younger, or make your pet talk.
Keep Your Character in Any Scene
Add up to 3 reference images to keep the same person, pet, or product across new scenes (Balanced and Cinematic quality).
Extend and Create Variations
Extend a finished video by 7 seconds, or create up to 4 variations at once and pick your favorite.
How It Works
1. Define Your Idea
Example: “A golden retriever surfing a big wave at sunset, slow motion.”
2. Select Your Style
Choose a style and camera move, then set quality, length (4, 6, or 8 seconds), and format.
3. Let AI Video Generator Do the Work
AI turns your text and images into an engaging video with visuals, motion, and sound.
Key Features
AI-generated sound and dialogue for your scenes
A fast and easy AI video creation process—no technical skills required
Portrait (9:16) and landscape (16:9) video formats
Text to Video and Image to Video technologies for quick content generation
Follow progress on your Lock Screen and get notified when it's ready
Share a photo or text from another app to start a video
No sign-up required, available in 16 languages
Turn Your Ideas into Reality with AI Video Generator! Create your first video today!
Credits and Subscriptions
Creating a video uses credits, depending on quality, resolution, and length. If a video can't be created, its credits are refunded automatically.
Weekly and monthly subscriptions include 40, 80, 120, or 600 credits per period; unused credits don't roll over. One-time credit packs include 16, 40, or 80 credits and don't expire.
Videos made without a purchase include a watermark. Any subscription or credit pack removes it, including from your earlier videos.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.
Good to Know
Real famous people and copyrighted characters or brands can't be generated. Video files are stored for 180 days, so save the ones you want to keep.
Privacy Policy: https://voiser.ai/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://voiser.ai/terms-of-use

Extend and Create Variations

How It Works

1.	Define Your Idea
Example: “A golden retriever surfing a big wave at sunset, slow motion.”

2.	Select Your Style

AI-generated sound and dialogue for your scenes

Creating a video uses credits, depending on quality, resolution, and length. If a video can't be created, its credits are refunded automatically.

Weekly and monthly subscriptions include 40, 80, 120, or 600 credits per period; unused credits don't roll over. One-time credit packs include 16, 40, or 80 credits and don't expire.

Videos made without a purchase include a watermark. Any subscription or credit pack removes it, including from your earlier videos.

We form a queue of all cab drivers within 5 minutes to reach the passenger based on the driver’s waiting time, distance and rating. You don’t have to wait for your transport anymore.
iCAB is very easy to operate:
1. Open the service of passenger application.
2. Indicate your current online location and the desired destination of the trip.
3. Monitor your route while a fast affordable ride around the city or country.
4. At the end of the tour evaluate your ride and driver.
5. You will receive your travel receipt by email associated with your account.
Safety
We care about your safety until the last minute of your ride, therefore your driver will never leave until makes sure you have safely entered your home, especially when it is night time.
If you have any questions about iCAB Winnipeg - contact us by email: support@icabapp.ca
iCAB has the best offer to get fast cab rides. Let’s request a ride with our service and relax on your affordable trip!

bluejetty:00076908:ios.description:
В помощь православному человеку. Все необходимые молитвы, каноны и акафисты с церковным богослужебным пением. Вся Библия в звуке — 77 книг в великолепном исполнении. И всё это в одном приложении.
ЗАЧЕМ ЭТО НУЖНО
• Поможет в ежедневной молитве и подготовке к Святому Причащению.
• Незаменим в ситуациях, когда чтение невозможно: за рулём, в болезни, при слабом зрении.
• Подходит детям и пожилым людям.
ЧТО ЕСТЬ В ПРИЛОЖЕНИИ
• Утренние и вечерние молитвы.
• Молитвы на разные случаи жизни.
• Последование ко Святому Причащению.
• Православные каноны и акафисты.
• Псалтирь.
• Великий покаянный канон.
• Библия — все 77 книг в тексте и аудиозаписи.
НАСТОЯЩЕЕ ЦЕРКОВНОЕ ПЕНИЕ
Многие молитвы, каноны и акафисты звучат в исполнении церковных хоров. Многоголосное богослужебное пение помогает настроиться на молитву и почувствовать красоту православной традиции.
ВСЯ БИБЛИЯ В ЗВУКЕ
Слушайте все 77 книг Священного Писания в профессиональной озвучке Синодального перевода — от Бытия до Откровения Иоанна Богослова.
СЛУШАЙТЕ И СЛЕДИТЕ ЗА ТЕКСТОМ
Слушайте молитвы и одновременно следите за текстом: произносимые слова подсвечиваются, а текст плавно прокручивается вслед за чтением. Это помогает лучше понимать и запоминать молитвы.
КАК ПОЛЬЗОВАТЬСЯ
• Запускайте аудио с выбранного слова при помощи долгого касания.
• Скачивайте аудиокниги на устройство, чтобы слушать без интернета.
• Добавляйте любимые книги и отдельные места в закладки.
• Переключайтесь между светлой и тёмной темами, настраивайте размер шрифта.
МОЛИТВЫ ВСЕГДА ПОД РУКОЙ
Все тексты молитв доступны бесплатно. Первый аудиотрек каждой книги можно прослушать бесплатно, чтобы познакомиться с её содержанием и звучанием. Полные аудиозаписи доступны по подписке или при покупке отдельных книг.
Пусть «Молитвослов» станет вашим добрым помощником в ежедневной молитве.
ВОПРОСЫ И ПРЕДЛОЖЕНИЯ
Если у вас возникли вопросы или что-то не работает, пожалуйста, напишите нам. Мы обязательно постараемся помочь!
Техническая поддержка: support@audiomolitvoslov.ru
УСЛОВИЯ ПОДПИСКИ
Подписка продлевается автоматически, пока вы её не отмените. Управлять подпиской и отключить автопродление можно в настройках учётной записи Apple.

bluejetty:00096392:ios.description:
Lilly Health™: Your journey, your way
Whether you’re on Zepbound® (tirzepatide), Mounjaro® (tirzepatide) or Foundayo™ (orforglipron), Lilly Health™ offers personalized information, education, and insights to help you feel supported throughout your treatment journey, at no cost. 
Please see Indication and Safety Summary with Warnings for Mounjaro at mounjaro.lilly.com/risk
Please see Indications and Safety Summary with Warnings for Zepbound at zepbound.lilly.com/risk
Please see Indications and Safety Summary with Warnings for Foundayo at foundayo.lilly.com/risk
When you download and use the Lilly Health™ mobile app, features will be customized based on your treatment and condition and may include:
LOGBOOK:
Track medicines, activity, and more—all in one place. 
PERSONALIZED SUPPORT: 
Lilly Health™ offers personalized information, education and insights to help you feel supported on your treatment journey—plus timely notifications to help keep your momentum going.
CUSTOMIZE ALERTS:
Set up dosing reminders to help stay on track with your medicine. 
VISUALIZE TRENDS: 
Review patterns, trends, and progress using charts and custom time ranges to share with your Health Care Provider. 
MEDICINE SUPPORT: 
Access savings information, keep track of your dose, and make updates if you and your doctor decide to make any changes. 
CONNECT DEVICES: 
You can choose to sync smart devices and apps for your convenience. 
LEARN & EXPLORE: 
Discover helpful articles, healthy recipes, and guided movement videos in our content library.
Lilly Health™ also provides access to general health education, wellness content,
and limited app features for adults 18 years or older, regardless of prescription or
medication status.
Note: This app is intended for the exclusive use of U.S. residents 18 years of age and older. Lilly Health™ is not intended to provide treatment decisions or replace the care and advice of a licensed Health Care Provider (HCP). All medical analysis and treatment plans should be performed by a licensed HCP. 
Still have questions? 
Call 1-800-LillyRx (1-800-545-5979) for additional support (available Monday to Friday 9 am - 5 pm EST).

bluejetty:00064028:ios.description:
This is an online Rummy Okey Game. You can play anytime! Press the Quick Start button and you'll be sitted at a new table with real players.
Game rules:
The game starts with 106 cards. Every player has to form valid card formations (ex: 12-12-12 or 3-4-5).
You need to draw a card from the card stacks or draw the card that the previous player placed on the table. 
At the end of your turn you need to place a card on the table for the next player. 
You can score and end the game when all the cards on your game board are placed in formations. One single card has to remain free from formations. 
This is an example of a valid game board:
12-12-12 
2-3-4-5-6 
7-7-7
10-11-12
11
The game board above gives you a score of 250 points. Any Joker in the formations would reduce the score by 50 points. 
Enjoy the game!
Terms of use: https://en.remi-online.ro/regulament
Privacy: https://en.remi-online.ro/privacy

bluejetty:00076517:ios.description:
Switching music apps? Don't leave your playlists behind.
Free Your Music transfers your playlists, albums, and liked songs between all major streaming services. Move from Spotify to Apple Music, Apple Music to Spotify, YouTube Music to TIDAL — any direction, in minutes.
◉ How it works:
1. Connect your current and new music service
2. Pick the playlists and albums you want to move
3. We match every song and start the transfer
4. Review the results — see exactly what moved and fix anything that didn't
Your first 600 songs transfer completely free.
◉ Supported services:
Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, Amazon Music, TIDAL, SoundCloud, Deezer, Napster — and more coming.
◉ Key features:
• Transfer playlists, albums, and your liked-songs library
• Keep playlists in sync — new songs you add are copied automatically
• Accurate song matching with a full transfer report
• Move one playlist or your entire library in a single run
• Works on iPhone, iPad, and Mac — one purchase covers all your devices
• No copy-paste, no spreadsheets, no lost songs
◉ Thinking about TuneMyMusic, Soundiiz, or SongShift?
Free Your Music is the simple, reliable alternative: transfers run on your device, your library never sits on someone else's server, and you can start free.
Download Free Your Music and take your playlists with you. Your music belongs to you — keep it wherever you go.
Support: https://freeyourmusic.com/help
TOS: https://freeyourmusic.com/terms-of-service

To be the greatest, you gotta learn from the greatest. In the post-prohibition world of farming, elevated entrepreneur Wiz Khalifa teaches you how to plant, grow, and harvest the finest herb on earth in this epic new simulation game.
Follow in Wiz Khalifa’s footsteps as you build your own weed empire from the ground up.
- Tap to plant and grow quality strains for your clients
- Swipe to get your products to market and get your paper up
- Invest your profits to expand your grow op
- Boost your harvest with hydroponics and LED grow lights
- Level up to unlock accessories and rare mystery strains

SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS

The Diamond Membership for $4.99 offers a weekly subscription after a 3-day free trial. Opting into the 3 day trail unlocks the Light Rider car forever. - Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Canceling Trial or Subscription
- You can turn off the auto-renew for the subscription whenever you want to through iTunes.
- When your current trial/subscription period expires, you will be unsubscribed.
- The current active subscription period can not be canceled.
If you have any questions or comments, please contact us at support@metamoki.com

bluejetty:00023983:ios.description:
CompTIA Security+ Prep 2026 is an exam preparation application that will help you pass the Information Security Engineer certification exam (codenamed SY0-701) administered by the Computing Technology Industry Association (CompTIA) with a high score on your first attempt.
CompTIA Security+ Prep 2026 not only helps you gain insight into Security+ exam preparation, but also helps you increase your confidence in passing the exam on the first attempt by practicing hundreds of exam-like questions.
### Passing the exam on the first attempt ###
In CompTIA Security+ Prep 2026, there are a large number of questions prepared by exam experts that cover the scope of the official exam requirements. According to the exam requirements, you must master all subjects in order to successfully pass the CompTIA Security+ exam.
Specifically, these subjects include:
- General Security Concepts
- Threats, Vulnerabilities, and Mitigations
- Security Architecture
- Security Operations
- Security Program Management and Oversight
To help you pass the exam, our exam experts have carefully analyzed and broken down the above subjects. You will need to practice all 5 subjects that will help you pass the exam with confidence!
### Key Features ###
- Over 1000 practice questions with detailed answer explanations for each question
- Specialized practice by content area, with the flexibility to switch between them at any time
- View an analysis of your current performance in the "Statistics" section
The most important part of passing the CompTIA Security+ exam is to keep practicing and not lose confidence in the exam. You will find that every time you practice on CompTIA Security+ Prep 2026, your knowledge of the exam will increase, thus increasing your certainty of passing the exam.
Set aside a certain amount of time each day to practice some questions while hinting to yourself to do the same tomorrow. After you develop good study habits, you will find it easier to pass and score high on not only the CompTIA Security+ exam, but on any other exam!
### Purchases, Subscriptions and Terms ###
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to unlock access to all features, content areas, and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted directly from your Apple account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged based on the rate and term selected for the subscription plan. If you need to cancel your subscription, please do so no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term or your account will be automatically charged for renewal.
You can manage your subscription by turning off auto-renewal in your account settings in Apple after purchase. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Service - http://security.yesmaster.pro/terms-of-service.html
Privacy Policy - http://security.yesmaster.pro/privacy-policy.html
If you have any questions or comments about your use, please let us know via email at contact@yesmaster.pro and we will resolve them for you within 3 business days at the latest.

bluejetty:00076433:ios.description:
Assalamualaikum Brothers and Sisters,
iman Pro is a minimalist Solah notification app with advanced features and endless style customizations.

 JAKIM (Waktu Solat Malaysia)

 KEMENAG (Jadwal Sholat Indonesia)
 MUIS (Waktu Solat Singapura)
 FIANZ (New Zealand)
• Other Calculation methods:
 Muslim World League
 Egyptian General Authority of Survey
 University of Islamic Sciences Karachi
 Umm al-Qura
 Moonsighting Committee Worldwide
 Dubai
 Kuwait
 Qatar
 User Custom methods for the rest of the world

• Fixed offline location mode for users in remote and extreme areas without Internet and GPS access
• Full support for iPhone, Apple Watch, iPad, and Macs with iPad compatibility mode
• Qibla compass
• Variety of Lock Screen and Home Widgets
• Azan notification selections from 29 Muazzins and 11 audio tone selections
• Additional pre-Solah notification options
• Suhoor, Imsak, Shuruq, Ishraq, Duha, and Qiyam notifications
• Infinite configurable combinations of app theme colors that sync over to the Home Widgets
• Rearrangeable dashboard items
• Hijri and age calculator with birthday notifications

• iman Pro Apple Watch app
• iman Pro Watch Complications

bluejetty:00158278:ios.description:
If you're anxiously attached, you know how exhausting it is. One quiet day from him and your whole mood shifts.
Alora helps you calm down, see the situation clearly, and figure out the secure thing to do next.
Inside, you'll meet Maureen AI. She learns your relationship attachment style, then tells you honestly what's going on, and helps you decide the secure next step. Designed to calm your anxiety, and give you clarity on why you’re feeling a certain way. 
Start learning how to collect data on the man youre dating, and sit back relax and observe it as the most secure version of you. 
WHETHER YOU'RE DEALING WITH:
He went quiet and you can't stop thinking about it
You keep rereading his texts trying to figure out what he meant
You want to text him again and don't know if you should
You feel like you're the one keeping the relationship going
He talks about plans but never actually makes them
You've had the same conversation five times and nothing changed
You're not sure if you should stay or leave
You're still getting over a breakup or a divorce
Maureen can help.
HOW IT WORKS:
1. Tell Maureen what's going on. Send her screenshots, tap how you're feeling, or just vent. She'll give you her honest perspective, whether you've been seeing him for three weeks or living with him for three years.
2. Figure out the secure move. What would you do right now if you felt secure? Maureen helps you see it, and gives you an action plan. 
3. Do one Secure Action a day. Small personalized actions that help you feel steadier and put your energy back into your own life. Watch your Secure Score grow.
WHAT'S INSIDE:
Ask Maureen: Personalized advice for your exact situation
Text analyzer: upload screenshots and see what's really going on
Feelings check-in for the moments you're spiraling
Daily Secure Actions picked for you
Your Secure Score, and anxious-to-secure tracker
Private mode for the things you'd rather not save
WHAT CHANGES:
You stop panicking every time he pulls back
You stop guessing and start collecting data instead
You say what you need once, without over-explaining
Your life gets fuller, and he's no longer the center of it
You make decisions calmly instead of out of fear
You know when to stay and when to walk away
You feel like yourself again
Alora isn't therapy, and it isn't a dating app. It’s designed to be in your back pocket, and help you choose yourself first, so you feel magnetic and stop revolving your world around him. 
Trusted by 25,000+ women.
Start free. Upgrade to Premium for unlimited conversations with Maureen and the full Secure Actions library.
Feel calmer in love. Download Alora.

Privacy Policy:

bluejetty:00136956:ios.name: Survivor Z: Zombie Games
bluejetty:00136956:ios.summary: Embark on an adrenaline-pumping journey of survival in Survivor Z: Loot & Survive, the ultimate zombie game that combines intense zombie shooting with looting and base expansion. Dive into a world overrun by walking dead, where your skills
bluejetty:00136956:ios.description:
Embark on an adrenaline-pumping journey of survival in Survivor Z: Loot & Survive, the ultimate zombie game that combines intense zombie shooting with looting and base expansion. Dive into a world overrun by walking dead, where your skills will be put to the test as you navigate through a zombie apocalypse, loot for essential supplies, and upgrade your arsenal to face the challenges ahead.
Shoot Zombies:
Immerse yourself in a thrilling zombie shooting action. Your survival depends on your accuracy and quick reflexes. Traverse through varied levels, employing tactical maneuvers to outsmart adversaries and defend your base against hordes of undead foes!
Loot Collection:
Each level is packed with loot boxes, chests, and racks brimming with weapons, coins, skulls, equipment tickets, and items that can be turned into coins.
Unlock Different Weapons:
Progress from Basic firearms to Epic weapons as you level up. Upgrade, equip, or merge them to boost your offensive capabilities against the relentless walkers attack.
Merge and Evolve Equipment:
Gather RPG-style equipment to enhance your character and face off stupid zombies. Upgrade and merge pieces from Basic to Epic, and prepare for zombie defense to ensure your survival in the post-apocalyptic world.
Defeat Zombie Bosses:
Confront formidable zombie bosses, each more challenging than the last. Employ your upgraded weapons and skills to defeat them and claim valuable rewards.
Hulk Mode:
Transform into a hulk in select levels, allowing you to annihilate enemies with sheer brute force - the dead ahead won't know what hit them!
Expand Your Base:
Build and expand your base for increased protection and survival chances. Expand your safe haven against the walking dead and protect yourself from a walkers attack. Use skulls obtained from missions to enhance your base between levels.
Unlock Challenges:
Survivor Z offers a variety of challenges to test your zombie defense and survival skills and earn additional rewards. Face off against a zombie wave in dangerously unstable, lava-filled worlds in these especially tough levels
Sell Weapons for Coins:
Manage your inventory wisely by selling weapons you no longer need. Accumulate coins to upgrade equipment, unlock new weapons, and fortify your base.
Survivor Z: Loot & Survive offers a dynamic blend of action, strategy, and survival as you navigate a world overrun by zombies. They are coming, and your ultimate goal is to thrive in the face of the walkers attack. Are you ready to face the challenges, expand your base, and emerge as the ultimate survivor in this thrilling post-apocalyptic adventure?
Download Now and Begin Your Survival Journey with Survivor Z: Loot & Survive!

The MyChart app also enables you to check in to your appointment directly from your mobile device, and reduces the need to fill out paper forms each time you go to a new Catholic Health office. All your records will be in one place on MyChart.
The app also gives you access to your clinical test results sooner – usually in less than 24 hours. Plus you can connect with your doctor anytime, anywhere, via email through MyChart.
You’ll also be able keep your health care information better organized; the app you to check on your appointments (and those of your family members); check health records; access immunization records; and order medication refills – all from a single portal. You can even pay a bill or get a cost estimate for a future service through MyChart, or upload health and fitness data, including data from the Apple Health app, when enrolled in self-tracking programs.
So put your health into your hands – and take control with MyChart.

bluejetty:00082790:ios.description:
Focus deeply. Take better breaks.
Find your rhythm with Foca, a minimalist, ad-free Pomodoro timer that brings focused work, calming sounds, and guided stretching together.
Whether you’re studying, working, or making time for a personal project, Foca helps you give each task your attention—and make room for a refreshing break.
A TIMER THAT FITS YOUR DAY
• Customize your focus sessions to suit your task.
• Pause and resume when you need to.
• Stay on track with sound and vibration alerts.
• Keep your rhythm going with Auto-Run mode.
SET THE MOOD FOR FOCUS
Create a calmer space with ambient sounds, from Dawn Forest and Seashore to Berliner Café. Choose your background, settle in, and focus on what matters.
MAKE YOUR BREAKS COUNT
Step away from your task for a guided stretch. Follow clear illustrations and voice guidance, with exercises for your neck, shoulders, back, hands, legs, and whole body.
SEE WHERE YOUR TIME GOES
Look back on your focus time and see how it’s distributed across your categories. Understand your routine, recognize your effort, and make time for what matters to you.
MAKE IT YOURS
Organize your sessions with custom category names and colors—for work, study, reading, or whatever you’re focusing on.
Less distraction. More room to focus.
No ads. Just you, your next task, and a little time to reset.

bluejetty:00157437:ios.description:
Cozy Sort is a delightful and relaxing sorting game that brings joy and color to your screen. In this charming classic sorter, your task is simple yet engaging: organize adorable pets and other animals into their proper groups. With its colorful visuals and intuitive gameplay, Cozy Sort offers a soothing experience for players of all ages.
Step into a vibrant world filled with lovable cats, playful dogs, and other cute animals waiting to be sorted. Your job is to carefully match them by type, color, or other traits to create perfect order. Each level presents new challenges, with more animals to sort and an increasing complexity, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting.
The game’s eye-catching design and calming music make it perfect for unwinding after a long day. Whether you’re a puzzle enthusiast or just looking for a way to relax, Cozy Sort delivers the perfect blend of challenge and tranquility. Its simple controls and progressively harder levels ensure that players of all skill levels can enjoy and improve.
Features:
- Colorful and charming graphics: Immerse yourself in a world filled with adorable animals and vibrant animations.
- Relaxing and engaging gameplay: Sort your way to calmness as you focus on organizing the cutest critters.
- Intuitive controls: Easy to pick up and play at any age.
- Challenging levels: Test your skills with progressively harder puzzles that keep you engaged.
- Casual and stress-free: No timers or pressure—play at your own pace.
Whether you’re a fan of classic sorting games or new to the genre, Cozy Sort is the perfect way to unwind and have fun. Dive into a colorful, cozy adventure and discover the joy of sorting today!

bluejetty:00137581:ios.name: Papo City: Hospital
bluejetty:00137581:ios.summary: Welcome to Papo City: Hospital! – A unique blend of innovative city building and house role-playing game, where you can design and place your own hospital city map and enter the built rooms to play as doctors and patients, simulating hospit
bluejetty:00137581:ios.description:
Welcome to Papo City: Hospital! – A unique blend of innovative city building and house role-playing game, where you can design and place your own hospital city map and enter the built rooms to play as doctors and patients, simulating hospital scenes and stories! In Papo City: Hospital, you can also interact with real-life friends, like and compete in your designs!
Diverse Design: In Papo City: Hospital, you can build a variety of medical buildings! From choosing building and decoration cards from the board to cleverly placing them on the map, from parking lots to operating rooms, there are nearly twenty different types of rooms, each with its unique functionality, creating your ideal medical kingdom and providing comprehensive medical services to patients!
Playhouse Experience: Click on any built room to immerse yourself in a real medical scene. Interact with characters in the building, cooperate with your medical team, feel the life of your designed hospital, and fully simulate every aspect of medical work to become a master in medicine!
Card System: Use coins to draw various building, decoration, and character cards, each key to creating a medical paradise. Unleash your creativity and decision-making skills. This not only stimulates your creativity but also makes your medical paradise unique! Complete mini-games or level up to get cards!
Mini-Game Challenges: Papo City: Hospital now treats ten different conditions, including fracture healing, allergy relief, nasal congestion clearing, toothache care, dry eye moisturizing, stomach ache healing, wound processing, acne care, sprain recovery, and cold relief. Completing mini-games helps to level up and earn rich rewards!
Social Interaction: Connect and visit real-life friends! View friends' medical cities, share building inspiration and design results, and compete in liking contests to see whose hospital city gains more recognition!
【Features】
• Create and design your city hospital!
• Add friends and visit each other's cities!
• Hundreds of different cards!
• Nearly twenty different playhouse scenes!
• Ten different treatment mini-games!
• Simulate a real hospital environment!
• Freely explore the scenes with no rules!
• Multi-touch support to play with friends!
This version of Papo City: Hospital is free to download. You can unlock more content through in-app purchases. If you have any questions during the purchase or usage process, feel free to contact us anytime at contact@papoworld.com
【About Papo World】
Papo World's game philosophy is to create a relaxed, harmonious, and enjoyable gaming environment. With games as the main focus and animated shorts as a supplement, we aim to foster healthy living habits and stimulate curiosity and interest in learning through experiential and immersive gameplay.
Let Papo Bunny accompany you in your happy growth!
【Contact Us】
Email: contact@papoworld.com
Website: www.papoworld.com
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/PapoWorld/

bluejetty:00071461:ios.description:
Race to the Top: Embark on an exciting journey of brain-teasing challenges and rapid-fire questions in Trivia Race. This game combines the best elements of classic trivia games like trivial tursuit and quizup to offer an immersive and competitive quiz experience that you won't be able to put down. Engage in intense head-to-head battles against friends or fellow trivia enthusiasts from around the world, as you race against the clock to outsmart your opponents.
Put Your Knowledge to the Test: How well do you know a wide range of topics? From history and science to pop culture and sports, Trivia Race covers it all. Prepare to be both entertained and educated as you tackle an array of intriguing questions that will push your memory and intellect to new heights. Whether you're a trivia crack or a newcomer to the world of quizzes, there's something here for everyone.
Global Competition: Join the global community of trivia lovers and compete in real-time against players from different corners of the world. Showcase your expertise as you climb the ranks and establish your presence as a true trivia virtuoso. Will you be the one to claim the coveted title of the Trivia Race champion?
Engaging Gameplay: Trivia Race isn't just a regular quiz game – it's a fast-paced, heart-pounding battle of wits. Challenge your friends to thrilling trivia matches, or dive into solo matches to put your own knowledge to the ultimate brain test. With a sleek and intuitive interface, you'll be navigating through questions and answers with ease.
The Ultimate Trivia Showdown: Imagine the excitement of a trivia face-off, the tension of a quizup match, and the thrill of a high-stakes trivial pursuit – all rolled into one captivating gaming experience. Trivia Race delivers all of this and more. Are you up for the challenge?
Unleash Your Inner Trivia Prodigy: Are you ready to be exposed to an adrenaline-pumping, mind-bending adventure? Trivia Race isn't just about answering questions; it's about outsmarting your opponents and proving your mettle as the ultimate quiz champion. Sharpen your memory, expand your knowledge, and rise to the top in this cutthroat race of intellects.
Don't miss out on the excitement – download Trivia Race now and embark on a journey that will keep you hooked for hours on end. Whether you're seeking a brainy challenge, friendly competition, or the thrill of proving your mastery, Trivia Race has it all. It's time to dive into the world of trivia, where every question is a chance to prove yourself. Are you up to the task?

bluejetty:00183020:ios.description:
Get ready to embark on an audacious journey where you become the master of a mysterious black hole in one of the most thrilling black hole games. Your mission is to gobble up all the white pieces scattered throughout the colourful 3D levels. Just remember: white is right!
The controls are as easy as pie! All it takes is a simple swipe of your finger across the screen to send your attack hole zooming across the virtual scape of the hole game. That's right, no complex controls to learn - just pure, unadulterated fun right from the get-go!
But don't let that fool you, this whole io game packs a challenging punch. With each new level, the maps grow more intricate and cunning. And that's not all - one wrong move and your game could be over. That's right, dodge the non-white pieces like your life (or rather, your io game) depends on it!
Why you’ll love Color Hole 3D:
- Levels of Thrilling Action: Each level in this hole game is more challenging than the last, you'll always have a new puzzle to solve
- Swipe and Go: Master the i o game in seconds with intuitive, easy-to-learn controls
- Challenge Your Skills: The black game is perfect for those who love testing their reaction and agility
So why wait? Take the plunge and download Color Hole 3D now to experience the thrilling action and addictive gameplay that has captured the hearts of players around the world. Whether you're a seasoned veteran in the realm of black holes and good job games or a casual player looking for a fun and engaging way to pass the time, Color Hole 3D is sure to provide hours of entertainment and excitement. Get ready to take on the world one white piece at a time!

bluejetty:00032313:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00032313:ios.description:
Your memories belong in Photos, not left behind on your computer.
Rollit moves photos, videos, and Live Photos from your computer straight into the Photos app on your iPhone or iPad, preserving full original quality, with capture dates and locations kept when available.
Transfer over Wi‑Fi using a web browser on Mac, Windows, or Linux.
No cloud upload. No account. No subscription.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Open Rollit and tap File Transfer.
2. On your computer, open the address shown and enter the PIN, or scan the QR code.
3. Drag your photos and videos into the browser.
4. Tap once to save them all to Photos.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE ROLLIT
- Live Photos stay Live Photos. Motion and sound come with them.
- Full resolution, no compression. Original files are never resized or recompressed.
- Capture dates and locations come across when available.
- Filter before you transfer. Browse Live Photos, videos, screenshots,
 selfies, RAW, HEIC, and more.
- Merge exact duplicate copies before they clutter your library.
- Big or small move. A few favorites or a whole collection.
- Wi‑Fi or USB. Transfer wirelessly in your browser, or use Finder, Apple Devices, or iTunes with a cable.
- Simple by design. A few taps, drag and drop, done.
SUPPORTED FILE TYPES
Photos: JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF, HEIC, HEIF, HEICS, HIF, AVIF, AVIFS, WEBP, TIFF, TIF, BMP, BMPF, DNG, PSD, TGA, EXR, ICO, ICNS, CUR, XBM
Videos: MOV, QT, MP4, M4V, 3GP, 3GPP, 3GP2, 3G2, SDV
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photos and videos transfer directly between your computer and your device over local Wi‑Fi or USB. 
They are not uploaded to Rollit or stored on an external media server. 
To pair your browser, Rollit uses small, temporary connection details that expire within minutes.
Rollit makes moving your photos and videos feel like magic.
Loving Rollit? Drop us a review. Your support means the world!

- Connect with a coach: Review coaching exper
bluejetty:00042377:ios.description:
CoachUp helps athletes of all ages and skill levels connect with the nation’s largest network of world-class, vetted coaches for personalized, sport-specific instruction.
ATHLETES & PARENTS: 
- Connect with a coach: Review coaching experience, specialities, and ratings to find the perfect coach near you (select from coaches in 30+ sports)
- Register for individual lessons or group training, virtual training, camps, clinics, and classes 
- Manage your training schedule, message coaches, and receive personalized feedback and analysis
- Access to extensive training resources (drills, workouts and more)
- 100% money back guarantee and secure payment with credit card or Apple Pay
- Improve skills, gain confidence, and celebrate success! Share your progress on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and more
COACHES: 
- Build and manage your entire coaching business: Gain new clients, message athletes & parents, schedule training, and provide feedback to athletes 
- Customize your profile: Update your bio, upload photos and videos, and add your coaching availability
- $1 million in liability insurance on all training booked through CoachUp
- Receive payment directly to your bank account and track your income 
- Complete training sessions to earn gear and merchandise from the CoachUp Store
- Are you a coach or former college athlete looking to give back to the sport you love? Download the CoachUp app today!
------------
TESTIMONIALS
I want to help every athlete benefit from the same coaching that I had growing up -- and CoachUp does that by connecting athletes with private coaches in every sport -- all across the country.
- Stephen Curry, CoachUp Athlete Ambassador, NBA Champion, and 2x MVP
CoachUp lets me find instructors with specialized knowledge to nurture my children beyond the basics taught in youth sports. My MLB career was about hard work, determination, and the influence of a few private coaches. CoachUp makes it easy for outstanding coaches and driven players to connect and thrive together!
- Gabe Kapler, former baseball star and World Series Champion 
Jeff is a fantastic instructor. He's been working with our 12 year-old to improve his agility and technique as well as sharpen his defensive skills for upcoming football tryouts. His focus on detail for movement and agility and showing how they translate to the field are exactly what we wanted from 1-on-1 sessions.
- Grant Belaire, CoachUp football parent
As the parent of a young soccer player, I am always looking to give him an edge and improve his game in a fun and stress-free environment. [Coach Chad] gave him techniques that immediately improved his shot accuracy and on-field decision-making, resulting in 2 goals after his first session! 
- Alexander Arnold, CoachUp soccer parent 
Kyle is an awesome teacher and has helped Nick far beyond my expectations. The improvements he made were remarkable. My son loves Coach Kyle!
- Jeannine Lenhart, CoachUp basketball parent
------------
ABOUT COACHUP: https://www.coachup.com
CoachUp is the nation’s leading personal coaching company with 20,000+ coaches across the country and hundreds of training sessions happening daily. Our mission is to help athletes change the trajectory of their lives through sports. Whether you’re a high school athlete looking to make the basketball team, a fitness rookie running your first 5k, or a busy mom looking to fit yoga into your hectic schedule -- CoachUp will help you reach your unique goal!
Email and phone support from our Customer Experience team is available 7 days a week (open the app and tap “Support” from the menu).

bluejetty:00031608:ios.summary: Are you suffering from Tinnitus? The MindEar Tinnitus App teaches you how to take control of ear ringing using clinically proven techniques. From Sound Therapy to Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), MindEar can finally provide you with Tinn
bluejetty:00031608:ios.description:
Are you suffering from Tinnitus? The MindEar Tinnitus App teaches you how to take control of ear ringing using clinically proven techniques. From Sound Therapy to Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), MindEar can finally provide you with Tinnitus relief.
Designed by audiologists, psychologists and researchers, MindEar utilizes scientifically proven methodologies to target areas where patients suffer the most. With MindEar, you can work your way through the anxiety, stress, and depression that often accompanies Tinnitus.
► Download MindEar today
MindEar Features
► Customizable Sound Therapy library, change levels according to your preference
► Podcast Series including better breathing, sleep relief, healthy habits and more
► Guided Meditations including full body scans, mindfulness, relaxation and more
► AI-powered chatbot to help and support you 24/7
► In-App Hearing Evaluation providing results in minutes
► Free 15 minutes consultation with a Tinnitus expert
Tinnitus Relief, tailored to you
► If you need quick Tinnitus Relief, try one of MindEar's many soundscapes or meditations.
► For more longer term Tinnitus Relief, you can interact with our AI-powered Tinnibot who will help you with some therapeutic activities as and when you need them.
► You can also use the MindEar Tinnitus App to monitor your progress and journal your general thoughts and feelings.
MindEar’s Tinnitus Solutions
► Education
Many Tinnitus sufferers can regain control over their condition by understanding more about it. MindEar will teach you more about Tinnitus which, in turn, can help you better deal with the symptoms.
► Cognitive Behavioral Therapy
Cognitive Behavioral Therapy helps sufferers focus on the positive in their lives and negate the negativity that Tinnitus brings. MindEar has many CBT activities that are designed to help you understand the connection between your thoughts and feelings.
► Sound Therapy
Sound can distract your from your ear ringing or, through the process of habituation, help your brain to adapt to it and, eventually, ignore it. MindEar uses the experience of Sound Therapy soundscapes to transport you to a different place, exploring the calming sounds of nature.
► Sleep Therapy
Many Tinnitus sufferers report sleep deprivation which, in turn, can make Tinnitus worse. MindEar can give you sleep relief through guided Sleep Therapy sessions.
► Rewarding Progression
MindEar uses points to track your progress and reward you for using the app frequently. Finding Tinnitus Relief will be fun with MindEar!
► Mindfulness
Mindfulness has been found to help reduce stress and anxiety, while teaching those who practice it to be kind to themselves, taking each moment as it comes and for what it is. The MindEar Tinnitus App has a range of relaxation techniques and breathing exercises that can help you achieve a state of mindfulness.
What do users say about MindEar?
“I never knew that what I was living with for months was Tinnitus. As soon as I began to learn more, the pieces all started to fit. I feel empowered now to manage my Tinnitus and improve my daily living!” – Kieran
"I knew quite a bit about the condition, however, MindEar has proved a very handy app with lots of useful content" – Dulzdin
"Using the app has been life-changing – a real mental health savior" – Kimberly
► Download “MindEar | Tinnitus Relief” today
Disclaimer: The MindEar app does not replace the need to seek a doctor’s advice before making any medical decisions.

bluejetty:00026845:ios.description:
Weather Scope: Precision Meets Simplicity - Dive into the world of detailed weather tracking with Weather Scope. Powered by NOAA's cutting-edge data, our app offers an unparalleled blend of accuracy and user-friendly design. Whether it's tracking cyclones, monitoring snowfall, or planning for your day with real-time weather updates, Weather Scope is your go-to source. Experience customized alerts, advanced radar imagery, and forecasts that cater to your every need. Join the community of weather-savvy individuals who choose Weather Scope for reliable, up-to-the-minute weather insights. Download now and step into a new era of weather forecasting!
Why choose WeatherScope?
Easy access to Current & Forecasted Weather: Get current weather conditions, such as feels-like temperature and UV index along with next-hour (Minute by minute rain possibility), hourly, and daily forecasts for up to 10 days. In supported regions you will see Air Quality information that will help you stay healthy and monitor particulates in the air.
Experience Daily Weather Insights with AI Precision: Benefit from top-tier, AI-curated daily weather summaries delivered directly to your device.
Real-Time Radar & Forecasts: Get up-to-the-minute global precipitation data, detailed weather forecasts, and stay ahead of the storm.
Advanced Hurricane Tracking: Our NHC-integrated hurricane tracker provides real-time updates on storm paths and wind speeds. This data is provided by the National Hurricane Center.
Lightning Alerts & Data: Stay safe with timely alerts when lightning is detected in your vicinity.
NWS Alerts: Receive alerts from the National Weather Service and visualize then inside of Weather Scope.
Real-Time Air Traffic Tracking: Elevate your aviation experience with our comprehensive aeroweather feature.
Rain and Cyclone Monitoring: Keep track of rainfall totals and cyclone developments.
Customizable: Configure alerts based on your preferences and never get caught off-guard.
View Weather Details:
- 24 hour and 10-day forecast
- PrecipScope forecast for every minute in the next hour.
- 10 days of hourly forecasts
- Air Quality Index for supported regions (CONUS)
- Current weather, min & max temperatures, sun rise/set, Feel-like temperature.
- Humidity, pressure, visibility, wind speed, gust info and dew-point etc.
- Likelihood / chance of precipitation.
Join our community of happy users and revolutionize the way you interact with weather. Whether you're tracking hurricanes, storms, monitoring rain, or indulging in aviation tracking - Weather Scope has you covered!
Download Weather Scope today, and experience the future of weather tracking. Your safety and satisfaction are our priority.
Access Premium Features: Weather Scope is free to use, and you can unlock even more powerful features, including the Hurricane Tracker, Aviation Overlays, and Internet Traffic with a subscription.
Please Note: Location is used to provide navigation services over a moving map and localized weather information. PrecipScope is not supported by all locations.
Current weather and forecast information is provided by Apple's WeatherKit. Weather Scope's radar overlays and aviation products are provided by Aviator Assistant.

Powered by NOAA's cutting-edge data, our app offers an unparalleled blend of accuracy and user-friendly design. Whether it's tracking cyclones, monitoring snowfall, or planning for your day with real-time weather updates, Weather Scope is your go-to source. Experience customized alerts, advanced radar imagery, and forecasts that cater to your every need. Join the community of weather-savvy individuals who choose Weather Scope for reliable, up-to-the-minute weather insights. Download now and step into a new era of weather forecasting!

Why choose WeatherScope?

Easy access to Current & Forecasted Weather: Get current weather conditions, such as feels-like temperature and UV index along with next-hour (Minute by minute rain possibility), hourly, and daily forecasts for up to 10 days. In supported regions you will see Air Quality information that will help you stay healthy and monitor particulates in the air.

Experience Daily Weather Insights with AI Precision: Benefit from top-tier, AI-curated daily weather summaries delivered directly to your device.

Real-Time Radar & Forecasts: Get up-to-the-minute global precipitation data, detailed weather forecasts, and stay ahead of the storm.

Advanced Hurricane Tracking: Our NHC-integrated hurricane tracker provides real-time updates on storm paths and wind speeds. This data is provided by the National Hurricane Center.

Lightning Alerts & Data: Stay safe with timely alerts when lightning is detected in your vicinity.

NWS Alerts: Receive alerts from the National Weather Service and visualize then inside of Weather Scope.

Real-Time Air Traffic Tracking: Elevate your aviation experience with our comprehensive aeroweather feature.

Rain and Cyclone Monitoring: Keep track of rainfall totals and cyclone developments.

Customizable: Configure alerts based on your preferences and never get caught off-guard.

View Weather Details:

- 24 hour and 10-day forecast
- PrecipScope forecast for every minute in the next hour.
- 10 days of hourly forecasts
- Air Quality Index for supported regions (CONUS)
- Current weather, min & max temperatures, sun rise/set, Feel-like temperature.
- Humidity, pressure, visibility, wind speed, gust info and dew-point etc.
- Likelihood / chance of precipitation.

Join our community of happy users and revolutionize the way you interact with weather. Whether you're tracking hurricanes, storms, monitoring rain, or indulging in aviation tracking - Weather Scope has you covered!

Download Weather Scope today, and experience the future of weather tracking. Your safety and satisfaction are our priority.

Access Premium Features: Weather Scope is free to use, and you can unlock even more powerful features, including the Hurricane Tracker, Aviation Overlays, and Internet Traffic with a subscription.

Please Note: Location is used to provide navigation services over a moving map and localized weather information. PrecipScope is not supported by all locations.

Current weather and forecast information is provided by Apple's WeatherKit. Weather Scope's radar overlays and aviation products are provided by Aviator Assistant.

bluejetty:00186057:ios.name: What’s in The Oceans?
bluejetty:00186057:ios.summary:
Explore the deep sea and the animals that call it home. Play with and learn about sharks, penguins, octopuses, seahorses, turtles and many others!
With "What’s in The Oceans?" you can play and learn freely, with no pressure or stress. Play
bluejetty:00186057:ios.description:
Explore the deep sea and the animals that call it home. Play with and learn about sharks, penguins, octopuses, seahorses, turtles and many others!
With "What’s in The Oceans?" you can play and learn freely, with no pressure or stress. Play, observe, ask questions and find the answers. Explore how animals interact with each other, how they live, how they defend themselves and how they reproduce.
Learn and get informed about the pollution of the oceans and its dangers. See how plastics, overfishing, climate change and ships affect the life and health of different ecosystems. We only have one planet — let's take care of it!
With five incredible ecosystems:
South Pole
Discover the life of penguins, seals and orcas. Play with them! What do they eat and how do they live? How does climate change affect them?
Octopuses
Feed the sharks and learn how octopuses defend themselves and not be devoured. Try to protect the divers inside the shark cage!
Dolphins
See how the dolphins hunt, reproduce and come out to breathe. Play with them until it becomes night so they can go to sleep. Watch the fishing nets — if the dolphins get caught in them, they will not be able to come out to breathe.
Turtles
Feed the turtles and watch them lay eggs. Help the younglings to get out of the egg, and make sure the turtles don't eat the plastic bags, as they sometime mistake them for jellyfish. Look at the remoras — they always hitch a ride on the turtles.
Seahorses
Seahorses are small and fragile. Protect them from their predators, crabs, and make the algae and corals grow so they can hide.
Features
• Discover how animals live and how they interact in different ecosystems.
• Play and learn with different marine animals: octopuses, crabs, sharks, turtles, jellyfish, seahorses, penguins, orcas, seals, remoras, starfish... And many others.
• See how pollution and human activity are harming sea life.
• With real videos of marine animals.
• Suitable for all ages from 3+.
ABOUT LEARNY LAND
At Learny Land, we love to play, and we believe that games must form part of the educational and growth stage of all children; because to play is to discover, explore, learn and have fun. Our educational games help children learn about the world around them and are designed with love. They are easy to use, beautiful and safe. Because boys and girls have always played to have fun and learn, the games we make - like the toys that last a lifetime - can be seen, played and heard.
At Learny Land we take advantage of the most innovative technologies and the most modern devices to take the experience of learning and playing a step further. We create toys that could not have existed when we were young.
Read more about us at www.learnyland.com.
Privacy Policy
We take Privacy very seriously. We do not collect or share personal information about your children or allow any type of third party ads. To learn more, please read our privacy policy at www.learnyland.com.
Contact us
We'd love to know your opinion and your suggestions. Please, write to support@learnyland.com.
Terms of Use: http://learnyland.com/terms-of-service/
