bluejetty:00175020:ios.description:
The Most Complete Fishing App Available. Whether you're a novice or a pro, we’ve got you covered with 110,000+ fishing hot spots, marine weather, tide charts, and a complete guide to angler fish species globally. From fresh to saltwater, we’ve got everything you need to enhance your fishing journey.
Our Mission:
Pro Angler is committed to providing top-notch, professional fishing reports and angling secrets that help you land more fish. We provide proper regulations, environmental and species statistics, and more, promoting the sport of fishing across all ages.
Fishing tips, Fishing Spots, Marine Weather, Tides, and Angler Fish Species identifier in over 500 locations you've been looking for. 
Key Features:
- 110,000+ Fishing Hot Spots: Find the best locations for freshwater and saltwater fishing.
- Marine Weather & Tides: Get real-time weather, tide charts, and solunar info to plan the perfect fishing day.
- Angler Fish Species Info: Complete, detailed fish species guide with angling techniques for each.
- Weekly Local Fishing Reports: Benefit from 90+ years of Pro Captain experience with our Weekly Local Fishing Reports and Guides from Tournament Winning, Veteran Captains and Angling Authorities. 
- Fishing Regulations: Easy-to-access state and federal regulations to ensure you’re fishing legally.
- GPS Hot Spots & Artificial Reefs: Navigate your boat directly to the best fishing spots.
- Fishing Locations & Charters: Find local bait shops, boat launches, marinas, IGFA weigh stations, and more.
- Bonus Content: Recipes, knots, rigs, gear, fishing licenses, state and world records, and a digital wallet to store important fishing documents.
Pro Angler’s dedication goes beyond just reports; we strive to bring you everything you need for a successful fishing experience. We also proudly sponsor Keep America Fishing, advocating for your right to fish local waterways.
Pro Angler’s Advantages:
- Detailed Species Guide with angling techniques.
- Local ""What’s Biting"" Updates for your region every week.
- All Major Fishing Locations (inshore, nearshore, offshore) with current fishing reports from pro anglers and charter captains.
- Real-Time Marine Data: Weather, tides, and best fishing times with solunar info.
- Local Bait Shops, Marinas, Charters, and More: Thousands of resources to support your fishing needs.
What Industry Experts Say:

bluejetty:00065771:ios.description:
Archery Club is a multiplayer archery game with multiple exciting game types and an extensive upgrade system. Become a master archer, collect the best equipment and win against other people online!
FEATURES:
▶ REAL-TIME MULTIPLAYER: Find and defeat opponents from around the world!
▶ EXCITING ARCHERY MATCHES: Each match consists of multiple game types!
▶ EXTENSIVE UPGRADE SYSTEM: Find new pieces to strengthen your bows!
▶ MULTIPLE DETAILED VENUES: Shoot your way to victory in different environments
Start your road to becoming an archery champion now! Archery Club lest you pick your favorite bow and play against other people online in exciting, multi-part matches! During each one of them you’ll play at least two out of three possible game modes:
Shortbow - a quick, 30-second long round where your reflexes and fast aiming skills will be put to the test.
Longbow - a longer round with 3 shots for each of the players. The distance to the target will increase after each shot, so you’ll have to be mindful of gravity and wind!
Compoundbow - a more strategic round, where you’ll have to decide which targets to shoot. Those that guarantee better score may be way harder to hit, so decide carefully!
Each match is played as a Best Of 3 with those game types selected in random order. You’ll have to master all of them if you want to keep winning and climbing up in the tanks!
You’ll duel against other people online in one of 4 distinct venues - forest, wild west, country, and university. Additional venues and game modes will be added to the game in future updates.
By winning matches against other people and increasing your skill you unlock new bow parts that you can use to further improve your chances of winning. Keep close attention to statistics of the bow you use and make them even more powerful with unlockable upgrades.

bluejetty:00032411:ios.summary:

Lost your AirPods? Can't find your Fitbit? Dropped a specialized earbud in the couch? EarBuddy turns your iPhone into a high-powered Bluetooth scanner to track down your lost device befo
bluejetty:00032411:ios.description:
FIND LOST HEADPHONES, WATCHES & TRACKERS IN SECONDS.
Lost your AirPods? Can't find your Fitbit? Dropped a specialized earbud in the couch? EarBuddy turns your iPhone into a high-powered Bluetooth scanner to track down your lost device before the battery runs out.
HOW TO FIND YOUR LOST DEVICE:
Open & Scan: Launch EarBuddy and grant Bluetooth access. The app will immediately start scanning for nearby signals.
Find Your Item: Look for your device name in the list.
Tip: Use the "Headphones" or "Watches" tabs to filter the list. If you don't see your device, tap the filter button to "Show Unnamed" devices.
Enable Precision: Tap on your device. For the best results, allow "Always" location access so EarBuddy can track your movement accurately on the map.
Follow the Signal: Walk around slowly. Watch the Signal Radar — the circle fills up and turns green as you get closer.
Use the Compass: Switch to the Compass tab. If the signal is stable, the arrow will point you directly to your lost item.
Check the Map: Tap the Map view to see the device’s last known pin and track your own movement path towards it.

Do you like big construction cars? Then let’s go to our garage! You can customize, choose wheels, paint, and add stickers to dump trucks, bulldozers, graders, and many other vehicles! 
Choose a truck, customize it, and go on an exciting journey with your new friend — Raccoon. Many interactive objects along the way make truck driving so much fun! 
Little drivers will:
- Choose from many construction cars and trucks
- Paint, choose wheels, and customize their cars in the garage
- Explore different locations
- Meet fun characters and tap on interactive objects
- Listen to pleasant music
- Play with no ads
With this exciting app, children can improve their fine motor skills, develop creativity and imagination, and drive their favorite trucks. It’s a perfect match for young adventurers who love to create and play!
We love to make kids happy, and we also like to read your emails! If you need help, have questions, or want to say “hi,” please get in touch at info@preschoolplay.games

Stay connected anywhere in the world without paying roaming fees. UPeSIM is the French-made travel eSIM app that gives you instant mobile data in 200+ destinations worldwide, with no hidden fees, no contracts, and no bill shock.
▼ WHAT IS
bluejetty:00088671:ios.description:
Stay connected anywhere in the world without paying roaming fees. UPeSIM is the French-made travel eSIM app that gives you instant mobile data in 200+ destinations worldwide, with no hidden fees, no contracts, and no bill shock.
▼ WHAT IS AN eSIM?
An eSIM is a 100% digital SIM card built into your phone. No more hunting for a physical SIM at the airport: buy your data plan in the app, install your eSIM in seconds, and you're ready to go. Perfect for short trips, business travel, long stays, cruises, road trips, study abroad, or expat living.
▼ WHY CHOOSE UPeSIM?
• Global coverage: 200+ destinations across Europe, Asia, the Americas, Africa, the Middle East, and Oceania
• Two plan types: Standard (capped data, lowest prices) or Unlimited (uncapped, no throttling)
• Instant activation on arrival at 4G/5G speeds
• Friendly multilingual customer support via email and live chat, 7 days a week
• 100% secure payments: Apple Pay, PayPal, credit card (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), 3D Secure V2
• No commitment, no subscription, no auto-renewal
• Keep your primary line active for calls, SMS, and two-factor authentication codes
• Hotspot / tethering included on most plans, share data with your tablet or laptop
▼ NO MORE WAITING FOR WI-FI WHILE TRAVELING
Say goodbye to slow and risky public Wi-Fi, hunting for the hotel Wi-Fi password, filling out endless captive portals, or chasing down a coffee shop or fast-food joint just to get online. No more queueing at the airport SIM kiosk, no more pocket Wi-Fi rentals to pick up and return. UPeSIM gives you internet everywhere from the moment you land: in taxis, on the subway, on the train, walking down the street, at the beach, hiking in the mountains.
▼ EXCLUSIVE LOYALTY PROGRAM
At UPeSIM, your loyalty is rewarded every trip: earn 1 point per euro spent. 10 points = 1 euro off your next plan. The more you travel, the more you save. No other major eSIM provider offers loyalty rewards this generous.
▼ HOW IT WORKS
1. Download UPeSIM (free)
2. Pick your destination and plan
3. Pay in seconds
4. Install your eSIM in one tap (iOS 17.4+) or via QR code
5. Turn on data on arrival - you're online!
▼ POPULAR DESTINATIONS
Europe: United Kingdom, France, Spain, Italy, Portugal, Germany, Netherlands, Belgium, Greece, Croatia, Switzerland, Austria, Poland, Norway, Sweden, Iceland, Hungary, Ireland, Malta, Cyprus...
Americas: United States, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Peru, Chile, Cuba, Dominican Republic, Costa Rica, Guatemala, Ecuador...
Asia: Japan, South Korea, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia (Bali), Singapore, Malaysia, China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, India, Philippines, Cambodia, Sri Lanka, Maldives, Nepal, Laos, UAE...
Africa & Middle East: Morocco, Tunisia, Egypt, South Africa, Kenya, Senegal, Tanzania, Saudi Arabia, Israel, Jordan, Turkey, Lebanon...
Oceania: Australia, New Zealand, Fiji, French Polynesia, New Caledonia...
Regional plans: All Europe, Asia, Americas, Caribbean, Africa, and the whole world.
▼ WHO IS UPeSIM FOR?
Tourists, business travelers, digital nomads, study abroad students, expats, backpackers, cruise passengers, families on vacation, frequent flyers.
▼ FAVORITE APPS ABROAD
Messaging, video calls, maps and navigation, ride-hailing, hotel and flight booking, social media, streaming, mobile banking, email... All your apps just work.
▼ PLANS FOR EVERY TRIP
Short trip (3, 5, 7 days), weekend, mid-length (15, 30 days), long stay (60, 90 days), around-the-world. Easy top-ups inside the app.
▼ DEVICE COMPATIBILITY
iPhone XS to iPhone 17 (2025), all eSIM iPads, iOS 14 or later. Native installation on iOS
▼ SECURITY AND PRIVACY
GDPR compliance, encrypted 3D Secure V2 payments, no personal data resale.
▼ THE UPeSIM PROMISE
Made in France. A French brand built for travelers who want simplicity and transparency. Clear pricing, instant activation, real human customer support. Download UPeSIM now and travel connected for less!

It doesn't matter if you're new to the job market or a veteran—we can help craft a resume that reflects your experience level and field.
GET EXPERT GUIDANCE EVERY STEP OF THE WAY
Stand out from the crowd and make sure recruiters and employers take notice with guidance from our experts that is backed by research. From start to finish, we will show you how to make a resume, by recommending the best resume format for your work experience, and providing professional advice to emphasize your strengths and accomplishments. My Perfect Resume will help you feel confident during your job-seeking process.
CREATE A NEW RESUME OR IMPORT YOUR OWN
Our simple technology allows you to upload and reformat your existing resume or start from scratch. We’ll cover everything from your education, to your work history, skills, and more.

MAKE AN ATS-FRIENDLY IMPRESSION
Many companies rely on Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) to manage large amounts of resumes they receive. ATS scans your resume, compares the requirements for each job and decides on a score for you. This helps recruiters speed up their selection process. My Perfect Resume offers customizable resume templates that are designed to pass through ATS.

bluejetty:00126159:ios.description:
We know there are better things than going to the bank.
That is why ABANCA's mobile banking app helps you manage your money on a daily basis in the easiest, most agile and efficient way. 
It includes the latest market advances in usability and performance and incorporates many of the suggestions we have received from users like you, such as having Bizum within the app!
Here is everything you can do with the ABANCA app.
Your day-to-day
* Access your accounts, cards, loans, insurance, investments...
* Check your account balance and transactions held in your account. 
* You can hide the amounts of your accounts at any time by shaking or turning your mobile
* Turn dark mode on and off whenever you want.
* Improve your financial health by consulting how much you have spent in the month and how much you have saved
* Classify your expenses and income in categories 
* Pay your bills by taking a picture, view their details or return and cancel them with just one click.
* Save and access your favorite transactions.
* Download certificates of ownership of your accounts and receipts. 
* Search for charges, receipts and contracts in your document mailbox.
* Customize the instant alerts you want to receive.
* Sign contracts and documents from the mobile banking app.
* Update your address or phone number whenever you need to 
Your money transfers
* Send money to an account number and mobile with Bizum.
* We have incorporated the sending of Bizum to NGOs
* Make immediate transfers to any bank in the euro zone.
* Send money to an ATM to be withdrawn by you or whoever you choose, without a card, at thousands of ATMs throughout Spain in the Hal Cash network. 
* Schedule your money transfers through regular transfers and save your regular transactions and contacts.
Your cards
* Just one click to turn your cards on and off.
* Transfer money from your credit card to your account.
* Increase your card's available credit or amortize your purchases by moving money from your account to your card.
* Split card payments into installments. 
* Create and manage your virtual cards for online purchases.
* You can check the CVV of your cards
* Activate and request the PIN of your cards.
* Block a card and request a duplicate to be sent to you. 
* Modify daily limits for payments in stores, online and ATM withdrawals. 
* Search and consult past expenses in an agile and efficient way. 
* You can now classify the movements of your credit cards assigning and modifying the categories to your liking.
* You can check the spending of your cards classified by category and brand.
Your insurances
* Manage your insurances, the payment method and the main coverages. 
* Access all the information of your Insurance Flat Rate and incorporate the insurances you have contracted.
* Take out your home, auto and life insurance.
* Simulate your monthly premium directly from your mobile banking.
* Know the date on which we will charge you the next bill.
* Contact your company directly in case of a claim.
* Turn your insurance coverage ON-OFF and ON-OFF.
Your safety
* Personalize your money transfer limits. Strengthen your security and adjust them to your needs.
* Set up the fingerprint biometric access or Face ID.
* Strengthen the security of your operations with ABANCA Key.
* Consult and manage the access of all the devices from which you connect to your App.
* Just one click to turn your cards on and off.
* Modify daily limits for payments in stores, online and ATM withdrawals.
* Activate instant alerts to be notified when you make purchases over a certain amount, for example. 
* Validate your online purchases from the app. 
Your investments
* Check your pension plans and make contributions.
* Buy and sell securities and investment funds.
* Find out about your investments’ evolution.
* Request quotes and market information.
How do you like the mobile banking app? Leave a review! Thanks to your feedback we work on app updates and improve every day.

bluejetty:00075550:ios.description:
Let's imagine and cut the rope!
This application is a puzzle game in which you cut a rope to make a pose for a doll.
## Game Contents ##
You can make various poses by cutting ropes.
Try to clear the stage by creating poses that match the theme!
By cutting the rope, you can make poses for running, dancing, watering flowers, grabbing balloons, and so on.
Don't worry if you fail. You can retry and try again right away.
## Rules Explained ##
Trace your finger as if you were cutting a rope, and the rope will cut.
By cutting the rope, the limbs connected to the rope will move.
When several correct ropes are cut, the correct pose is achieved and the stage is cleared.
---
Rated for ages 3+ by IGRS (Indonesian Games Rating System).

bluejetty:00034786:ios.name: Bumpa - Manage Orders Easily
bluejetty:00034786:ios.summary: Bumpa is a mobile and web application that helps Nigerian business owners manage their business easily with features around seamless inventory management, business analytics, website creation, invoice & receipt generation, order and sales m
bluejetty:00034786:ios.description:
Bumpa is a mobile and web application that helps Nigerian business owners manage their business easily with features around seamless inventory management, business analytics, website creation, invoice & receipt generation, order and sales management.
With subscription packages tailored to fit your business needs, there are many things Bumpa will do for your business growth and efficiency.
CREATE A BUSINESS WEBSITE & MANAGE YOUR ONLINE BUSINESS SEAMLESSLY
• Create an easily customized business website in 2 minutes. No Code or tech skills required.
• Sell as many products as you wish with automated order updates for your customers.
• Get a free bumpa.shop domain or purchase a custom domain name with an SSL certificate on the app.
• Sell as many products as you wish with automated order updates for your customers.
TRACK YOUR BUSINESS INVENTORY WITH EASE
• Connect every point you have inventory: your website, stores across different locations, marketplaces, etc to Bumpa for proper inventory tracking.
• Get prompt notifications on your app when you’re running low on stock for products.
• Get analytics on your best and least-performing products.
MANAGE ORDERS & SALES WITH EASE
• Record sales from any channel safely to the cloud.
• Generate invoices and receipts from your customers.
• Get analytics on your total sales and best-performing sales channel.
• Access Bumpa’s Order Processing system that updates your customers when their payment is successful, the order has been shipped, delivered, etc - all without stress.
• Make order fulfillment simple by connecting to logistics providers through our Orders API integration.
RECEIVE PAYMENTS IN MULTIPLE WAYS, ONLINE & OFFLINE
• Use our online payment gateway to provide USSD, Bank Transfer, Card, QR Code payment options to your customers.
• Confirm online payments easily with our Proof of Payment feature on your website.
• Get WhatsApp notifications of payments for yourself and your staff with Bumpa Terminal.
• Get immediate payment confirmation with Bumpa Wallet (coming soon).
RUN DISCOUNTED SALES WITHOUT STRESS
• Create discounts & coupons by percentage or a fixed amount.
• Create start & expiration dates for your discount & coupons, and have your prices automatically revert when you’re done with sales.
GET COMPREHENSIVE BUSINESS ANALYTICS YOU WON’T FIND ANYWHERE ELSE
• Understand how well your business is doing with weekly sales reports, monthly business reports & analytics dashboard.
• View reports on Sales, Products & Customers by day, week, month, or year & compare different periods easily.
• Understand your sales performance by channel eg. Facebook, Physical store, Instagram, etc with the aid of a bar and pie chart.
• Save yourself the stress of calculating complex business numbers like Gross Profit, Total Sales, Shipping Spend, Average Spend per Customer, and much more.
COMMUNICATE WITH YOUR CUSTOMERS WHEREVER THEY ARE WITH A PROFESSIONAL TOUCH
• Send bulk SMS/emails to customers from the app.
• Record customer records safely with their preferences and transaction history.
• Connect your Instagram DM to Bumpa to sell products faster.
• Use Payment Request & Share Order to remind customers of pending payments, on any platform.
ACCESS RESOURCES FOR BUSINESS GROWTH
• Join a community of business owners who share resources, business tips, and information.
• Get monthly emails with updates on grant opportunities, competitions, accelerators, and much more.
• Get access to Bumpa Academy: an online resource with free access to business courses.
• Receive our business ebooks that come out once a quarter from seasoned professionals
As a product built by entrepreneurs for the Nigerian entrepreneur, Bumpa is the best way to manage and grow your business.

bluejetty:00145271:ios.description:
"*** ONLY AVAILABLE TO APPROVED USERS - https://odinpass.com.au/approvedusers/ ***
ODIN PASS offers bundles for transport options across South East Queensland as part of a world-leading Mobility as a Service (MaaS) trial.
Our bundle options include:
• Unlimited public transport
• Unlimited shared electric scooter trips*
• Unlimited shared electric bike trips*
• And discounts on taxis, ride-sharing and car-sharing (when available).
Choose the option that best suits you by using our advanced multi-modal journey planner to search and book any and all of your trips across South East Queensland.
ODIN PASS provides users with real-time information on public transport services, and estimates on travel, cost, environmental impact, and calories burnt. This means you can choose the transport option that’s right for you!
This MaaS trial is co-funded by the Queensland Department of Transport and Main Roads (TMR), Gold Coast City Council (GCCC), The University of Queensland (UQ), Queensland University of Technology (QUT), Griffith University (GU) and iMOVE, as part of a two-year research project.
Have a question? Visit odinpass.com.au
Note:
An active email address at The University of Queensland, Griffith University or other eligible group is required to sign up to ODIN PASS.
*Daily time limits apply to shared electric scooter and bike plans."

The Full FATE Saga in One App
Explore all four titles in the iconic series:
FATE
FATE: Undiscovered Realms
FATE: The Traitor Soul
FATE: The Cursed King
Remastered for mobile, with timeless gameplay and endless replayability.

Catch rare items and gear while fishing, and power up your hero between battles.
Your Fate, Your Choice
When defeat comes, how will you rise again? Choose your path forward wisely.
New Realm: Prometheus (In-app Purchase)
Enter a cursed town shrouded in eternal night. Battle through a corrupted marble dungeon, reclaim the Golden Scepter and restore the Golden Flame to Prometheus.
Includes:
• A new darkened town hub
• A brand-new dungeon
• Companion pet: Baby Pegasus
Available as an in-game purchase for FATE: Undiscovered Realms and accessible through the left portal in the Temple of Fate

bluejetty:00171194:ios.description:
Introducing the Frequency Generator App, your new best friend for snoozing like a baby and concentrating like a caffeine-fueled squirrel! Are you tossing and turning like a pancake at a brunch buffet, or do you find your attention span rivaling that of a goldfish? Fear not! 
This app is here to serenade your brain with soothing sounds and focus-enhancing tones, turning your chaotic mind into a zen garden of productivity. So, plug in, chill out, and prepare to conquer that to-do list like a boss!
Frequency Generator Features:
SLEEP MODE:
- Tired of counting sheep that have apparently gone on vacation? Enter Sleep Mode: your personal insomnia-busting ninja! 
- Select from a delightful buffet of brainwave frequencies like Delta and Theta to coax your mind into a deep slumber. (No sheep required.)
- Adjust your snooze fest with customizable settings for duration and volume—because even your sleep deserves a personalized touch!
FOCUS MODE:
- Want to channel your inner productivity wizard? Focus Mode is here to sprinkle some brain-boosting magic dust on your concentration!
- Tap into Alpha and Beta brainwave frequencies—science-approved enhancers of cognitive prowess. 
- Set timers that will keep you in the zone, ensuring that "procrastination" remains just a distant memory (or a Netflix binge for later).
BINAURAL BEATS:
- Get ready to groove with the Frequency Generator App! Our fancy binaural and isochronic beats will have your brain dancing to the rhythm of productivity.
- These beats are engineered for maximum effectiveness, so you'll be riding the wave of genius in no time!
User-Friendly Interface:
- Our sleek design is so intuitive, even your grandma could navigate it while knitting! 
- Quick-start options and presets mean you can dive right in—no PhD in frequency science required!
Offline Mode:
- No Wi-Fi? No worries! The Frequency Generator App is your trusty sidekick, ready to deliver your favorite frequencies wherever you roam. It’s like having a personal DJ in your pocket, minus the questionable dance moves!
SUBSCRIPTION AND TERMS
When you download the app you can opt into a 7-day free trial. Frequency Generator offers auto-renewing monthly/yearly/weekly subscription options for access to the app's features and content. Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term and payment will be charged through your iTunes account. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. To avoid renewal, you must cancel at least 24 hours before your subscription or trial ends. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.
Make the most of your downtime and supercharge your productivity with Frequency Generator App. Experience the power of brainwave synchronization and witness the transformative effects on your sleep and focus. 
Achieve better sleep, heightened focus, and an improved quality of life today.

bluejetty:00042443:ios.description:
AZOVA is the Collaborative Clinical Care Platform. Healthcare anywhere, anytime, for anyone.
For Patients:
1) The AZOVA mobile app allows patients to stay connected with all of their healthcare professionals in one single app. Schedule e-visits, in-office appointments and house calls. Securely message with all of your doctors, their staff and your family members who are involved in your care. Use your phone, tablet or computer to see any of your doctors, therapists, wellness professionals and more. Aggregate your medical records and your children's medical records and share them with any of your doctors---all from one web page.
2)Schedule a phone call, a face to face video visit, or send a PhotoForward visit or a Quick Question secure messaging visit online and complete your visits through the app. Now you can access healthcare seamlessly when, where and how you want to---all at a transparent price.
For Healthcare Professionals:
1) AZOVA integrates telemedicine, online self-scheduling for in-office visits and procedures, house calls, secure messaging and e-commerce all in one solution. Streamline your business, simplify your life, save lives and enjoy healthcare again. 
2) AZOVA is for all healthcare professionals: Medical, Mental Health, Wellness Professionals, Dentists, Veterinarians, Pharmacists, Laboratories, Imaging Centers and more. Each can build and launch a customized online clinic and offer customized services for any service line. Built for the largest of academic institutions down to the individual provider, we give you the tools to bring your business to the cloud with many new business opportunities. 
3) Create an online healthcare ecosystem when you and your colleagues across the country and across organizations join AZOVA. Now you can collaborate, coordinate care and make a true difference in the lives of your patients.
4) Offer your services as a cash, insurance or as a concierge medicine model. You decide what makes sense for your business, customize, and go live!
5) AZOVA is a turnkey business solution. If you have an amazing digital health business idea, now you can build it on AZOVA and launch your business in weeks rather than years. We are your partner is connected care, coordination of care, population health, telemedicine and patient engagement. Get started today.

bluejetty:00159545:ios.description:
Did you know that "working hard" is not as key as you may think to be productive and achieve success? The key.... is to work smarter, not harder. And one of the key elements to work smarter is to plan your work in advance and having a solid and reliable system to do it.
Created by a Certified Project Manager, Game Plan is the best time management and tasks scheduling app that will enable you to do exactly this, to work smarter, not harder. Have a big to-do list and does not know where to start? No problem! The Gameplan mobile app automatically gives you an optimized, integrated and customized plan for your week of productivity with the use of its state of the art GamePlan Assistive Engine.
Don't start your week without a Game Plan!
The core features of this amazing app include:
- Ease of use and self-intuitive, so you can quickly and effortlessly start using the app without having to learn a lot of complex stuff, which means an easier and smoother planning process.
- You can set-up reminders for your tasks, so you can rely on an external system to remind you of the important things, which means having the peace of mind that you will not drop the ball with an important appointment and/or task.
- You can organize all your tasks in different Tasks Lists or Projects, so you can have a much better visibility of all your priorities, which means you will feel more in control of all your work.
- Tasks prioritization features, so you can identify which tasks you need to tackle first, which means that you will have the certainty that you are doing the right things at the right time.
- The GamePlan Assistive Engine, with which the app prepares a plan for you with the touch of a button, based on your tasks, priorities and scheduled calendar events. This will allow you be quicker and more agile on the preparation of your workplans, which means you can do all your planning in half the time.
- Task completion tracking, so you don’t loose track of your tasks and make sure they get completed, which means that you will be able to complete everything you start, and won’t leave any loose ends.
- Integration with Calendars, so you can have your tasks, projects and calendar events all in one place, which means that you will have visibility and control of it all.
- Integration with Apple Watch, so you can have all these great benefits at the reach of your wrist, which means that you can review your pending tasks or capture and create new tasks on the go.
- Syncing across all your devices (iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch) so you can access your working plans and receive reminders from any device, which means you can review your plans anytime you want, anywhere you are, and be on top of your game.
The app includes tutorials and guidelines to enable you to have the best experience and get the most out of this amazing tool.
A subscription purchase is required to use the GamePlan App.
Subscriptions and Pricing:
Get started with a 3-day free trial!
- Monthly plan: $4.99 per month
- Yearly plan: $39.99 per year
- Lifetime plan: $99.99
For more information, you can visit us at our website gameplanmobileapp.com or contact our support team at support@gameplanmobileapp.com.
I wish you nothing but SUCCESS in everything you do.
Thanks!!

bluejetty:00118833:ios.description:
Your everyday business communication tools, all in one place. Easily call, video chat, message, meet and share whether you’re at a desk, on the move, or work from home. 
Bria lets you take communications anywhere, no matter what network or device you use it on. Bria is available across a variety of devices, including phones and desktop PCs, and easily works with your VoIP service or call server.
• Talk with high-quality voice calls. Make calls between Bria team members instantly*, or set up your call server or VoIP service to call mobile and landlines.
• Chat with people instantly by sending a quick message instead of an email.
• Start a chat room or grab a colleague's attention @ mentions.
• Meet face to face even if you're miles apart with HD video calling
• Share files, photos, videos and more from Bria and reduce swapping between apps to collaborate effectively and efficiently.
• Bring conversations to life with emoticons for chat
*Bria Teams includes unlimited voice and video calls between team members. Operator data charges may apply. We recommend using an unlimited data plan or WiFi connection.
Looking for support or troubleshooting help? Reach out and contact us at https://support.counterpath.com/
IMPORTANT NOTE
This version of Bria is tied to CounterPath Bria Solo and Bria Teams solutions and requires an account to log in. Without an account, the app will not work. Available features are dependent on your subscription. Please visit the CounterPath website for more information.
Emergency Calls
CounterPath's Bria mobile products provide handling designed to redirect emergency calls to the Native Cellular dialer when possible on a best reasonable commercial efforts basis, however this functionality is also dependent on the operating system of the mobile phone which is outside of our control and subject to change at any time. As a result, the official position of CounterPath is that CounterPath's Bria product is not intended, designed, or fit for placing, carrying or supporting Emergency Calls. CounterPath will not be liable for any costs or damages arising either directly nor indirectly from the use of the software for Emergency Calls. Using Bria as a default dialer may interfere with dialing emergency services.

 - Fourths

bluejetty:00017272:ios.description:
Discover entertaining stories, talented writers, and new worlds to explore.
Read original fictional stories across a variety of genres including comedy, horror, drama, romance, mystery, and more. Explore stories chapter by chapter, follow your favorite writers, or bring your own ideas to life by creating and publishing stories for the community.
Access to story content and creation tools is included with premium access.
• Explore a growing collection of original stories across multiple genres.
• Discover comedy, horror, drama, romance, mystery, and many other categories.
• Read stories chapter by chapter and discover new authors and creators.
• Create your own original stories and organize them into chapters.
• Personalize your stories with characters, images, videos, audio, and other creative elements.
• Save your stories and share your writing.
• Save your favorite stories and easily return to the stories you enjoy.
Not sure what kind of story you want to read today? Explore different categories and discover your next favorite story.
PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
A Text Story subscription is required to access premium content and features.
Subscription options may include:
• Weekly subscription – 3-day free trial, then $4.99 per week
• Monthly subscription – 3-day free trial, then $9.99 per month
• Annual subscription – 3-day free trial, then $49.99 per year
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the applicable subscription price.
Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal can be turned off from your Apple ID Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when a subscription is purchased, where applicable.

bluejetty:00095336:android.description:
🚂💥 Merge Battle Trains: Epic Idle War Adventure 💥🚂
Welcome to a 2D world where steel beasts ride the rails and rain fire upon their enemies! In this epic idle merge game, you are the commander of a powerful battle train. Assemble cars, merge weapons, and upgrade your armored convoy into an unstoppable force.
🔥 The war has begun. Are you ready to fight, shoot, and win?
🎮 GAMEPLAY THAT KEEPS YOU HOOKED
Tap, merge, and upgrade to build your train into a deadly shooter machine. Combine guns, turrets, and combat gear to increase firepower. Then roll your train down the railroad, blasting through waves of enemies and massive bosses in thrilling battles.
⚔️ Every part of your train matters — from the freight cars you load to the guns you place. Create the best strategy to survive longer and achieve higher scores.
🚀 TOP FEATURES
🔫 Merge combat units
Start with basic guns
Merge them to create stronger, more advanced firepower
Discover special and unique combinations to boost your train’s attack
🎯 Epic shooting action
Enjoy satisfying shooter gameplay in a fun, simplified 2D style
Feel the blast as you hit enemies, destroy tanks, and tear through waves
🏗️ Upgrade and build your base
Unlock new trains, weapons, and armor
Expand your railroad empire
Grow from a small station to a massive military base
💣 Nuclear explosions & boss fights
Face giant bosses and enemy tanks in intense battles
Use nuclear attacks and powerful guns to dominate
Keep your train simulator running at full speed to survive
🌎 Explore the global battlefield
Travel through deserts, cities, and icy lands
Visit new stations and train locations
Fight on different tracks and become the best rail commander
👥 PLAY SOLO OR WITH FRIENDS
Take on missions in single-player levels
Or connect with friends and partners to complete special objectives
Compare scores and see who commands the best battle train
🎁 DAILY REWARDS & BONUSES
Log in daily to collect free rewards
Open packs of weapons and gear
Earn currency and upgrade your army faster
🧠 A GAME OF STRATEGY AND SPEED
This isn’t just about tapping and watching explosions. You’ll need smart planning, fast reactions, and the ability to build a train that’s ready for any war. Think ahead, choose wisely, and control every shot fired from your guns.
Are you the commander this world needs?
🎖️ BECOME A MERGE MASTER
Crush enemies in the most awesome train simulator ever
Rise through levels and unlock giant battle engines
Command a growing army of steel and firepower
Rule the global battlefield and earn your place as a legend
💬 Whether you love idle games, shooting games, or unique merge experiences — this one brings it all on tracks. This is not just a game, it’s a thrilling adventure across rails where you create, learn, and destroy. No complex controls, just pure fun, explosive action, and strategic depth!
📦 Ready to take command?
🎮 Start building your dream train army and jump into this epic ride today! 🚄💣

bluejetty:00041557:ios.name: nRF Connect for Mobile
bluejetty:00041557:ios.summary:
nRF Connect is a powerful generic tool that allows you to scan and explore your Bluetooth Low Energy (henceforth Bluetooth LE, also called Bluetooth Version 4.0+ of the Bluetooth specification) devices and communicate with them.
nRF Connec
bluejetty:00041557:ios.description:
nRF Connect is a powerful generic tool that allows you to scan and explore your Bluetooth Low Energy (henceforth Bluetooth LE, also called Bluetooth Version 4.0+ of the Bluetooth specification) devices and communicate with them.
nRF Connect also allows your iOS device to advertise as a peripheral, with full support of many of Bluetooth SIG adopted profiles.
Additionally, nRF Connect supports Nordic Semiconductor’s Device Firmware Update profile (DFU) capabilities, allowing you to update compatible peripherals!
+ Features:
• Supports DFU on all Nordic Semiconducto-powered devices.
• Supports Nordic Thingy™ from Nordic Semiconductor.
• Scan and discover nearby Bluetooth LE peripherals.
• Filter Scanned Peripherals by Name, Manufacturer, Services (Advertised & Connected) and RSSI Level.
• Parsing Multiple Formats of Bluetooth LE Advertisement Data.
• Live RSSI Chart of Scanned Bluetooth LE Peripherals.
• Complete iPad Support, including Multi-Tasking and Mouse Support as of 13.4.
• Logs: Including BLE Function calls, and Export Function as CSV and Text.
• Privacy-Oriented: Full-Disclosure of Scanned Data, Advertised Data, and User-Performed Actions held by nRF Connect.
• Connecting to Any Connectable Bluetooth LE Smart Device.
• Discovery of Services, Characteristics and Descriptors.
• Read and Write Characteristics and Descriptors.
• Enable and Disable Notifications and Indications.
• Advertising as a Bluetooth LE Peripheral.
• Setting up a Bluetooth LE (Peripheral) Server and Notifying/Indicating back to connected Central(s).
• Low-Fat: nRF Connect for iOS is Very Small, so You Can Always Keep Us With You!
>= Requirements:
• iOS 16.0 and above.
- Notes:
nRF Connect also works with our Development Kits, which you may acquire online here:
https://www.nordicsemi.com/eng/buy-online

Math can be fun and easy! 99math offers a gamified practice that gets kids excited and keeps them motivated. Elevate your child's math skills and make learning enjoyable!
Designed for kids in grades 1 to 6, 99math is the ultimate math practice app that transforms learning into an engaging adventure.
WHY 99MATH?
INTERACTIVE LEARNING: Say goodbye to boring math drills! 99math provides over 1000+ math skills to practice, giving real-time feedback on progress and offering interactive learning.
CLASSROOM AND ASSIGNMENTS: Join your class, connect with your teacher, and complete assignments right from the app. 99math makes remote learning easy and enjoyable.
COLLECTIBLES AND REWARDS: Motivate your child to excel in math with stickers, cool avatars, and a customizable pet park. Children thrive as they earn rewards for their achievements.
SUITABLE FOR YOUR LEVEL: Designed for Grades 1-6 and tailored to kids of various math levels, 99math covers a wide range of math skills, from basic arithmetic to more advanced concepts.

Elevate your child's math skills, boost their confidence, and make learning enjoyable with 99math. Try it now and see the difference!

bluejetty:00160405:ios.name: Star Farm: Merge Tower Defense
bluejetty:00160405:ios.summary: You will play as a interstellar farmer, not only facing waves of alien insectoid invasions and building a strong defense system, but also dealing with various emergencies: mysterious alien UFOs will suddenly descend, deploying a large numbe
bluejetty:00160405:ios.description:
You will play as a interstellar farmer, not only facing waves of alien insectoid invasions and building a strong defense system, but also dealing with various emergencies: mysterious alien UFOs will suddenly descend, deploying a large number of mechanical spiders, posing a serious threat to your farm; even huge alien spaceships will crash in front of your farm, from which tens of thousands of alien creatures will pour out, their target being the farm's cows! You must go all out to protect these important livestock.
Use your wisdom and courage, combined with strategically merged turrets, powerful airships, and various special units, to resist all invaders and protect the precious star farm!
GAME FEATURES
- Strategic Merge, Build the Strongest Defense: Randomly purchase various types of turrets, and upgrade them into more powerful existences through a simple and fun merging system! Reasonably match different types of turrets to build an indestructible defense line to resist various types of enemies.
- Infinite Insectoid Swarms, Challenge the Limits of Strategy: Facing endless waves of alien insectoids, you need to constantly adjust your strategy and flexibly use various tactics to survive in the cruel battle. Each wave is a new challenge, testing your strategic layout and adaptability.
- Immersive Shooting: Switch to the first-person perspective, personally control turrets and powerful gunship, and experience the excitement of precise shooting! Feel the real feedback of bullets cutting through the air and hitting enemies, immersing yourself in the intense battle atmosphere.
- Stunning Visuals, Enjoy a Visual Feast: Tens of thousands of enemies surge on the same screen, combined with gorgeous weapon effects and explosions, presenting an epic sci-fi war scene, bringing you a shocking audio-visual experience.
- Combine Harvester: The brand new armed combine harvester makes a powerful debut! It is not only a good helper for harvesting crops, but also a mobile fortress on the battlefield! The giant harvesting roller at the front can easily crush any enemy who dares to block it, crushing the swarm like a hot knife through butter! Combined with a powerful shotgun turret, it allows you to be invincible on the battlefield and enjoy an unprecedented mowing experience!
- Gunship: Newly added powerful gunships, similar to the real-world AC-130, are equipped with a variety of powerful weapons, allowing you to easily cope with the threat of insectoids in the air and provide crucial close air support to your ground forces.
- Attack helicopter: Helicopter that can be piloted by yourself, equipped with powerful guided missiles, a large number of unguided rockets and an automatic machine gun.
CORE GAMEPLAY
- Merge Upgrade: Two turrets of the same level can be merged into a higher-level turret of the same type, greatly increasing attack power, range, and attack speed.
- First-Person Shooting: Enter the first-person perspective, freely control turrets and airships, accurately strike enemy weaknesses, and cause greater damage.
- Skill Support: Summon powerful air support, including fighter dive bombing, bomber carpet bombing, and airship machine gun fire suppression, instantly reversing the situation.
GAME EXPERIENCE
- Strategic Depth: Different enemies have different characteristics and weaknesses. You need to flexibly adjust the layout and upgrade route of the turrets according to the battlefield situation, and formulate effective tactics to achieve the final victory.
- Thrilling and Exciting: Personally control various powerful weapons,including the devastating firepower of the gunships, feel the baptism of bullets and artillery fire, experience a hearty and exciting battle experience, and fully enjoy the ultimate stress relief experience brought by eliminating massive enemies! Enjoy the glory of defending your home!

• 맞춤형 공간 '마이페이지'
서비스 이용 현황을 확인하고 배지를 모아 혜택도 받아보세요.
• 위젯으로 만나는 나만의 중앙일보
기기 홈화면에 위젯을 추가하고, 내 구독 뉴스와 관심 인사이트의 최신 소식을 빠르게 만나보세요.
• 광고없는 앱 경험
로그인하면 AD Free! 광고 없이 뉴스를 볼 수 있습니다.
• 강력해진 알림
속보는 물론 구독한 최신 콘텐트와 댓글 알림 등 개인화된 알림을 받아볼 수 있습니다.
• 콘텐트 이어읽기
앱에서 읽고 있던 콘텐트가 있다면, 바로 이어서 볼 수 있습니다.
[선택] 접근 권한
중앙일보 앱의 원활한 이용을 위해 아래 항목에 대한 권한 동의가 필요합니다. 
- 사진보관함 : 제보 및 게시판에 사진과 동영상을 첨부하기 위해 필요합니다. 
- 카메라 : 사진과 동영상을 촬영하고 첨부하기 위해 필요합니다.
- 마이크 : 동영상을 촬영하고 첨부하기 위해 필요합니다.
- 알림 : 속보 및 추천기사 등 알림 수신을 위해 필요합니다. 
(선택 접근 권한은 기능을 사용하는 시점에 동의를 받고 있으며, 권한을 허용하지 않아도 해당 기능 외 서비스는 이용이 가능합니다.)
[이용권 및 App Store 결제 주의사항]
- App Store 결제는 App Store 계정으로 진행됩니다.
- 결제되는 금액은 부가세 및 결제 수수료 포함 금액이며, Apple의 국가별 가격 정책에 따라 변경될 수 있습니다.
- App Store 자동결제는 App Store 내 [계정설정 > 구독]에서 해지하실 수 있습니다.
- 구독상품 종료 24시간 이내에 취소되지 않는 한 자동으로 갱신됩니다.
- 자동 결제 예정일 전 24시간 이내에 결제가 이루어지며, App Store 자동 결제 예정일과 실제 이용권 구매일/만료일 표기는 결제 시점 및 시차 등의 이유로 다르게 표기될 수 있습니다.
- 이용 약관 : https://www.joongang.co.kr/purchase/terms.html 
[선택] 입력 정보
결제 시 선택 상품에 따라 선택적으로 아래와 같이 정보를 요청 할 수 있습니다.
- 주소 : 구독 정보 확인을 위해 필요합니다.
(선택 정보는 결제 정보 입력 시 요청을 할 수 있으며, 정보를 입력하지 않아도 상품 결제와 서비스 이용에는 문제가 없습니다.)

bluejetty:00180256:ios.description:
Outdoorsy is the best way to discover and book your next RV adventure vacation or roadtrip. Feel the freedom and fresh air of the open road, and unlock new experiences. 
Whether you’re looking for a quick staycation, cross country road-trip, tailgating or music-festival adventure, we’ve got you covered. Outdoorsy is the #1 fastest growing and most trusted peer-to-peer RV rental marketplace where you can rent the coolest RVs, camper vans, and adventure vehicles. 
Why book with us? 
RENT COOL RIGS & HIT THE ROAD
* Browse thousands of RVs by location, amenities, or owners across the U.S., Canada, Australia and UK 
* Search by travel dates, vehicle type, sleeping capacity, cost, and location 
* Filter by dog friendly, kid friendly, or experience level 
* Save your favorites to book down the road 
* Read trusted reviews from real renters 
TRAVEL LIKE A PRO
* Rent RVs personally cared for by their owners that suit a variety of tastes and needs 
* Vehicles typically come with basic gear, like coffee pots, and you can often purchase enhancements like kayaks or bikes
* Access to city guides and RV usage education 
* View your itinerary for upcoming trips 
BOOK INSTANTLY & SAFELY
* Message and connect with the owner before you book 
* Review travel plans and coordinate a key exchange 
* Up to $500,000 in liability insurance
* 24/7 technical support & roadside assistance 
* Trusted community of 93% average 4+-star customer reviews 
* Secure online payments 
* Real people, live customer support team  
* Trust and safety experts 
MAKE YOUR BEST MEMORIES
* Explore all the places on your bucket list or unlock new experiences 
* Swap the four walls of a hotel for the fresh air of the open road or the blaring noise of a TV for the crackling sound of a campfire 
* Make memories with friends and family by renting more than one vehicle and caravan 
SAVE MONEY 
* RVing is a cost-effective way to see the country    
SUPPORT
Real people. Here to help. Email us at support@outdoorsy.com, call us at 1.877.723.7232 or visit www.outdoorsy.com
SEE HOW FUN IT IS
Follow us on Instagram @outdoorsy, Facebook, and Twitter: @outdoorsy

bluejetty:00086446:ios.description:
Professionalize your business to attract more customers with Agenda Boa!
Convenience and agility with amazing features that help your business grow. Discover Agenda Boa, the ultimate management tool. Download the app and impress your customers even more!
◉ FEATURES:
• Generate service orders, quotes, and other PDF documents
Create the document (PDF) and send it to your customer via WhatsApp, WhatsApp Business, or email!
• Issue receipts for customers
Made a sale? Then issue a receipt in the app to send to the customer.
• Register customers
Everything is saved in the cloud. If you lose your phone, your customers will still be saved in your Agenda Boa account.
• Note and manage orders and sales
By noting and managing orders, you can, for example, know which quotes are awaiting customer approval.
• Catalogs of services and products
Save your services and products with photos in the app. It's much more practical to generate quotes and service orders!
• Control your business finances
Record costs, receipts, amounts receivable, overdue amounts, and expenses. Know how much and when each customer needs to pay you and track the monthly results.
• Schedule appointments
Use the calendar feature to organize your business appointments in the app and never miss an appointment with any customer.
◉ EXTRA FEATURES IN THE PRO VERSION
• Use the web version
• Add your logo
• Create standardized texts
• Your signatures on documents
• Duplicate orders, services, and products
• And much more!
◉ EXTRA FEATURES IN THE TOP VERSION
• All features in the Pro version
• Collect customer signatures
• Generate contracts
• Add exclusive details to documents
◉ FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
• Do I have to pay to use it?
We have a Free plan with almost all the features, designed to help those who are just starting.
• Do I need to have a CNPJ to use Agenda Boa?
No, you don’t. You can be a MEI, self-employed (individual), have a company, or a small business. Agenda Boa has several features to facilitate the management of your business!

Looking for our Police or Government Auctions?
If you are looking for our listing of Police and Government auctions it is currently only available on our website. Right now the app only has our No Reserve Auctions. Police Auctions is not affiliated with any Local, State or Federal Governments.
PoliceAuctions.com is now available as the Police Auctions app! All of our auctions are no reserve auctions, and bidding is free! Our no reserve auctions are wholesale liquidation non-government auctions.
Why Use Police Auctions?
 * We’ve Been in Business Since 2001
 * 100% Satisfaction Guaranteed
 * Easy Returns
 * Over 40,000 Testimonials
 * Over 1,000,000 Facebook Followers
The Police Auctions app is perfect for bidders on the go, bidders who are serious about winning, and all mobile users who love auctions. New auctions go up daily, so never miss out on new items with our app. You could win certified diamonds, home electronics, collectibles, and more!
The Police Auctions app is designed with the bidder in mind. Now, you can bid anytime from anywhere! Never miss out on a certified diamond or rare collectible again. With the Police Auctions app, bidding is as easy as the push of a button.
Why use the Police Auctions app?
PoliceAuctions.com is the auction site with real items and real bidding. Joining and using the app is totally free! Never worry about bidding charges, credits, or hidden fees again. When you win on Police Auctions, that’s the price you pay (plus shipping and any applicable tax). Choose your price on all of your favorite items. With no reserve, none of our items have to go for a certain price. All of our items go to the highest bidder, no matter how low the price. You could win certified diamond jewelry, rare collectibles, coins, home electronics, and more.
Tap into our unique features and win big with the Police Auctions app! Connect your Facebook for easy one-click login, add items to your watchlist, view our special Daily Deals, bid with just one button, and more. With our app, you’ll always be in the know.
Police Auctions is not affiliated with any Local, State or Federal Governments.

bluejetty:00150042:ios.summary:
► SOLVE PUZZLES AND BUILD YOUR BUSINESS

bluejetty:00150042:ios.description:
► SOLVE PUZZLES AND BUILD YOUR BUSINESS
Join adorably coiffed Merchant Mike and his cute corgi Milo as the pair struggle to make their way in business. Master increasingly difficult matching puzzles to earn coins and gems, then spend them on expanding and upgrading Mike’s business ventures. Start by selling street food in the park, build your own little fun fair, then move on to food truck and gift shop empires in this colorful and entertaining triple-tile match game with added entrepreneurial flare.
► INGENIOUS AND ENTERPRISING
• The perfect match: Master hundreds of levels of unique matching puzzles. Can you keep making triple matches from the pile without blocking your board? It gets harder as the levels progress, and each level consists of three unique stages that you’ll need to complete to get your rewards.
• The perks of doing business: Before each stage, choose from three free perks, which are either boosters to help you match tiles and complete the stage – including extra lives, boomerangs that undo your last move, and dice to shuffle all tiles – or extra gems and coins to add to your rewards at the end of the level. You can also choose the Feeling Lucky perk, which can give you regular rewards, special premium rewards, or even negative rewards – are you ready to make a risky investment?
• See it through to the end: The perks go into your backpack for safe keeping until you need them, or you complete the level. Rewards accumulate over the three stages of each level but watch out: if you lose a stage then all the contents of your backpack are gone!
• Invest in success: Take your rewards from completing levels and spend them to build Mike’s little business empire. Each location in the game has 15 different items to unlock for gems, and each item has three colorful upgrades, one of which is available for gems, the second for coins, and the third for completing special challenge levels. Upgrade all items to at least one-star level to unlock the next delightful location, then follow Mike and Milo to the next chapter in their entrepreneurial adventure.
• Very important player: Buy a VIP pass to get unique additional perks in the game, including the magnifying glass, which lets you see behind the Feeling Lucky perk, so you know what you’re getting yourself into.
► MATCH TILES TO MAKE IT BIG
Looking for a new puzzle challenge that’s easy to play, hard enough to keep you engaged, and set in fun, colorful world that you’ll want to explore further? Join the adorable entrepreneurial pair of Mike and Milo and play triple matching puzzles to help them build their business empire and bring joy to the community. Download Merchant Mike now and become a master of the puzzle business!
Subscription Terms:
VIP MEMBERSHIP Access offers a weekly subscription. After buying this subscription you will be charged $4.99/week.
You will unlock the following features: exclusive perks, free 10 coins daily, and free 5 spy glasses daily.
This is an Auto-renewable subscription. The payment is charged to your account after confirmation. The subscription is renewed unless you turn it off 24 hours before the period ends.
VIP features will work only with an internet connection. Your account will be charged for renewal as well.
Subscription renewal:
• The payment is charged to your account after a confirmation of purchase.
• The subscription is renewed unless you turn it off 24 hour before the end of the current period.
• The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period at the cost of the weekly subscription.
• The user may manage the subscription and auto-renewal have to be turned off by going to the user’s account settings after purchase in the Store.
• No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00062490:ios.name: My Town : Beauty Contest
bluejetty:00062490:ios.summary: Calling all aspiring stylists and fashionistas! If you and your child love fashion, design and hair My Town : Beauty Contest is the perfect app for you. There are six different locations to explore as you get your favorite character ready t
bluejetty:00062490:ios.description:
Calling all aspiring stylists and fashionistas! If you and your child love fashion, design and hair My Town : Beauty Contest is the perfect app for you. There are six different locations to explore as you get your favorite character ready to compete. 
In the main show room, you design the show! No beauty contest is complete without a stage and you can choose from over 400 items to design the perfect backdrop. Once the stage is set, it’s time to visit the flower shop to customize over 60 different floral décor options. You then can even choose the music to be played during the show!
Once the stage is set, have your contestant begin their spa day in the My Town hair salon so they can get their hair done by the leading hair stylist in the industry. So many hair styles to choose from! After hair comes makeup! Our My Town makeup artists are ready to treat you to facial treatments so your makeup will look flawless. 
It’s almost show time, but first you have to visit the clothing store, so your contestant can pick out their contest winning outfit from over 50 choices. 
Can’t get onto the cover of the My Town magazine without having a photoshoot! Select from a myriad of backgrounds, then choose your magazine cover and print out a poster for your contestant. Don’t forget to hang the posters all over to promote your winner!
FEATURES
*14 characters to choose from, including: contestants, store keeps, stage managers and more! 
*6 locations to explore including a closet, makeup room, hair salon, flower shop and stage.
If you can imagine it, you can make it. Everything is possible in My Town : Beauty Contest!
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room. 
TELL US WHAT YOU THINK!
 You can easily contact with us on Facebook or Twitter at any time to let us know what you would like changed or added. Maybe you’ve come up with a new My Town game all on your own – let us know! We promise to read all messages and reply. We love to hear YOUR ideas, so please connect with us! 
Facebook – https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
 Twitter – https://twitter.com/mytowngames
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com

bluejetty:00175166:ios.description:
The MSC for Me app enhances your cruise experience by connecting seamlessly with 
onboard digital services, giving you everything you need right at your fingertips. 
It’s free to use, and once on board, no internet package is required to access its features. 
BEFORE YOUR CRUISE 
Start planning your experience before you even step on board. 
Complete your online check-in in just a few steps and download your boarding pass. 
Take your required security photo before embarkation. 
Select your preferred arrival time at the terminal. 
Be Ready to Sail 
Link your credit card to your Cruise Card in advance and start using onboard services 
immediately upon boarding. 
Plan Ahead & Save 
Take advantage of pre-cruise rates and savings and book shore excursions, spa treatments, 
specialty dining, beverage and internet packages. 
Browse specialty restaurant menus and reserve your preferred time. 
Discover Your Cruise 
Explore onboard activities, events, and services. 
Manage all your bookings with a single MSC account. 
ONBOARD FEATURES 
Enjoy a smooth, stress-free cruise with everything under control. 
Discover the MSC Concierge (AI-powered), your digital assistant available 24/7 in 70+ 
languages. 
Book dining and activities. 
Get personalized recommendations. 
Check your account and onboard activities. 
Digital Cruise Card 
Pay for onboard services as soon as you step on board (no need for the physical card). 
Stay Updated 
Reserve shows, activities, and excursions. 
Receive real-time notifications for your bookings and key events.
MSC - Internal 
Internet Management: Purchase the package that fits your needs, track and manage your 
usage directly in the app. 
Track Your Expenses 
Monitor your onboard spending in real time. 
Link guests to your account. 
Download your final financial statement.

bluejetty:00087735:ios.name: Sleepy Stories
bluejetty:00087735:ios.summary:

Sleepy Stories is a treasure trove of values-based, beloved bedtime stories and
bluejetty:00087735:ios.description:
Packed with bedtime stories, musical playlists, lullabies, and even kids yoga, Sleepy Stories makes bedtimes nothing short of magical.
What Is Sleepy Stories?
Sleepy Stories is a treasure trove of values-based, beloved bedtime stories and songs to make bedtimes fun! Some stories are specifically designed to bring sleep quickly, while others provide cozy, bedtime listening for magical nights. Benefits of nighttime listening include:
- Reduced stress and anxiety (for both kids AND parents!)
- Shorter time needed to fall asleep
- Imaginative listening instead of more screen time
- Introduction to wonderful works of literature and music
- Reaffirmed values like honesty, courage, hard work, and more
The Stories
Written by award-winning authors, therapists, and others, our stories are the heart of the app. Some stories, like "The Land of the Sleeps" and "Annabella's Dream Pillow," are designed to help kids fall asleep quickly. The lilting ocean waves, enchanting music, and soft voice help children gradually drift off to sleep, and the extra music played at the end of each story transition kids into deep sleep when the story is over.
Other stories provide cozy, entertaining bedtime listening. Snuggle into the covers and enjoy classic favorites like "The Velveteen Rabbit," "Alice's Adventures in Wonderland," "The Wonderful Wizard of Oz," and "Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves." A wonderful way to ditch the screens and the videos and enjoy classic kids literature instead!
Or, visit the Learning Tower for stories that teach you while you fall asleep! Discover how birds fly, how bees make honey, the lives of famous composers and artists, and other wonderful, eye-opening explorations of the world around us. 
The Music
If you don't feel like stories tonight, we also have a library of beautiful relaxing music. Enjoy lullabies, Celtic tunes, and of course, classical favorites.

bluejetty:00061725:ios.summary:
Get all the benefits of SurveyMonkey no matter where you are—no internet required.
The SurveyMonkey Anywhere mobile app lets you quickly and securely collect data even when you don’t have an internet connection. Use it for field surveys at
bluejetty:00061725:ios.description:
Get all the benefits of SurveyMonkey no matter where you are—no internet required.
The SurveyMonkey Anywhere mobile app lets you quickly and securely collect data even when you don’t have an internet connection. Use it for field surveys at trade shows, conferences, in retail stores, or even on the street—anywhere your audience is. And with the app, any mobile device becomes a survey station.
Run surveys in Kiosk Mode
Turn a mobile device into a survey station. With SurveyMonkey Anywhere, you can create a mobile-friendly survey experience capturing leads at trade shows, gathering customer feedback on location, or from shoppers at the point of service.
• Lock down your device and put your survey on auto-pilot
• Go from completed survey to start page automatically and securely
• Surveys display full screen—no toolbars, menus, or other browser interface
Conduct field surveys anywhere
Stop worrying about having a strong internet connection to conduct valuable face-to-face field surveys. Download your survey to your smartphone or tablet and take it wherever you need to collect feedback.
• Gather in-person evaluations after a training session
• Survey shoppers at a retail location
• Conduct field surveys at a national park
• Do market research in the wild
SurveyMonkey is trusted by more than 60 million users, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Power your curiosity with SurveyMonkey Anywhere - wherever, whenever, however. The SurveyMonkey Anywhere app is free to download and use. Kiosk Mode is available to all SurveyMonkey users for free. Paid users get access to even more powerful features such as the auto-restart timer and passcodes for kiosk surveys. Offline Mode is only available for the paid Enterprise plan at this time.

bluejetty:00062103:ios.name: CopyIt The Grid Drawing Method
bluejetty:00062103:ios.summary: First released in 2010, CopyIt is the original and most feature‑rich grid drawing app. Trusted by artists, teachers, and students worldwide, CopyIt brings the centuries‑old grid drawing technique into the digital age, making it easier than
bluejetty:00062103:ios.description:
First released in 2010, CopyIt is the original and most feature‑rich grid drawing app. Trusted by artists, teachers, and students worldwide, CopyIt brings the centuries‑old grid drawing technique into the digital age, making it easier than ever to copy, enlarge, or reduce reference images with precision.
Why CopyIt?
The grid method, used by masters like Leonardo da Vinci, breaks images into manageable sections so you can focus on lines and shapes square by square. CopyIt eliminates the need to print and mark up photos, offering zoom, filters, and digital tools that enhance accuracy and detail. Whether you’re a beginner or experienced artist, CopyIt helps you achieve results with confidence.
Key Features
• Universal App: Works on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Silicon Macs
• Flexible Grids: 6 grid types, customisable rows/columns, adjustable colors, transparency, and guidelines
• Smart Tools: SmartMove zoom, Target mode, digital ruler, perspective lines, Crosshair, MixMap and TubeMatch™ for colour matching
• Filters & Effects: Pencil Sketch, Onion Skin overlay, flips, rotations, and multiple image aspects
• Import & Export: Capture with front/back cameras, load projects or albums, save and share via AirDrop, email, or social platforms
• Customization: Portrait/landscape orientation, fullscreen mode, adjustable zoom (x1–x20), media sizes in imperial/metric
• Support: In‑app help and a new tutorial
Designed for Success
CopyIt transforms the traditional grid method into a modern workflow tool. By working square by square, you can scale images accurately, refine details, and build confidence in your drawing skills.
Connect with us:
• Facebook: facebook.com/CopyItTheGridDrawingMethod
Terms of Use:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00115468:ios.name: Merge Coins - Relax Sort Game
bluejetty:00115468:ios.summary: Welcome to Merge Coins, a fun and addictive puzzle game that combines strategy and relaxation! Sort coins by color and number to merge them into higher denominations. Inspired by water sort puzzles, this game challenges your logic and decis
bluejetty:00115468:ios.description:
Welcome to Merge Coins, a fun and addictive puzzle game that combines strategy and relaxation! Sort coins by color and number to merge them into higher denominations. Inspired by water sort puzzles, this game challenges your logic and decision-making skills. 
Enjoy vibrant visuals and intuitive gameplay that make sorting coins both satisfying and relaxing. With no time limits and free-to-play mechanics, Merge Coins is the perfect way to unwind and train your brain. Start your sorting journey today and discover the joy of merging coins!
Game Features: 
- Addictive Gameplay: Merge coins by color and number in this relaxing and rewarding puzzle experience!
- Colorful Challenges: Explore vibrant visuals and intuitive controls that make sorting coins enjoyable for all ages.
- Brain-Boosting Fun: Solve strategic puzzles that challenge your logic and help you relax at the same time.
- Play Anytime, Anywhere: This free game works offline, so you can enjoy sorting coins wherever you are!
- Endless Levels & Rewards: Unlock achievements and progress through hundreds of unique sorting challenges!
How to Play Merge Coins
1. Tap Deal to fill empty slots with coins of random numbers.
2. Sort coins by matching their number and color. Coins can only move if the target slot has enough space and the top coin matches the number.
3. Combine 10 coins of the same number to create 2 coins of a higher denomination using the Merge button.
4. Use Shuffle to refresh the board when you’re stuck—no penalties, no limits!
5. Solve puzzles by merging coins until you reach the highest denomination to win the level!
Why Play Merge Coins?
1. Sharpen Your Mind: Sorting coins by number and color enhances your problem-solving and strategic thinking skills. This addictive puzzle game is perfect for brain training!
2. Relax & Unwind: Merge Coins offers a stress-free environment to enjoy soothing gameplay and colorful visuals.
3. Skill Development: Improve your color recognition and sorting abilities while mastering coin merging techniques.
4. Free Fun Anytime: Play this free game offline—no limits, no failures, just pure sorting fun!
Start your puzzle adventure today and experience the ultimate combination of fun, relaxation, and mental stimulation! 
Contact us: support@easyplay.ai
Our website: https://www.easyplay.ai/

bluejetty:00174725:ios.description:
Never let the weather catch you by surprise again. The trusted weather experts at KELOLAND Live Doppler HD deliver South Dakota, Western Minnesota, Northwest Iowa, Northern Nebraska's most accurate hour-by-hour forecast for the next day and for the week ahead. Unlike other weather apps, you'll get a local forecast that is customized for you.
Download the KELOLAND Storm Tracker app for fast, accurate local and national weather at your fingertips. With its personal alert notifications, you'll know when significant weather is heading your way and when to take cover. And when you are traveling, use KELOLAND Storm Tracker to get real-time weather forecasts, interactive radar and current conditions for anywhere in the U.S.
The KELOLAND Storm Tracker app utilizes the most advanced radar maps, weather and digital technology available. With its easy to use interactive radar, you can take control and see where the storm is now and where it is tracking. Then, set customized alerts to keep you and your family informed and safe.
Features:
- Live interactive radar with many layering options lets you track the storms around you
- Alerts for severe weather go to your home screen and cue an audio alert
- The most accurate hour-by-hour forecast for the next day and week ahead for South Dakota, Western Minnesota, Northwest Iowa, Northern Nebraska
- The latest video forecast from KELOLAND Live Doppler HD
- Current weather conditions for South Dakota, Western Minnesota, Northwest Iowa, Northern Nebraska and anywhere in the United States
- Share the weather conditions via text message, email, Facebook or Twitter
- You can set multiple custom locations to track forecasts, alerts, radar, and more
- News and weather headlines from KELOLAND TV

bluejetty:00173981:ios.name: The Mindfulness App
bluejetty:00173981:ios.summary:
With over 500 guided meditations, sleep stories and courses from experts around the world, we have options for every mood, time of the day and for everyone from beginners to experienced.
• Guided meditations and courses of different topics
bluejetty:00173981:ios.description:
With over 500 guided meditations, sleep stories and courses from experts around the world, we have options for every mood, time of the day and for everyone from beginners to experienced.
• Guided meditations and courses of different topics in over 10 different languages.
• Sleep Stories for a gentle closing of the day.
• Reminders to help you remember to meditate. 
• Daily Notices to keep you mindful throughout the day.
• Personalized user statistics.
• The Mindfulness App saves your meditation sessions to your Apple Health App.
• Apple Watch Integration.
If you find that you enjoy a silent meditation, or simply want to include a personalized meditation into your practice, you can pick and choose between:
• 3-99 minute meditations. 
• Option of silent or guided.
• Inclusion of bells and a guided introduction. 
• Different background sounds such as forest, rain, waves and more.
• Possibility to save your favorites for quick access. 
As a new user, you have the option to take advantage of our Free Trial that allows you to test the app and access all premium content for a full seven days.
Included in our Premium Subscription:
• Unlimited access to all meditations and courses in over 20 different topics. 
• Make meditations and course sessions available offline.
• Regularly updated content allows you to discover new favorite meditations and teachers.
For those that wish to have access to our premium version, we offer auto-renewable subscription:
• $79.99 per year
These prices are for US customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
We’re here to help you find what meets your needs and make meditation work for your daily life to improve your inner well-being. 
We want to be a part of your mindfulness journey, making it possible to meditate wherever you may be!
Read the terms and conditions here:
https://themindfulnessapp.com/terms-of-service
Read the privacy policy here:
https://themindfulnessapp.com/privacy-policy
