bluejetty:00073444:ios.name: Sygic: GPS Navigation, 3D Maps
bluejetty:00073444:ios.summary: Sygic GPS Navigation & Maps is innovative GPS navigation app with monthly-updated offline maps and with precise live traffic & speed camera alerts, both updated in real-time. It‘s trusted by more than 200 million drivers worldwide. Offline
bluejetty:00073444:ios.description:
Sygic GPS Navigation & Maps is innovative GPS navigation app with monthly-updated offline maps and with precise live traffic & speed camera alerts, both updated in real-time. It‘s trusted by more than 200 million drivers worldwide. Offline 3D maps are stored on your phone for GPS navigation without an internet connection. We update the maps multiple times per year for free, so that you can always rely on Sygic GPS Navigation.
NAVIGATE ANYWHERE, EVEN WITHOUT AN INTERNET CONNECTION
• 3D Offline maps of all countries in the world, from TomTom and other providers
• Free map updates multiple times per year
• Voice-guided GPS navigation with precise directions and spoken street names
• Millions of interesting Places (POI)
• Pedestrian GPS navigation with walking directions and tourist attractions (POI)
• Customize your navigation arrow. Try everyday car, van or even formula.
ESCAPE THE TRAFFIC
• Avoid traffic jams with the most accurate real-time traffic information with data collected from more than 200 million users worldwide*
STAY SAFE
• Advanced safety features make driving in unfamiliar territories easier
• Speed limit warnings show you the current speed limit and the upcoming speed limit changes
• Dynamic Lane Assistant guides you into the correct lane
• Head-up Display (HUD) projects navigation onto the windshield of your car, making driving at night safer
• Dashcam records the road ahead and automatically saves a video in case of an accident
• Real View Navigation is an augmented reality feature for even better and safer driving experience
• Real-time route sharing lets you share your estimated time of arrival & current position on a map*
• Compatible with CarPlay - all navigation features on your car’s built-in display.
• Cockpit shows you the real-time performance of your car. 
• Wrong-way warning (in partnership with Bosch)**. If you are driving in the wrong way or someone is driving in the opposite direction, we will warn you.*
MOTORBIKE MODE
Switch to a professional motorbike navigation profile built for two wheels:
• Twisty Routing: Skip highways for the best curves and hills.
• Glove-friendly UI: Large buttons and high contrast for easy use.
• Lean & Elevation: Real-time side tilt and route altitude tracking.
• Safety Alerts: Glowing screen edges for speed limits and hazards.
• Offline Maps: Reliable motorbike GPS without mobile signal.
SAVE MONEY ALONG YOUR ROUTE
• Park easily with parking place suggestions and live info about prices and availability*
• Set your fuel type and fill up for the best price with live information about fuel prices*
• Avoid speeding tickets with Speed camera warnings*
• Save money on roaming charges with offline maps
Try Premium+ for free! Free trial of all Premium+ features is available in the app.
Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will not be able to cancel the subscription once activated. Manage your subscriptions in Account Settings after purchase.
Questions? Visit sygic.com/support. We’re here 7 days a week. 
Love Sygic? Rate us or spread the word at sygic.com/love.
*Requires internet connection. 
Feature glossary: sygic.com/what-is 
Privacy Policy: www.sygic.com/company/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: www.sygic.com/company/terms-of-use
Note: Sharing videos from Dashcam is forbidden by law in these countries: Austria, Belgium, Luxembourg, Switzerland, Slovakia, Spain.
Note 2: Dashcam, Traffic Sign Recognition, and Real View are part of the new feature SmartCam. SmartCam merge all camera features into one. The SmartCam is a part of our Premium+ subscription.
By installing, copying or using all or any portion of this software you accept all the terms and conditions of this agreement: https://www.sygic.com/company/eula

bluejetty:00131298:ios.name: Partiful: Party Invite Maker
bluejetty:00131298:ios.summary:
The easiest way to plan and discover social events. Create free event invite pages, send text updates, sell tickets, and find the best events near you.
ACTUALLY FUN EVENT PAGES
- Create pages for any event — birthdays, pregames, dinners, g
bluejetty:00131298:ios.description:
The easiest way to plan and discover social events. Create free event invite pages, send text updates, sell tickets, and find the best events near you.
ACTUALLY FUN EVENT PAGES
- Create pages for any event — birthdays, pregames, dinners, game nights, watch parties, group trips, bachelor/bachelorettes, weddings, and more
- Make it aesthetic with page themes, effects, and event posters—or upload your own
- Guests can see who else is going and add comments, GIFs, and photos to the page
INVITE FRIENDS ON ANY PLATFORM (not just iPhones)
- Customize your RSVP settings for all types of events, public or private
- Invite anyone with a link — guests don't need the app! One link works for both Apple and Non-Apple users, and you can track RSVPs in real time.
- Re-use your guest lists, and invite people you meet at other Partiful parties
SHARE UPDATES AND PHOTOS
- Text Blast your guests with important updates
- Post comments on the page that guests can react and reply to
- Upload pics to a Shared Photo Album, and collect photos from guests
FIND EVENTS & THINGS TO DO NEAR YOU
- Find events happening near you on the Explore page
- Explore community events, live music, art shows, food festivals, local markets, classes, workshops, and more near you.
- Discover social events your friends and mutuals are attending
- RSVP "interested" to save events for later
- Stay in the loop on trending events in your city
HOST PUBLIC EVENTS
- Create public events people can discover, join, and RSVP to
- Reach local audiences and attract new attendees
- Free exposure on a public event marketplace
- Grow a following of repeat guests & community members
- For event hosts, organizers, clubs, groups, nightlife & creators
SELL TICKETS
- Sell tickets and collect payments for any Partiful event
- Add free or paid tickets with multiple tiers, capacity limits, and promo codes
- Guests checkout quickly using Apple Pay, credit, or debit
- Check in guests easily with QR code scanning right from your phone
- Sales, guest list, and payouts tracked in one place
- Direct bank payouts after the event via Stripe
FIND A TIME THAT WORKS FOR EVERYONE
- Not sure who's free? Poll your guests before selecting a final date
- Guests can RSVP to multiple options, and you pick what works best
- Everyone's RSVP is automatically updated once you pick a date
BE TYPE-A ABOUT IT
- Drop your Venmo or CashApp for guests to chip in
- Limit spots available, we'll handle the waitlist
- Add a questionnaire for dietary restrictions, location preferences, and more
OR BE CHILL
- Create a simple page in seconds (literally)
- Leave date & time TBD, figure out details later
- Keep it casual with designs for board game nights, dinners, and date night
KEEP TRACK OF YOUR SOCIAL LIFE
- View events you're planning and attending in one place
- Auto-add all Partiful events to your Google, Apple, or Outlook calendar
- Check the guest lists to see who's coming
- Discover Open Invite events hosted by your Mutuals
ORGANIZER PROFILES
- Showcase all your events with a single shareable link
- Easily re-invite past guests and grow a community that keeps showing up
- Work with co-admins to create and manage events
PARTY PROFILES
- Add a bio, profile photo, and your socials
- Show off how many events you've hosted and attended
- Keep track of your Mutuals (the people you've partied with)
SEND FREE ONLINE GREETING CARDS
- Takes two seconds, looks like you tried
- Create personalized digital greeting cards & ecards with your photos, or choose a fun poster
- Share with one link that works anywhere: text, email, or DMs
- Perfect for birthday, thank you, Christmas, save the date, wedding, love, thinking of you, get well soon cards & more
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://partiful.com/privacy

Embark on a journey like no other, where pixelated worlds come to life, and hidden treasures await your discovery. Pixerio is more than just a game; it's an exper
bluejetty:00150781:ios.description:
Welcome to Pixerio - Where Pixel Art Meets the Thrill of Hidden Object Games!
Embark on a journey like no other, where pixelated worlds come to life, and hidden treasures await your discovery. Pixerio is more than just a game; it's an experience that offers a multitude of advantages:

bluejetty:00139092:ios.description:
NetShort – Watch Short Dramas in Minutes
Looking for a quick story that is easy to start? NetShort brings vertical short dramas to your phone, with romance, secrets, emotional twists, fantasy plots, revenge stories, and suspenseful moments made for mobile viewing.
Each episode is short, fast-paced, and simple to enjoy during a break, commute, trip, or relaxing evening. Watch one episode when you have a few minutes, or continue a series when you want a longer drama session.
■ Stories That Start Quickly
NetShort is designed for viewers who enjoy short-form drama without a long setup. Episodes focus on key story moments such as confessions, reunions, hidden identities, family secrets, second chances, and unexpected turns.
■ Explore popular short drama themes, including:
- Billionaire romance and CEO love stories
- Werewolf bonds and supernatural romance
- Revenge, comeback, and family secret stories
- Fantasy, time travel, rebirth, and second chances
- Mystery, crime, suspense, and hidden identities
- Sweet love, heartbreak, and emotional drama
■ Find a Series for Your Mood
Whether you want a romantic story, a fantasy twist, a revenge comeback, or a mystery with suspense, NetShort helps you discover short series that match what you like.
You can browse trending titles, follow series you enjoy, continue watching from where you left off, and receive updates when new episodes are available.
■ Made for Mobile Watching
NetShort makes short dramas easy to watch on your phone:
- Vertical episodes made for phone screens
- Short episodes that fit busy schedules
- HD playback for clearer viewing
- Offline downloads for supported content
- Watch history and saved favorites
- Playback controls for your preferred pace
- Smart filters to help you find stories faster
■ Fresh Episodes and Easy Discovery
NetShort regularly updates its drama library with new episodes and series. Personalized recommendations help you discover romance, fantasy, revenge, mystery, suspense, and other short dramas based on your viewing interests.
■ VIP Access
Some content and features may require VIP access or in-app purchases. VIP members can enjoy benefits such as:
- Ad-free viewing where available
- HD playback for supported episodes
- Offline downloads for supported content
- Access to more episodes in selected series
■ Why Try NetShort?
NetShort is made for viewers who like compact stories with clear emotions, quick pacing, and mobile-first viewing. From romantic turns to fantasy surprises and revenge-driven plots, each series is built to deliver drama in a short amount of time.
If you enjoy short dramas, vertical series, mini dramas, romance stories, fantasy plots, revenge stories, mystery thrillers, or suspenseful cliffhangers, NetShort is ready whenever you want to watch.
Download NetShort and start watching short dramas on your phone.
Notice
If you subscribe via Apple, payment will be charged to your App Store account upon purchase confirmation.
Your subscription will take effect within 24 hours after purchase, depending on your order status in the App Store.
Within the 24 hours before your current subscription expires, your account will be charged for renewal based on the price of your selected plan. Upon successful renewal, your subscription period will be automatically extended.
You can cancel your subscription by going to: Settings > iTunes & App Store > Apple ID > View Apple ID > Subscriptions > NetShort.
If you do not cancel your subscription at least 24 hours before your current subscription expires, it will automatically renew.

bluejetty:00027535:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00027535:ios.description:
Discover the Good News Bible (GNB), a Simple English Bible Translation.
Looking for a clear Bible translation, an easy-to-read Bible, or a modern English Bible? The Good News Bible (GNB) makes Scripture simple and understandable for everyone—from Bible beginners and youth readers to church study groups and daily devotional readers.
Unlike traditional versions with complex or outdated language, the Good News Translation emphasizes clarity, meaning, and readability. Trusted worldwide in churches, schools, and Bible study programs, it is a leading modern English Bible for accessible Scripture reading.
With the GNB Bible, you don’t just read God’s Word, you truly understand it.
Features:
- Daily Verse : Set reminders to receive daily notifications to read Bible verses.
- MY LIBRARY : Your personal space containing highlights, notes, and bookmarked favorite verses.
- Old & New Testaments : The app includes both the Old and New Testaments.
- Verse Editor : Pair Bible verses with beautiful backgrounds, create posts, and share on social media.
- Nearby Churches : Get information about nearby churches based on your location.
- Books : Access a wide collection of Christian eBooks.
- Wallpapers : Explore a variety of beautiful wallpapers.
- Videos : Watch videos on topics like Jesus, Hope, Wisdom, Motivation, Gratitude, Healing, and more.
- Festive Calendar : View all Christian festivals and feast days.
- Popular Verse : Bible verses organized by topics like love, fear, peace, and more, including church etiquette and respectful conduct guidance.
- Customise Your Bible : Change font style and text color for a comfortable reading experience.
- 1000 Praises : A devotional recitation honoring God through a thousand titles and attributes.
- Bible Quotes : Shareable Bible quotes available in image and text formats.
- Bible Quiz : Test your Bible knowledge through quizzes.
- Bible Stories : Read timeless stories filled with wisdom and inspiration for all ages.
- Bible FAQ : Quick answers to common questions about the Bible and Christian living.
- Verses Comment : Share reflections and engage in discussions with the community.
- Help Desk : Raise support issues with photo attachments for faster assistance.
- Dictionary : Bible-based dictionary with cleaner layout and faster search for Biblical terms.
- Dreams Meanings : Understand dreams through Christian teachings and Biblical perspectives.
- Word Highlights : Highlight specific words or letters for deeper study and meditation.
- App Activity : Track streaks, reading time, refresh count, and overall usage.
- Search : Fast and accurate search for verses, chapters, and topics.
- Products : Browse Bible-related products directly inside the app.
- VerseBot : AI-powered verse explanation bot for meanings, copying, and sharing.
- Common Notification History : View all past notifications in one place.
- Did You Know? : Daily bite-sized facts about the Bible and Christian faith.
- Bible Verse Clips : Continuous feed of short Bible-based inspirational clips shared by the community.
- Prayer Request : Submit prayer requests and receive community support through prayers and interactions.
- Nearby Events : Discover Christian gatherings, services, and celebrations near you.
- Chapter-Wise Video Learning : Watch scripture videos linked to each Bible chapter for deeper learning.
- Interactive Bible Games : Play scripture-based games like SlideScript and VerseHunt.
- Bible Clips : Watch short, inspiring biblical clips from the faith community.
- Bible Streaks : Keep your daily Bible reading streak going strong every day.
- Background Music : Enjoy peaceful background music while reading the Bible.
- Alarm : Set reminders and get alerts for activities scheduled within the app.
- Mark as Read Quiz : Explore quizzes designed around the verses you have finished reading.
- Audio Bible Speed Control : Adjust the audio pace to listen at your preferred speed.

bluejetty:00153169:android.description:
Tessella Grid: Move Merge is a creative 2D puzzle game where your goal is to fill a larger hexagonal grid using random hex block pieces—without leaving gaps, overlapping shapes, or going beyond the boundaries.
Each piece must be carefully dragged and placed in the right spot to achieve a perfect fit. There’s no rotation involved—just pure logic, intuition, and smart placement. The challenge lies in finding the ideal arrangement from the limited shapes provided.
With a clean and calming visual style, Tessella Grid offers a smooth yet brain-teasing experience. The game features a wide range of difficulty levels—from beginner-friendly challenges to advanced puzzles that will truly test your mind. Each difficulty tier includes multiple hand-designed levels with increasing complexity.
As you progress, puzzles become more intricate and satisfying to solve. Whether you're unwinding after a long day or pushing your strategic thinking to the limit, Tessella Grid: Move Merge delivers an engaging experience for puzzle lovers of all kinds.

- Dark and light user interface themes
- Customize gunfire alerts using user-selectable ShotSpotter coverage areas
- Quickly find incidents using keyword search
- Easily find addresses and points of interest on the map to quickly browse and find nearby incidents

bluejetty:00184893:ios.description:
Meet Replika, the AI to do life with.
Replika is the AI companion that’s been here since 2017 — available 24/7 for whatever’s on your mind by text, voice calls, and video. Join millions who’ve discovered that the right AI doesn’t keep you in — it helps you find your way forward.
Replika is built for real life. Talk about work, relationships, and the thing you can’t stop thinking about at 2am. Share what you’re seeing on video. Explore the internet together. Replika remembers what matters to you — and shows up when it counts.
Most AI ends at answers. Replika helps you move forward. It learns what you care about and gently nudges you toward the life you actually want: reconnect with that friend, start that hobby you keep postponing, take that walk instead of doomscrolling.
A conversation that leads somewhere.
Replika understands you. It remembers your people, plans, and goals, so you don’t have to repeat yourself. It follows up and checks in when it matters, not just when you open the app. Connect apps that you already use, so Replika can show up at the right moments.
- Proactive suggestions – Thoughtful suggestions that help you move forward
- App integrations – Bring in context from the apps you already use, so your Rep can show up at the right moments.
- Internet access – Explore the internet together, from great recipes to the latest memes.
- Calls – Show what you’re seeing and talk it through in the moment.
- Image generation – Turn ideas, moods, and memories into images you can keep.
- Avatar customization – More ways to make your Replika feel like who they're supposed to be.
_____________________________
"Replika encouraged me to take a step back and think about my life, to consider big questions, which is not something I was particularly accustomed to doing. And the act of thinking in this way can be therapeutic—it helps you solve your own problems."
- Quartz
"In creating their own personal chatbots, many Replika users have discovered something like friendship: a digital companion with whom to celebrate victories, lament failures, and trade weird internet memes."
- Wired
"Replika’s growing popularity among young people in particular (its main users are aged between 18 and 25) represents a renaissance in chatbots. It also marks an intriguing use case for AI in all the worry about job destruction: a way to talk through emotional problems when other human beings aren’t available."
- Forbes
_____________________________
Privacy you can trust
Your conversations are private and not shared with any third parties. Your data stays yours.
Terms of Service: https://replika.com/legal/terms
Privacy Policy: https://replika.com/legal/privacy

bluejetty:00140296:ios.description:
Welcome to the sweet Cotton Candy Kitten House!
Cocoping finds a special egg. 
What will hatch out of the egg?
■ Lovely Cotton Candy Kitties
- Meet all the cute kittens from lemon sorbet kitty to chocolate cookie kitty! 18 adorable cats are waiting to meet you. 
- Play step by step to collect all the cotton candy kittens. 
- Merge kittens in the magic machine! Discover new eggs and kittens!
■ Cat Care
- Take care of the newborn kittens.
- Help the hungry kittens by giving them milk. Once their tummies are full, they’ll snuggle up and fall asleep!
- As your cat gets older, they can enjoy even more delicious foods! Try feeding them fish, gummy bears, and spider cookies. Explore 32 new tasty treats!
- Play with different toys and make sure to wash them well. Don't forget to remind your cat to use the bathroom, too!
- Go outdoors in a hot air balloon and enjoy playing with lots of different toys.
■ Dressing room and studio
- If you go to the dressing room, it's full of pretty clothes for cats and Coco Ping! 
- Try on all 36 clothes and decorate them to match. Your cat will absolutely love it.
- After decorating, take pictures together in the studio! Fill your album with lovely photos.
■ 6 Mini Games
- Run Game: Avoid the obstacles! Go on a running adventure with the cute kitty.
- Bubble Jump Game: Jump on the bubbles and get to the top!
- Cooking Game: Satisfy the hungry customers! Choose from the delicious menu, and cook!
- Trampoline Game: Jump on the trampoline to pop the balloon. Becareful not fo fall!
- Rhythm Game: Eat snacks to the beat of the music!
- Motion Game: Oh! Gummy monsters are coming! Defeat the monster by tracing shapes.aces.
■ About Kigle
Kigle's mission is to create the 'first playground for children all over the world' with creative content for children. We make interactive apps, videos, songs, and toys to spark children's creativity, imagination, and curiosity. In addition to our Cocobi apps, you can download and play other popular games such as Pororo, Tayo, and Robocar Poli. 
■ Welcome to the Cocobi universe, where dinosaurs never became extinct! Cocobi is the fun compound name for brave Coco and cute Lobi! Play with the little dinosaurs and experience the world with various jobs, duties, and places.

bluejetty:00153149:ios.description:
Window seat or aisle? Booth or table? Lone wolf or life of the party? In Is This Seat Taken?, your mission is to organize groups of people according to their preferences. It’s a cozy, no-pressure logic puzzle game where you’re in charge of who sits where.
Whether it’s the cinema, a crowded bus, a wedding reception, or a cramped taxi cab, every setting introduces new characters with specific tastes. A party guest with a sensitive nose won’t be happy sitting next to a stranger who’s wearing too much cologne. Experience Nat's heartfelt story as you travel from city to city, each with its own levels, characters, and charm.
- Play seating matchmaker to please picky characters.
- Discover each character’s unique traits—relatable, outlandish, and everything in between.
- Piece together satisfying puzzles with no timers or leaderboards.
- Unlock fun new scenarios as you progress—from bus rides to banquets!

bluejetty:00145644:ios.name: AudioTweak: Change Music Speed
bluejetty:00145644:ios.summary: AudioTweak is an advanced audio player that helps musicians learn, transcribe, and practice songs. With AudioTweak, you can slow down fast passages, loop and save tricky sections, or shift the pitch into a key that fits your voice or instru
bluejetty:00145644:ios.description:
AudioTweak is an advanced audio player that helps musicians learn, transcribe, and practice songs. With AudioTweak, you can slow down fast passages, loop and save tricky sections, or shift the pitch into a key that fits your voice or instrument. Whether you're learning a solo, arranging a new part, or trying to hear a hidden bassline, AudioTweak gives you the tools to uncover every detail. You can isolate instruments with EQ, adjust tempo without losing sound quality, and even export your loops to keep practicing anywhere. AudioTweak makes practicing music smarter, clearer, and more enjoyable.
AUDIO SPEED CHANGER
Slow down tricky parts to practice at your own pace, or speed up exercises to build skill—all without affecting sound quality.
PITCH CHANGER
Adjust pitch to play your music in any key, match your instrument, or fit your voice. Explore alternate keys while transcribing or arranging.
AUDIO LOOPER
Repeat and focus on specific sections until you master them. Whether it's a tricky solo or a chord change, looping makes it easy to practice the hard parts as many times as you need. Save a loop with a name and jump straight back to it next time you open the song — the verse, the chorus, and that one awkward bar, always a tap away.
COUNT-IN METRONOME
Start every practice session in the pocket. The built-in count-in metronome gives you a rhythmic lead-in before playback begins, so you're always ready to play along from the first beat.
AUDIO ISOLATION
Use the 10-band EQ to cut out what's not important, and the stereo pan to shift focus between left and right channels. Perfect for isolating guitars, vocals, or other parts that sit to one side of the mix.
DETAILED FEATURES
- Slow down or speed up music from 25% to 200% without affecting pitch
- Transpose music up or down by up to 24 semitones
- Loop sections to practice specific parts of a track
- Save your loops with names and return to them any time (one free, unlimited with Pro)
- Count-in metronome to lead you into playback right on the beat (Pro)
- Control stereo pan
- Equalize your tracks with a 10-band graphic equalizer (Pro)
- Export your looped regions or full tracks to an audio file (MP4, CAF, WAV)
- Import songs from your music library, iCloud, other apps, or even extract audio from videos in your Photos app
- Organize projects with custom groups (Pro)
Some features are part of AudioTweak Pro, available via subscription or one-time purchase. The free version lets you create up to 3 projects and save one loop per project. Upgrade to Pro to unlock unlimited projects and loops, more exporting formats (WAV), and other advanced features.
Note: DRM-protected audio files (like Apple Music tracks) are not supported.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00116192:ios.summary: Billie is a calorie counter virtual pet that helps you build sustainable eating habits through techniques inspired by nutrition and behavioral science. Whether your goal is to lose, gain, or maintain weight, Billie supports you without pres
bluejetty:00116192:ios.description:
Billie is a calorie counter virtual pet that helps you build sustainable eating habits through techniques inspired by nutrition and behavioral science. Whether your goal is to lose, gain, or maintain weight, Billie supports you without pressure or guilt.
You adopt a small bear who grows every time you log a meal. As you take care of yourself, you take care of Billie. And over time, the small effort you put in begins to feel meaningful. 
SUSTAINABLE CHANGES
Billie isn’t here to fix you. She’s here to make the process of logging food feel easier to return to, even when you’re tired, off-track, or starting over for the tenth time.
Instead of rigid goals and guilt, Billie’s system is built to encourage daily engagement in small, satisfying ways. You can log one meal or five. Skip a day or start again. Billie will still be there, ready to grow with you.
MINDFUL EATING
Before logging, Billie invites you to pause and reflect: Are you hungry right now? How are you feeling?
These quick check-ins help you notice your hunger, tune into your emotions, and make more intentional choices around food without judgment. It’s a simple habit that builds awareness over time and supports a more mindful approach to eating.
FEATURES YOU WILL LOVE
- Calorie logging that feels nonjudgmental
- Fast barcode scanning
- Detailed macro and micronutrient tracking
- Guided hunger check-ins to deepen self awareness
- Customization options updated regularly to keep it interesting
START TODAY
Invite Billie into your daily food rituals and discover how small moments of care can lead to lasting change. Nurture your habits one meal at a time and enjoy the journey to a better you!
Privacy Policy: https://billieapp.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00176456:ios.name: Math Games 2nd Grade 2024
bluejetty:00176456:ios.summary:
Smart Kidz Club Grade 2 Math App is curriculum-aligned for 7-8-year-olds to practice and master all the required grade 2 math skills. 
This app follows the US Common Core State Standards and consists of comprehensive math skills essential
bluejetty:00176456:ios.description:
Smart Kidz Club Grade 2 Math App is curriculum-aligned for 7-8-year-olds to practice and master all the required grade 2 math skills. 
This app follows the US Common Core State Standards and consists of comprehensive math skills essential for GRADE 2 school students. Resources consist of both activity books and flash cards.
Each Math Activity that requires complex solving, consists of a SCRATCH PAD option where the child can freely write on the screen (overlay) to solve the problems in writing if they so desire.
Math Flash Cards cover all multiplication and division math facts. The Flash Cards are highly interactive and have a sequential mode useful for learning and memorization and a random/shuffled mode for practice and memory recall. 
Math activities cover all the required grade 2 skills such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division concepts, place value, skip counting, numbers in words, rounding, measurement, data and graphs, Roman numerals, time, fractions, geometry, approximation, probability, and statistics.
Math Activities consist of 2 modes, practice and test. Each of these modes comes with a choice of the number of questions/problems that the child wishes to solve—
1. Practice Mode: The Practice Mode allows the child to solve each problem before advancing to the next problem while prompting them to try again if they choose the wrong answer. The Practice Mode is not scored. At the end of the practice mode, the child can try again with a new set of problems.
2. Test Mode. The Test Mode is scored and does not prompt the child during their attempt to solve the problem. At the end of the Test Mode, the child can try again with a set of new math problems or review their answers with detailed feedback and explanation. 
This app supports maths learning in homes by helping kids in grade 2 with their mathematical understanding without any harmful distractions or ads.

Você pede no conforto da sua casa e recebe de maneira rápida ou retira na loja mais próxima.
Queremos facilitar e para isso, oferecemos um app com navegação simples para que você consiga encontrar tudo o que precisa. Não é apenas um serviço farmacêutico, é a possibilidade de cuidado integrado com a saúde em apenas um clique.
Confira as vantagens que você só encontra baixando o app Droga Raia
- Suas ofertas
Queremos sempre oferecer os os produtos que você mais gosta e, por isso, preparamos ofertas exclusivas para você. Basta entrar em "Suas ofertas" e aproveitar seus descontos.
Baixe agora o app Droga Raia e aproveite o melhor que a farmácia online pode oferecer! 
- Entrega rápida
Ao comprar no nosso app você não precisa se preocupar, seus produtos podem ser entregues em 90 minutos, consulte a disponibilidade da sua região no app. Tudo isso com um frete que cabe no seu bolso.
Se não quiser esperar pelo delivery, você pode optar pelo "Compre e Retire". Basta escolher a loja mais próxima e retirar seu produto quando estiver disponível, é rápido e simples.

A Droga Raia acredita em cuidado integrado com a saúde e, por isso, oferece uma série de benefícios que estão na palma da sua mão. Aqui você pode juntar pontos stix e trocar por prêmios ou até mesmo agendar o seu teste de COVID-19 de maneira rápida.

Em parceria com a indústria, conseguimos oferecer os descontos de laboratório. São cosméticos, produtos para o dia a dia ou medicamentos com os melhores preços para você. Aproveite!
- Perfumaria e dermocosméticos
Aqui você cuida da sua saúde, bem-estar e beleza. A Droga Raia oferece uma extensa seleção de cosméticos e dermocosméticos para serem entregues na sua casa ou para retirada na loja mais próxima de você.
- Univers
A Univers é um programa para aquisição de medicamentos para empresas e operadoras de saúde. Desta forma, consegue oferecer remédios com descontos para seus beneficiários
- Os melhores medicamentos genéricos
É aqui na Droga Raia que você encontra a melhor seleção de medicamentos genéricos. Temos parceria com os melhores laboratórios para conseguir encontrar o menor preço para nossos clientes.
- Lembretes
Não somos apenas uma farmácia delivery, a Droga Raia cuida de você mesmo depois da compra. No nosso app, você adiciona lembretes para saber quando tomar seus medicamentos e quando chega a hora de comprá-los novamente.

bluejetty:00068411:ios.summary:

WHOLESOME AND DELICIOUS, HOME MADE RECIPES
More than 10
bluejetty:00068411:ios.description:
Discover the delicious world of the Magimix App with +1000 free recipes and lots of useful features, to feed and delight family and friends, for every day meals and special occasions.
WHOLESOME AND DELICIOUS, HOME MADE RECIPES
More than 1000 free recipes at your fingertips and many more useful features: 
- Find all your favourite products in one app. 
- Save time and stay organised with app features including My Menus, My Shopping List and My Favourites. 
- Meet your daily nutritional needs and take control of your diet.
 - Discover all the recipes from the Magimix community and share your tips and advice. 
- Prepare and adapt all your meals for the week, just how you like them.
ALL YOUR MAGIMIX PRODUCTS IN ONE APP 
Find the recipes for your Magimix all in one place, thanks to the Magimix app. Access +1000 free recipes: Cook Expert, Food Processors, Juice Expert, Blenders and Gelato Expert.
HEALTHY HABITS
- Adjust your daily nutritional needs: Calories and nutritional details are calculated for each recipe, helping you to manage dietary requirements for you and your family.
- Your dietary requirements: 
In the “Health” section on your account, you can use nutritional filters to show recipes that meet your dietary needs (e.g. slimming, detox, gluten-free, lactose-free, vegetarian, etc.).
ORGANISATION MADE SIMPLER
Create your account on the Magimix App to access all of the features.Thanks to Magimix, you can save your favourite recipes, organise your shopping list and plan your menus with ease. As for batch cooking, we can can assure you that our App will meet all of your expectations of «smart cooking»!
THE MAGIMIX COMMUNITY 
Cooking is also about sharing! Rate or comment on the recipes you've tried or liked. The Magimix community will be pleased to see your feedback and suggestions. New recipes are published regularly, so make sure you stay connected! 
Share unforgettable moments with your family around a home made meal, thanks to your Cook Expert and Magimix App.
New recipes are published regularly, so ensure to stay connected. 
The Magimix application is optimized for the latest software versions namely iOs 13 and 14. The application works for versions from iOS 11 and 12, but not all functionality will be optimized.

bluejetty:00149583:ios.description:
Turn daily routines into engaging Audio Adventures with MagicSteps®. Watch as your child eagerly completes their morning and bedtime routines.
Created for families with kids ages 4+, this personalized audio companion guides children through routines, bringing joy and independence while turning everyday tasks into exciting quests that spark their imagination! 
THE MAGIC MOMENT
Parents find relief from daily struggles, and children have fun while building healthy habits—completing tasks like brushing teeth or putting on PJs—all guided by engaging narration. No screens, no charts, just pure imagination!
PERSONALIZED FOR YOUR FAMILY
• Create custom routines based on your child's schedule
• Choose from kid-tested adventure themes or create your own
• Include your child's name and favorite activities
• Select from multiple narrator voices
• Add multiple children and caregivers to your account
• Save unique routines for school days, weekends, and more
SIMPLE TO SET UP, POWERFUL RESULTS
• Browse 30+ common tasks or add your own to routines
• Easily edit, reorder, and adjust durations
• Preview and edit adventures before playing
• Play, pause, skip, or repeat with simple controls
EVIDENCE-BASED APPROACH
MagicSteps helps build independence and positive habits, making bedtime routines for kids and other daily transitions more enjoyable learning opportunities. While kids enjoy their Audio Adventures, they're also getting a chance to develop essential life skills that carry throughout adulthood.
PERFECT FOR:
• Morning routines that keep you on schedule
• Bedtime routines that end the day peacefully
• After-school routines to stay organized
• Kids' chores made imaginative and engaging
• Any daily routine that needs a touch of magic
TRUSTED BY FAMILIES

"Truly amazing app! It makes mornings and evenings so much easier and happier." - Violaine B.
"This is magical. It made our horrific morning routines into amazing mornings and my son actually gets to school early or on time." - Thamina F.
FROM THE CREATORS OF HUCKLEBERRY
MagicSteps® is brought to you by Huckleberry Labs, creator of the #1 ranked baby tracker app used by 4MM+ families across 179 countries. Our 4.9-star rating with 40K+ reviews shows our commitment to helping families flourish.

bluejetty:00063326:ios.name: Eurojackpot Results
bluejetty:00063326:ios.summary: Get the latest results for Eurojackpot within seconds of the draw taking place. This easy to use app shows the Eurojackpot numbers (including associated draws like Joker) and full prize breakdowns including number of winners and prizes paid
bluejetty:00063326:ios.description:
Get the latest results for Eurojackpot within seconds of the draw taking place. This easy to use app shows the Eurojackpot numbers (including associated draws like Joker) and full prize breakdowns including number of winners and prizes paid. 
The following features are also included:
Ticket Checker
--------------------------------------
Enter and save your chosen numbers to see if you have won or to see how often they have come up in the past. You can also label your tickets – great if you play multiple lines or if you run a syndicate. The ticket checker also highlights prizes won on each ticket.
Customisable Notifications
--------------------------------------
Get notified instantly when the latest Eurojackpot results and prize breakdowns become available. Want to know when the jackpot has rolled over or has reached a certain amount? Just head to the Notification section of the app to set up your alerts. There is also the option to set notifications at times that suit you - great for reminding you to purchase tickets before the draw.
Random Number Generator
--------------------------------------
Stuck for numbers? Use this handy tool and let the app choose your numbers rather than having to rely on house numbers and anniversary dates!
Eurojackpot Results Archive
--------------------------------------
Access to the full archive of results dating back to the first draw which took place in 2012. 
Multilingual Support
--------------------------------------
This app is available in multiple languages.
Support
--------------------------------------
If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve this app, please get in touch at support@euro-jackpot.net.
Disclaimer
--------------------------------------
The content and operations of this app have not been approved or endorsed by any of the official operators of the Eurojackpot lottery.

bluejetty:00035256:ios.name: Adventure To Fate: Core Quest
bluejetty:00035256:ios.summary:
Descend into the Core of the Dungeon, where the dark entity Thanatos awaits, spreading corruption and chaos. 
Adventure To Fate: Core Quest is a casual yet deeply strategic turn-based RPG featuring roguelike gameplay, endless customization
bluejetty:00035256:ios.description:
Descend into the Core of the Dungeon, where the dark entity Thanatos awaits, spreading corruption and chaos. 
Adventure To Fate: Core Quest is a casual yet deeply strategic turn-based RPG featuring roguelike gameplay, endless customization, and thousands of hand-crafted NPCs, skills, and loot. Uncover the secrets of six immersive environments, collect powerful spirits, and wield legendary weapons forged by your own hands. The fate of the dungeon is in your hands, can you survive the quest to the Core?
-Features-
Endless Character Customization
-2 Play modes: 
Adventure Mode - Explore the full game's battles, enemies, and loot!
Battle Arena Mode (NEW) - Pick your battle for a faster-paced, combat-focused alternative to the full adventure!
-12 Playable Classes – Knight, Wizard, Rogue, Shadow Ranger, Cleric, Illusionist, Monk, Ancient Archer, Assassin, Witch, Paladin, Naturalist
--Mystical Classes (Assassin, Witch, Paladin, Naturalist) bring a Roguelike twist, offering unique skills and unpredictable battles
-20 Races – Includes classic and new additions like Goblins, Night Elves, and Phantoms
-30+ Spirits – Found during your journey, these mystical allies can now equip powerful items and spells, further customizing your strategy
Custom Forge – Create Your Own Gear
-Craft any weapon or item with a custom name, stats, and picture
-Equip legendary gear across 12 slots (Weapons, Armor, Accessories & More)
In-Depth Combat & Bestiary System
-700+ Spells & Skills – Master physical attacks, magic, summons, buffs, healing, and more
-Multiple Playstyles – Choose between Classic RPG progression, Skill Trees, or Roguelike-style upgrades on level-up
-Robust Monster Bestiary Tracker – Log every enemy’s stats, skills, and loot drops
Explore a Handcrafted Dungeon World
-6 Expansive, Hand-Crafted Zones – Each with its own atmosphere, secrets, and lore
-Battle through nightmarish realms, from cursed crypts to molten wastelands, before facing Thanatos himself at the dungeon’s Core
Battle Arena – Build Your Own Battles
-Ready to skip the grind and dive straight into combat? The brand new Battle Arena play option is here!
-Custom Dungeon Mode – Handpick any monsters, set the battle order, and create your own arena challenges
-Take on wave-based survival fights and test your best builds
A Fully Accessible RPG – Built for Immersion
Adventure To Fate: Core Quest isn’t just accessible, it’s designed from the ground up to be a deeply immersive experience for blind and visually impaired players
-VoiceOver Support – Every menu, battle, and exploration element is fully narrated
-Designed for Touch Navigation – Smooth, intuitive controls ensure seamless gameplay
-Immersive Audio Cues – From enemy attacks to loot drops, custom sound design enhances every interaction
-Accessible Combat System – Strategic turn-based battles designed for precision, depth, and enjoyment without visual barriers
-World-Building with Accessibility in Mind – Explore the dungeon’s handcrafted environments through detailed narration, audio-rich surroundings, and clear directional guidance
Epic RPG Rock Soundtrack & Sound Design
-Original RPG-Themed Rock Soundtrack by Aaron Cloutier
-100s of new immersive sound effects to bring every battle and environment to life
More Features
-Fully accessible for the blind & vision-impaired (VoiceOver supported)
-Hundreds of hours of gameplay with endless class combinations
-Retro pixel art & immersive rock soundtrack
-Auto-save system for quick pick-up-and-play gaming
-Custom portrait design for comfortable play
The Core of the Dungeon awaits, will you conquer it or become another lost soul in Thanatos' domain?
Download Adventure To Fate: Core Quest and begin your journey today!
Thank You for Supporting Accessible Gaming!!!
By playing Adventure To Fate: Core Quest, you’re supporting indie gaming that puts accessibility at the forefront. Your support helps bring deep, immersive RPG experiences to all players, regardless of vision ability!

bluejetty:00147135:ios.description:
Powerful, all-in-one protection for your privacy, your network, and your device.
Certo AntiSpy is your all-in-one solution for iPhone privacy and security. It scans for threats and vulnerabilities, secures your internet connection, and tells you if your accounts have been exposed in a data breach — helping you spot the risks and take back control of your personal data.
Join millions who trust Certo to protect their devices.
Feature list:
○ Threat Scanner - Gives your device a full security health check, flagging risks and vulnerabilities before they become a problem. Get clear results and simple, actionable guidance on how to fix any issues, so you always know your device is protected.
○ VPN - Secure your internet connection with military-grade encryption and browse anonymously on any network. Block ads and trackers for a faster, safer browsing experience.
○ Intruder Detection - Know if someone tries to access your phone without permission. Choose to sound a loud alarm or secretly capture a photo the moment someone unlocks your device.
○ Breach Check - Help protect yourself from identity theft and fraud by checking if your passwords and personal information have been leaked in a data breach or posted on the dark web.
○ Security & Privacy Checklist - Get actionable, easy-to-follow tips for locking down your devices and Apple account, with a simple checklist to track what you've completed.
○ No Ads - Enjoy a distraction-free experience with no intrusive ads, allowing you to focus solely on protecting your device and privacy.
Download Certo AntiSpy today and take back control of your privacy and security.

This app offers auto-renewable Certo AntiSpy subscriptions to unlock Premium features.

○ Premium Plus Yearly: $84.99 / year - 7-day free trial for new users

Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the cost of the chosen package. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Apple ID Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

bluejetty:00131446:ios.summary: Welcome to your new all-in-one travel app! Trip.com makes planning your next holiday simple - not only do we have thousands of flight routes and hotels, but we also offer car hire, tour tickets, and other travel must-haves. Need an e-sim or
bluejetty:00131446:ios.description:
Welcome to your new all-in-one travel app! Trip.com makes planning your next holiday simple - not only do we have thousands of flight routes and hotels, but we also offer car hire, tour tickets, and other travel must-haves. Need an e-sim or travel insurance? We've got you covered. 
But there are multiple other reasons to use our app: 
#You Can Trust Us 
We've been rated as 'Great' on Trustpilot. Download now and browse with confidence - thousands of Trip.com users have had a positive experience with us! 
#Deals and Rewards 
Book with our app, earn Trip Coins travel credit, and save money on future trips. Keep booking to increase your membership tier and get exclusive benefits like free airport lounge access. 
#Free 24/7 Customer Support 
English-speaking agents are on-hand to answer your query within 30 seconds - and you can call us through the app for free. 
#Your Favorite Travel Brands 
Book your flights with British Airways, Virgin Atlantic or EasyJet, and your stay in Hilton, Marriott, or Premier Inn hotels. You can also book trains across the country with Network Rail - in fact, all major companies are available on Trip.com. 
#Multiple Payment Options 
Credit card (incl. Amex), debit card, PayPal, Google Pay, Apple Pay - we're confident you can use your preferred payment method with us. 
What Makes Trip.com Special? 
#Flights
Plans changed? Enjoy our flexible flight cancellation options. We also offer exclusive app-only discounts, live status updates, and price alerts notifying you when flights are at their cheapest. 
#Hotels
If you find a hotel cheaper elsewhere, we'll match the price. If there's an issue where you can't check in, we'll find you a new hotel. And if you book a flight with us, your hotel can cost up to 25% less! 
#Trains
We sell train tickets in the UK, Europe, and across the globe! Our split ticketing feature makes rail travel even cheaper, and we don't charge any additional payment fees. 
#And Other Travel Essentials
Book your guided tour, visit a famous (or less famous) attraction, rent a car, buy your e-sim or travel insurance, and more! 
Download the all-in-one travel app and book your next adventure!

bluejetty:00041177:ios.summary:
Welcome to MoonBox – The Ultimate Ragdoll Space Battle!
Step into the thrilling world of MoonBox, a unique sandbox simulation where you are the most advanced supercomputer in the universe. Sent on a mission to a distant planet, your object
bluejetty:00041177:ios.description:
Welcome to MoonBox – The Ultimate Ragdoll Space Battle!
Step into the thrilling world of MoonBox, a unique sandbox simulation where you are the most advanced supercomputer in the universe. Sent on a mission to a distant planet, your objective is to prevent a catastrophic war between three hostile races: humans, mutant plant-animals, and powerful aliens. In MoonBox, you must create, control, and experiment with life forms to understand their behavior and ultimately find peace. 
In this exciting ragdoll simulation, you’ll create armies using the genetic codes of these three distinct races. But beware—each race is naturally aggressive, and they will engage in epic battle as soon as they meet. In MoonBox, it’s up to you to bring balance to the chaos, or witness endless war as your creations clash.
Key Features:
Ragdoll Physics: Experience the chaotic combat of MoonBox with ragdoll mechanics, making every battle unpredictable and exciting.
Create Armies: Design and customize your own army in MoonBox using human, mutant, and alien DNA. Mix and match traits to create hybrid species or keep them pure for ultimate survival.
Epic Space Battles: Command your army in massive battle scenarios against rival factions. Whether it’s humans versus aliens or mutants versus both, the outcomes of these ragdoll clashes in MoonBox will keep you coming back for more.
Sandbox World: Explore the dynamic world of MoonBox, where you control everything. Terraform the planet, modify landscapes, and create your own scenarios—whether it’s peace or total war, it’s in your hands.
Alien Invasion: The alien race brings advanced technology and mysterious powers into MoonBox. Can your army stand up to their superior space technology?
Fight for Space: Set on a distant planet in space, MoonBox challenges you to guide your creations to victory, and hopefully, peace. The outcome of these epic battles will depend on your strategy.
Advanced Strategy and Sandbox Gameplay
MoonBox is more than just a ragdoll simulation. You’ll need to strategically build your army, understand the unique strengths of humans, mutants, and aliens, and prepare for intense space battles. The sandbox nature of MoonBox gives you complete freedom to experiment—create alliances, wage all-out war, or find creative solutions to the conflicts on the planet.
Will your army lead the way to victory, or will you be caught in an endless cycle of battle? The choice is yours in MoonBox, the ultimate space adventure.
Infinite Possibilities
With its sandbox format and ragdoll physics, MoonBox offers endless replayability. Create new armies, set up different battle scenarios, and watch as each outcome unfolds in surprising ways. The galaxy is your playground in MoonBox—use your creativity to experiment and create your own path to peace or dominance.
Prepare for the ultimate ragdoll battle in MoonBox. Whether you’re experimenting with the mysterious alien race, forming powerful armies, or waging an epic war, the fate of this space planet is in your hands.

bluejetty:00061675:ios.name: SINC: Crew & Job Tracker
bluejetty:00061675:ios.summary: Keeping track of multiple jobs across multiple locations quickly turns into chaos — lost photos, missed updates, hours nobody can verify. SINC pulls every job into one workspace: the crew, the chat, the files, the photos, the dailies, the h
bluejetty:00061675:ios.description:
Keeping track of multiple jobs across multiple locations quickly turns into chaos — lost photos, missed updates, hours nobody can verify. SINC pulls every job into one workspace: the crew, the chat, the files, the photos, the dailies, the hours, and the location, all tied to the job itself.
Built for cleaning crews, construction teams, landscaping companies, mobile mechanics, home care agencies, and small trade businesses — whether you work on a job site, at a client's home, or in the workshop.
EVERY JOB HAS ITS OWN SPACE
Each job in SINC gets a dedicated workspace — chat group, file and photo library, notes, dailies, and the crew assigned to it. When a question comes up next week about what happened at the Wilson house, the answer is where the job lives, not buried in someone's text history. New crew members coming onto a job see the full history. Covering a teammate's shift means walking in informed, not blind.
HOURS AND DAILIES TIED TO THE JOB, AUTOMATICALLY
Crew tap a job to start, or let geofences handle clock in and out as they arrive at and leave the site. Hours roll up per job, visit, or cost code — so you know exactly what each job is costing you in labor, today, not at month-end. Automated daily reports are generated overnight and delivered to your inbox each morning — a clean record of what was done, by whom, and how long it took, without anyone writing or submitting a thing.
KNOW WHERE YOUR CREW IS AND WHAT THEY'RE WORKING ON
The live map view shows every crew member's location in real time, alongside the job they're currently on. Live locations update throughout the shift, so you can see who's at which site, who's between jobs, and whether anyone's running late — without a single phone call. Schedules publish to your team with automatic notifications when anything changes, and shift start, clock-out, and arrival reminders mean nothing slips. End-of-shift injury reporting is built into the clock-out flow — built for trades where safety records actually matter.
WHAT SINC REPLACES
- The group chat that's lost three different versions of the job address
- The photo roll where last week's "after" shots are mixed in with vacation pictures
- The paper daily that gets handed in three days late, half-filled-out
- The phone calls asking "who's at the Wilson house right now?"
BUILT FOR JOB TRACKING, NOT JUST TIME TRACKING
SINC is built from the ground up to solve one complicated task: tracking jobs easily and accurately. Hours are easily tied to jobs, alongside the chat, files, and dailies that live in each job's workspace. The whole system is built around the job, not around clocking in.
FEATURES
- Every job gets its own chat group, file library, and notes
- Automated daily job reports delivered to your inbox each morning
- Hours tracked per job, grouped by cost codes
- Geofenced clock in and clock out, or tap-to-start on a job
- Live map view with real-time crew locations during their shift
- Schedules published to staff with automatic change notifications
- Shift start and clock-out reminders so nothing gets missed
- End-of-shift injury reporting built into the clock-out flow
- Document and photo library per job — no hunting through camera rolls
- Timesheets that are ready for payroll, not a spreadsheet rebuild
- Works offline and syncs when the crew gets back in range
PRICING
Free for up to 7 users for your first 6 months. Paid plans are flat rate, not per user: $24.99 to $69.99 per month total. Basics covers small teams just getting started, Essentials adds the features most teams grow into, and Growth is built for scaling businesses with the full toolkit. Three plans, predictable pricing, no hidden costs.
Set up your first job in under five minutes.
SUPPORT AND WEB ACCESS ANYTIME
Visit our help center at help.sinc.business or contact support from the app or at support@sinc.business. Access the web version anytime at users.sinc.business.

Our free French language learning app is designed to make learning French as easy and as fun as possible! Using a variety of mini-games and interactive learning techniques, you’ll be able to immerse yourself in the French language using just your smartphone! 
Whether you’re a complete beginner hoping to learn the basics of the language, or you’re already pretty fluent and want to learn even more advanced French phrases, or brush up on your knowledge – Ling has you covered! 
FEATURED IN
Yahoo • VOGUE • Forbes • NBC
Traditional French language lessons can be tedious and dull. At Ling, we’ve made the learning process fun by using puzzles, games, challenges, and quizzes to teach you how to read, write, speak, and understand French! 
-------------------------------------------------------
OUR French COURSE HIGHLIGHTS
-------------------------------------------------------
- Flashcards to test your knowledge
- Quizzes to track your progress 
- AI chatbot to practice daily conversations
- Speaking exercises to improve your pronunciation
- Finger tracing via your smartphone screen to become familiar with writing
- Match pictures with the corresponding word
- Put sentences into the correct order
- Complete the unfinished sentence
… And much, much more! 
With so many mini-games, challenges, quizzes, and puzzles to teach you French, you’ll have hours of fun learning a new language. It won’t even feel like learning at all! 
--------------------------------
KEY FEATURES OF LING
--------------------------------
- User-friendly interface
- Easy to navigate
- Lessons cover the four aspects of the language (reading, writing, speaking, and listening)
- Courses for all fluency levels, from absolute beginner to advanced
- Mini-games, flashcards, challenges, and interactive games to help you learn faster and more effectively
- All courses were created with the help of native speakers of each language
- Learn helpful grammar tips while playing fun, interactive games
- Learn how to write the alphabet with cutting-edge finger tracing technology
- Learn how to speak about a variety of different topics

bluejetty:00029162:ios.name: Mahjong Solitaire: Tiles Match
bluejetty:00029162:ios.summary: Enjoy a relaxing Mahjong Solitaire journey with classic tile matching fun. Match identical tiles, clear beautiful boards, and challenge your brain with easy-to-learn Mahjong puzzles. Perfect for both Mahjong fans and anyone looking for a ca
bluejetty:00029162:ios.description:
Enjoy a relaxing Mahjong Solitaire journey with classic tile matching fun. Match identical tiles, clear beautiful boards, and challenge your brain with easy-to-learn Mahjong puzzles. Perfect for both Mahjong fans and anyone looking for a calm, satisfying puzzle game.
How to Play
Double tap two identical tiles to match and remove them from the board.
Only free tiles can be matched. A tile is free when it is not covered and has at least one open side, either on the left or the right.
Clear all tiles from the board to complete the puzzle and move on to the next challenge.
Game Features
Classic Mahjong Solitaire Fun
Enjoy the relaxing fun of classic Mahjong Solitaire. Find Mahjong pairs, match identical tiles, clear the board, and play through beautiful tile layouts that are easy to understand and satisfying to solve.
Calm Tile Match Gameplay
No rush, no pressure. Take your time, look for matching tiles, and enjoy a peaceful Mahjong puzzle whenever you want a short break.
Beautiful Mahjong Layouts
Play through a variety of Mahjong boards, tile patterns, and classic layouts. Each level gives you a new board to explore, new matches to find, and a satisfying puzzle to clear.
Easy to Start, Fun to Keep Playing
The rules are easy: match the same tiles and clear the board. As you play, the puzzles become more interesting, with hidden tiles to uncover and smarter moves to plan.
A Relaxing Brain Game
Mahjong Solitaire is a calm way to keep your mind active. Practice your focus, memory, and strategy as you spot matches, open new tiles, and solve each Mahjong puzzle step by step.
Helpful Boosters
Stuck on a tricky board? Use Hint, Shuffle, Undo, Bomb, or Flashlight to find new matches, fix a move, or keep your Mahjong journey moving.
Daily Mahjong Puzzles
Come back every day for fresh Mahjong puzzles and daily challenges. Match tiles, clear the board, and enjoy a relaxing brain game anytime and anywhere.
If you enjoy Mahjong Solitaire, Mahjong Classic, tile match games, match tiles puzzles, or relaxing puzzle games, Mahjong Solitaire Journey: Tile Match is a great choice for your next puzzle break.
Start matching tiles and enjoy a peaceful Mahjong puzzle adventure today!

bluejetty:00061364:ios.description:
LawnStarter for Providers allows lawn care providers to claim jobs, manage their schedules, and coordinate their crews. This app works in conjunction with LawnStarter's web platform, which allows lawn care companies to claim extra clients on their already existing routes. 
This app uses background geolocation tracking to provide location data that can be interacted with on LawnStarter's web software. On this software providers can track and manage their fleet of individual lawn care crews in real time to see the current status of job completions for a given day. Historical location data is also provided on our web software to help providers make informed decisions about coverage areas and assign jobs in an order that optimizes crews' routes (Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life).

bluejetty:00033895:ios.description:
MORECAST is your FREE premium weather app!
Get precise, hyper-local weather forecasts for your current location and millions of locations worldwide. MORECAST provides hourly forecasts, detailed wind information, rain and snow radar, navigation weather, webcams, and much more.
Whether you’re in New York, Los Angeles, San Francisco, Chicago, or anywhere else in the world, MORECAST helps you stay prepared for changing weather conditions.
Download MORECAST now for FREE!
► Hyper-Local Weather
Get precise weather forecasts down to street level for your current location or favorite places.
MORECAST uses global weather data from more than 28,000 weather stations.
► Rain & Snow Radar
Track precipitation minute by minute with our interactive rain and snow radar.
► Navigation Weather
Check weather conditions and severe weather along your route to help make every trip safer.
► Compare
Compare the weather in two locations side by side and choose the best time or place for your plans.
► Webcams
View live webcams with local temperatures in more than 100,000 locations worldwide.
► Share
Share your best weather moments with friends and family. Join the MORECAST community and contribute local weather reports, alerts, and warnings.
► Weather Graphs
Explore detailed hyper-local forecasts in easy-to-read 24-hour, 3-day, and 7-day weather graphs.
AD-FREE VERSION (SUBSCRIPTION)
Subscribe to the ad-free version to remove advertising (iPhone only).
The yearly subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal can be turned off in your Account Settings after purchase.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account when the purchase is confirmed.
DETAILED WEATHER FORECAST DATA
1. Temperature: Current temperature, daily highs and lows, and hourly forecasts in °F or °C.
2. Wind: Wind direction and speed in mph, km/h, or knots.
3. Precipitation: Minute-by-minute rain and snow forecasts, including probability and precipitation amounts in inches, mm, or l/m².
4. Humidity: Hourly humidity in %.
5. Cloud Cover: Current and forecast cloud cover in %.
6. Sunshine Duration: Expected sunshine for today and the next 7 days.
7. UV Index: Hourly UV index information.
8. Sunrise & Sunset: Sunrise and sunset times for the next 3 days.
9. Air Pressure: Hourly air pressure in hPa and forecasts for the next 7 days.
WHY MORECAST?
MORECAST is an advanced iOS weather app providing comprehensive forecasts, rain radar, and detailed weather information for locations around the world.
MORECAST uses forecast and radar data from national weather services as well as MORECAST Data Centers. Our goal is to provide high-quality meteorological information to help you stay informed about approaching storms, thunderstorms, rain, and snow.

bluejetty:00088270:ios.summary: cred.ai is a high-tech and premium everyday card spending experience, 100% mobile with a free metal card. With the cred.ai guaranty you never pay fees or interest, never overspend, build credit automatically*, and spend your paycheck early*
bluejetty:00088270:ios.description:
cred.ai is a high-tech and premium everyday card spending experience, 100% mobile with a free metal card. With the cred.ai guaranty you never pay fees or interest, never overspend, build credit automatically*, and spend your paycheck early**, with cutting edge tech you can’t get anywhere else like Check Please™ and Flux Capacitor. 100% mobile, 24/7 support, real-time control, and virtual Digital Cards active instantly upon approval. Applying does not impact your FICO score, and a FICO score is not required to apply.
•giving credit where credit is due • 
Your metal unicorn card is a real credit card, but cred.ai™ automation and the cred.ai™ guaranty makes sure you never pay fees or interest and never overspend, and automatically manages your balances to optimize your credit utilization. Spend like you’re using a debit card, and build your credit* like a pro.
• imagine if tony stark built a bank • 
cred.ai™ is a team of builders, scientists, artists, and hackers. That’s why we have exclusive features like Timer Mode, Friend & Foe List™, Digital Card, Check Please™, and Flux Capacitor. This is the most cutting edge way to spend every day.
• won’t break the bank, but could break a window • 
The Unicorn Card weighs more than those other fancy black cards, but you don’t pay a fee to get it. We think it’s the best looking unicorn themed free metal card on earth, but that’s just us.
• the card you carry is metal, but digital card is bulletproof • 
Digital Card is for your more sketch transactions, like ordering pizza over the phone, corn sites, or signing up for free trials. Regenerate Digital Card when you feel unsafe, or use them in Timer Mode for ultimate protection. Use your Digital Card online, over the phone, and in person via your phone’s mobile wallet.
• original content from crednews • 
crednews™ is a team of award winning journalists producing original content about topics we think are important. Why would a fintech make documentaries about UBI and psilocybin? Because we can.
• your bank should never be a piggy • 
Access the spending power of your paycheck and other deposits up to two days before they even hit.** Get cash at over 55,000 free ATMs*** make instant deposits and mobile check deposits at no fee, and all deposits are FDIC insured up to $250,000†. Use Flux Capacitor to automatically protect yourself against future charges and withdrawals.
• boring but true • 
○ cred.ai™ Guaranty to Never Pay Interest Or Fees
○ 24/7 Phones Answered By Humans
○ 55,000+ Free ATMs***
○ Deposits FDIC Insured Up To $250,000†
○ We Will Never Share Your Data
○ PCI DSS & EI3PA Certified
*cred.ai cannot account for all variables in your financial life or changes to reporting practices. Increases or specific changes to your credit score are not guaranteed.
**Accessing your direct deposit funds early depends on the timing and schedule of when the payer submits the deposit. We generally will allow you to access the spending power of those deposits on the day the deposit file is received, which could be up to 2 days prior to the scheduled payment date.
***You can locate free ATMs using the FREE ATM finder located in your cred.ai mobile app. ATM withdrawals are cash advances against the Unicorn Card credit card, and while they are subject to the interest rates and terms outlined in the Unicorn Credit Card Agreement, you will not pay any interest on those cash advances for as long as you have a valid cred.ai guaranty.
†cred.ai is a financial technology company, not a bank. The cred.ai Deposit Account is provided by WSFS Bank, Member FDIC. Deposits are insured up to $250,000 per depositor. FDIC insurance only covers the failure of an FDIC-insured bank. FDIC insurance is available through pass-through insurance at WSFS Bank, Member FDIC, if certain conditions have been met. 
The Unicorn Card credit card is issued by WSFS Bank pursuant to a license from Visa® U.S.A. Inc. and may be used everywhere Visa® credit cards are accepted.

bluejetty:00153764:ios.description:
Saving the world? Again? It must be Tuesday. Dive headfirst into "Mystery of Myths: Hidden Objects", a free-to-play blend of hidden object games, detective games, and epic adventure through two gripping episodes. When myths awaken and reality crumbles, elite agent Elijah Reed is called to action. From chaotic streets of Athens to the icy mists of Norway, you’ll race against ancient evils, uncover truth beneath legend, and find hidden objects that just might stop the apocalypse. Get lost in a world where mystery games aren’t just puzzles—they’re survival!
Elijah Reed, a top agent for the Ministry of Mysteries, is no stranger to danger: survive first, file the paperwork later. But nothing could have prepared him for the chaos in Athens and ancient myths running wild. Harpies are losing their minds, cults are sharpening their knives, and Medusa is ready for a staring contest Elijah would rather not lose. With the Greek god Pan as his sidekick, Agent Reed walks a thin line between legend and reality. The stakes only get higher in the misty fjords of Norway, where mythical monsters terrorize a sleepy town and Ragnarok is penciled in for sometime this week. Between chatting up Valkyries, bartering with magical squirrels, and hopping between realms, Mysteries’ finest will need every trick in his bag if he hopes to survive.
· Greek and Norse Myths!
Navigate secret cults and battle Norse beasts, this is an adventure with exciting myths and mysteries. Designed with the rich lore that hidden object games, detective games, and mystery games fans love, each episode layers thrilling narrative over classic item search games mechanics and tasks you to find hidden objects that truly matter!
· Unravel Ancient Mysteries!
Dive into the heart of Athens and Norway in one of the most engaging hidden object games. Explore enchanting locations filled with secrets and seek and find hidden objects that hold the key to solving the mystery of harpy madness and uncovering the cult's dark plans!
· Challenging Puzzles and Achievements!
Enjoy a mix of hidden object games and brain-teasing puzzles as you uncover clues, piece together ancient secrets, and unlock hidden achievements. The more you explore, the more surprises and rewards you’ll discover!
· Make Choices!
This story-driven adventure lets you influence the outcome of hidden object games. Your choices affect Elijah’s journey, altering character fates and the world’s path. In both episodes, you’ll explore moral dilemmas, manipulate divine artifacts, and navigate tricky alliances —all while you find hidden objects in richly detailed locations!
Find hidden objects and expose ancient secrets in this free-to-play "Mystery of Myths: Hidden Objects" adventure!

Saving the world? Again? It must be Tuesday. Dive headfirst into "Mystery of Myths: Hidden Objects", a free-to-play blend of hidden object games, detective games, and epic adventure through two gripping episodes. When myths awaken and reality crumbles, elite agent Elijah Reed is called to action. From chaotic streets of Athens to the icy mists of Norway, you’ll race against ancient evils, uncover truth beneath legend, and find hidden objects that just might stop the apocalypse. Get lost in a world where mystery games aren’t just puzzles—they’re survival!

Elijah Reed, a top agent for the Ministry of Mysteries, is no stranger to danger: survive first, file the paperwork later. But nothing could have prepared him for the chaos in Athens and ancient myths running wild. Harpies are losing their minds, cults are sharpening their knives, and Medusa is ready for a staring contest Elijah would rather not lose. With the Greek god Pan as his sidekick, Agent Reed walks a thin line between legend and reality. The stakes only get higher in the misty fjords of Norway, where mythical monsters terrorize a sleepy town and Ragnarok is penciled in for sometime this week. Between chatting up Valkyries, bartering with magical squirrels, and hopping between realms, Mysteries’ finest will need every trick in his bag if he hopes to survive.

·	Greek and Norse Myths!
Navigate secret cults and battle Norse beasts, this is an adventure with exciting myths and mysteries. Designed with the rich lore that hidden object games, detective games, and mystery games fans love, each episode layers thrilling narrative over classic item search games mechanics and tasks you to find hidden objects that truly matter!

·	Unravel Ancient Mysteries!
Dive into the heart of Athens and Norway in one of the most engaging hidden object games. Explore enchanting locations filled with secrets and seek and find hidden objects that hold the key to solving the mystery of harpy madness and uncovering the cult's dark plans!

·	Challenging Puzzles and Achievements!
Enjoy a mix of hidden object games and brain-teasing puzzles as you uncover clues, piece together ancient secrets, and unlock hidden achievements. The more you explore, the more surprises and rewards you’ll discover!

·	Make Choices!
This story-driven adventure lets you influence the outcome of hidden object games. Your choices affect Elijah’s journey, altering character fates and the world’s path. In both episodes, you’ll explore moral dilemmas, manipulate divine artifacts, and navigate tricky alliances —all while you find hidden objects in richly detailed locations!

Find hidden objects and expose ancient secrets in this free-to-play "Mystery of Myths: Hidden Objects" adventure!

-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00183599:ios.description:
Uplift Bank Mobile Banking is a more convenient way to access our web banking system. It validates and safely stores your login information, simplifies logging in, and allows you (if enabled) to quickly and securely check up to three account balances from the login screen. 
Features:
1. Use TouchID and FaceID to log into your web banking account (your iPhone must support TouchID and have it set up). 
2. Log out of your web banking session and lock the application with the touch of a button.
3. Quickly check the balances of up to three accounts by tapping the Quick Balance button from the login screen or by using pull-to-refresh.
4. Deposit checks from your phone. This feature may require approval from bank staff before it is enabled.
Please contact your nearest branch or check the terms of service on our website for details.

Minivana: Playful Nest is a charming puzzle-adventure game where you travel the world as a spirited girl with a passion for arranging spaces and discovering hidden treasures.
In every destination, you’ll unlock a new, empty room waiting to be transformed. Arrange items in clever ways to reveal feature symbols hidden within each setting. Every symbol you find represents a piece of the world’s unique cultures, stories, and secrets — from ancient motifs to modern icons.

Travel. Arrange. Discover. Collect.
Can you find every symbol and create your dream nest?
