bluejetty:00128783:ios.description:
Telemundo 48 Área de la Bahía es una app de noticias locales en español, clima y alertas para la comunidad hispana de San Francisco, San José, Oakland y el Área de la Bahía. Mantente informado con noticias de última hora, pronósticos, radar en vivo, alertas meteorológicas, cobertura electoral y transmisiones en vivo.
Recibe cobertura local confiable en una sola app. Sigue noticias de San Francisco, San José, Oakland y Fremont, además de inmigración, política, elecciones, tráfico, seguridad pública, incendios, sismos y clima severo.
Personaliza tus alertas de noticias, clima y elecciones según tu zona.
¿Por qué usar la app de Telemundo 48?
Si vives en San Francisco, San José, Oakland o el Área de la Bahía, Telemundo 48 te ayuda a estar informado de noticias locales, clima, inmigración, elecciones, incendios, sismos y radar en vivo.
¿Qué puedes hacer con la app de Telemundo 48?
Sigue noticias locales del Área de la Bahía
* Recibe alertas de noticias locales, nacionales e internacionales
* Sigue inmigración, política, seguridad pública y tráfico
* Lee artículos y mira videos de Telemundo 48
Sigue las elecciones en el Área de la Bahía y California
* Obtén cobertura de elecciones locales y estatales
* Sigue elecciones de San Francisco, San José, Oakland y California
* Infórmate sobre primarias, elecciones de medio término y presidenciales
* Consulta candidatos, medidas electorales, información para votantes y resultados
Consulta el tiempo para el Área de la Bahía
* Mira condiciones actuales y alertas meteorológicas
* Accede al pronóstico de 10 días para tu zona
* Consulta pronósticos por hora
Usa los widgets del tiempo
* Agrega widgets a tu pantalla de inicio
* Ve condiciones actuales según tu zona
* Toca el widget para ver el pronóstico completo
Sigue el tiempo con radar en vivo
* Accede a radar en tiempo real
* Sigue cambios del tiempo en San Francisco, San José y Oakland
* Guarda zonas y configura alertas meteorológicas
* Consulta alertas de incendios, sismos, tormentas y calor
Mira Telemundo 48 en vivo
* Ve noticieros y cobertura en vivo de Telemundo 48
* Accede a videos locales y entretenimiento
* Mira streams de eventos importantes
Mantente informado durante eventos importantes
* Sigue incendios, sismos, tormentas, calor y emergencias
* Recibe actualizaciones de tráfico y seguridad pública
* Mira conferencias de prensa y cobertura en vivo
* Recibe lo último de elecciones, inmigración y noticias en desarrollo
Consulta Telemundo 48 Responde
* Accede a investigaciones y reportajes locales
* Sigue historias de ayuda al consumidor
¿Para quién es la app de Telemundo 48?
Telemundo 48 es para personas en San Francisco, San José, Oakland, Fremont, Santa Clara, Palo Alto, Berkeley, Hayward y Sunnyvale que buscan noticias locales en español, clima, radar en vivo, tráfico, inmigración, elecciones y alertas.
¿Cuándo debes usar la app de Telemundo 48?
Usa la app para recibir noticias del Área de la Bahía, consultar el pronóstico y radar en vivo, seguir incendios, sismos y clima severo, ver noticieros, informarte sobre inmigración y seguir elecciones locales, primarias, elecciones de medio término, presidenciales y resultados.

Sí. Personaliza alertas del Área de la Bahía, titulares locales, inmigración, clima, tráfico, elecciones y noticias urgentes.
¿Puedo seguir las elecciones del Área de la Bahía y California?
Sí. Sigue elecciones locales y estatales, primarias, elecciones de medio término y presidenciales. Consulta candidatos, medidas electorales, información para votantes y resultados.
¿Puedo ver Telemundo 48 en vivo en la app?
Sí. Puedes ver noticieros en vivo de Telemundo 48, cobertura urgente, cobertura electoral y videos locales.

listings.description:

Mantente informado con noticias de última hora, pronósticos, radar en vivo, alertas meteorológicas, cobertura electoral y transmisiones en vivo.

Recibe cobertura local confiable en una sola app. Sigue noticias de San Francisco, San José, Oakland y Fremont, además de inmigración, política, elecciones, tráfico, seguridad pública, incendios, sismos y clima severo.

Personaliza tus alertas de noticias, clima y elecciones según tu zona.

¿Por qué usar la app de Telemundo 48?

Si vives en San Francisco, San José, Oakland o el Área de la Bahía, Telemundo 48 te ayuda a estar informado de noticias locales, clima, inmigración, elecciones, incendios, sismos y radar en vivo.

¿Qué puedes hacer con la app de Telemundo 48?

Sigue noticias locales del Área de la Bahía

* Recibe alertas de noticias locales, nacionales e internacionales
* Sigue inmigración, política, seguridad pública y tráfico
* Lee artículos y mira videos de Telemundo 48

Sigue las elecciones en el Área de la Bahía y California

* Obtén cobertura de elecciones locales y estatales
* Sigue elecciones de San Francisco, San José, Oakland y California
* Infórmate sobre primarias, elecciones de medio término y presidenciales
* Consulta candidatos, medidas electorales, información para votantes y resultados

Consulta el tiempo para el Área de la Bahía

* Mira condiciones actuales y alertas meteorológicas
* Accede al pronóstico de 10 días para tu zona
* Consulta pronósticos por hora

Usa los widgets del tiempo

* Agrega widgets a tu pantalla de inicio
* Ve condiciones actuales según tu zona
* Toca el widget para ver el pronóstico completo

Sigue el tiempo con radar en vivo

* Accede a radar en tiempo real
* Sigue cambios del tiempo en San Francisco, San José y Oakland
* Guarda zonas y configura alertas meteorológicas
* Consulta alertas de incendios, sismos, tormentas y calor

Mira Telemundo 48 en vivo

* Ve noticieros y cobertura en vivo de Telemundo 48
* Accede a videos locales y entretenimiento
* Mira streams de eventos importantes

Mantente informado durante eventos importantes

* Sigue incendios, sismos, tormentas, calor y emergencias
* Recibe actualizaciones de tráfico y seguridad pública
* Mira conferencias de prensa y cobertura en vivo
* Recibe lo último de elecciones, inmigración y noticias en desarrollo

Consulta Telemundo 48 Responde

* Accede a investigaciones y reportajes locales
* Sigue historias de ayuda al consumidor

¿Para quién es la app de Telemundo 48?

Telemundo 48 es para personas en San Francisco, San José, Oakland, Fremont, Santa Clara, Palo Alto, Berkeley, Hayward y Sunnyvale que buscan noticias locales en español, clima, radar en vivo, tráfico, inmigración, elecciones y alertas.

¿Cuándo debes usar la app de Telemundo 48?

Usa la app para recibir noticias del Área de la Bahía, consultar el pronóstico y radar en vivo, seguir incendios, sismos y clima severo, ver noticieros, informarte sobre inmigración y seguir elecciones locales, primarias, elecciones de medio término, presidenciales y resultados.

¿Puedo recibir alertas de noticias del Área de la Bahía?

Sí. Personaliza alertas del Área de la Bahía, titulares locales, inmigración, clima, tráfico, elecciones y noticias urgentes.

¿Puedo seguir las elecciones del Área de la Bahía y California?

Sí. Sigue elecciones locales y estatales, primarias, elecciones de medio término y presidenciales. Consulta candidatos, medidas electorales, información para votantes y resultados.

¿Puedo ver Telemundo 48 en vivo en la app?

Sí. Puedes ver noticieros en vivo de Telemundo 48, cobertura urgente, cobertura electoral y videos locales.

bluejetty:00024443:ios.description:
*** Educational game for preschoolers "RMB Knowledge Park 1" with more than 200 objects to learn for children from 1 year and older.
*** The game includes more than 40 funny levels containing over 200 items and animals with increasing difficulty in the levels.
*** Each level is voiced by a native speaker to help the child hear the correct pronunciation and learn new words.
The games will help your boys and girls to:
• learn counting
• learn how to identify groups of objects and sort them
• learn the alphabet and new words
• learn how to make simple words
• study the basic colors and shapes
• develop new talents, creativity, and motor skills
This is the best game that children love so much!
Millions of children and mothers around the world have praised our games!
These games are very useful for children from 1 year and older, for kindergartens and preschool institutions. 
Welcome to the new adventure educational game “RMB Knowledge Park” for children from 1 year old and older, together with funny heroes loved by the whole world:
• Fluffy Chick !
• Glamorous Kitty !
• Cool Panda !
• Clever Heron !
• Funny Pig !
• Friendly Dog !
• Cute Rabbit !
Friends!!! Join us faster and we will go to the first theme park in the beautiful city of San Francisco by the ocean, mountains, and forests; with many museums, sweets, and ice cream.
Guys, do you want a prize !!? Then, help the heroes solve different puzzles by visiting a fun educational park with 4 exciting themed zones:
• "World of Numbers",
• "World of Coloring",
• "World of Alphabet",
• "World of Shapes".
In the "World of Numbers" mini-game, your child will play 12 exciting educational levels together with funny characters to learn how to count.
There are many different places for interesting learning:
• "Funny Factory Pizza", where your child will independently choose the ingredients and decide which pizza he wants to cook
• "Foods Heroes", where your child will independently place orders for hamburgers, chicken, donuts, and treats for his friends
• "Funny Number Quiz", where your child selects the correct number in numerical order and quickly counts further
In the "World of Coloring" mini-game, the child will play 12 exciting creative levels together with funny characters to easily get acquainted with colors and sounds as well as:
• play with their own drawings
• save the photo in the gallery or share it with friends
In the "World of Alphabet" mini-game, the child will play 15 exciting educational levels that will easily introduce him to letters, new words together with funny characters to visit and compete in:
• "Extreme Ski Race", where they will slide down a steep and beautiful slope, quickly find the correct letter of the alphabet and try to win this race!
• "Funny fishing", where cute ducks swim with letters in envelopes, from which you need to make a word and quickly assemble puzzles;
• "Magic Beach" - children will solve several puzzles from cards that depict letters and various fruits, vegetables, animals, insects;
• "Interesting Photoshoot" in nature with pets and wild animals.
In the "World of Shapes" mini-game, the child will play in 12 exciting levels and will easily get acquainted with colors, shapes, sizes and, together with funny characters, will visit:
• "Ice Cream Museum",
• "Candy Museum",
• "Dino Museum",
• "Toys Museum",
• "Funny Smiling Shapes",
• "Space Photoshoot",
• "Funny Running on Mud"
Pay attention to how children learn! Babies and toddlers can have fun for a long time without stress and time limit.
We are constantly adding new educational games to our application stores around the world, which you can find on our website: https://rmbgames.com/
Join us, subscribe to our pages on social media. Enjoy our Games and Premium Clothes & Accessories for Children, Men and Women:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rmb_games/
Shop Online: https://rmbgames.com/shop/
Thanks to everyone who plays our games and appreciates them!
RMB Games

More than just an innovative puzzle game, ScrewScapes is a test of skill, patience, and intellect that combines 3D graphics, strategic gameplay, and beaut
bluejetty:00167788:ios.description:
Welcome to Screw Scapes, a unique world of solving puzzles and unraveling everything!
More than just an innovative puzzle game, ScrewScapes is a test of skill, patience, and intellect that combines 3D graphics, strategic gameplay, and beautiful art design to create a truly captivating screwing experience.
Unscrew the colorful screws in the correct order, place the removed screws in the same color box for storage, and remove the intricate plastic panels bit by bit. Simply a boon for OCD sufferers! It's so healing!
Game Features:
- Engaging Brain Game: Featuring countless levels ranging from easy to difficult, it offers a variety of innovative obstacles and mind-stimulating puzzles to challenge your logical thinking and dexterity.
- Relaxing but challenging: The levels are attractively designed and you can look for various clues and use many strategies to solve the screw puzzles.
- ASMR Experience: Immerse yourself in the exciting ASMR sounds of removing screws and nuts and bolts clashing, complemented by a soothing musical score.
- Competitive Leaderboards: You have the opportunity to compete with players from all over the world to see where you can rank!
- Countless mini-games: When you are tired of playing, there are many exquisite mini-games for you to experience!
- Suitable for all ages: It has a smooth gaming experience, beautiful 3D graphics, vibrant colors, and is easy to control and play.
So, are you ready for the challenge? Let's dive into the world of vibrant puzzles in this captivating screw game. Download Screw Scapes now and start unraveling mechanical mysteries today!

We will be so happy if you and someone you know who both enjoy using it.

This is an alternate world. The falling meteor failed to destroy everything, but a cruel plague swept this land.
Mutated and corrupted beasts roar under the shadows of towering trees.
Lead the dinosaurs and explore the world together!
Features:
◆ Relaxing Idle Gameplay
Non-grinding auto-battles with dynamic and exciting combat animations. Every strike will make you thrilled!
◆ Exciting Looting
Defeat enemies and get dropped equipment instantly. See if the next piece of equipment will shine with legendary brilliance!

A wide variety of attributes and skills are available for you to choose and match. Build your own power to carve out your path and enjoy your unique battle experience!
◆ Satisfying Growth
Defeat monsters to gain EXP. Upgrade and advance at any time. Each step of growth brings noticeable power and damage increases!
◆ Rich Content
Various monsters, all sorts of challenges, and well-designed development systems allow you to have a fantastic gaming experience!
◆ Unique World
Bright and beautiful game screens of Celtic style present a world of primal natural landscapes where mysterious dinosaurs coexist with mutated beasts.

bluejetty:00168925:ios.description:
Vivid Color: Where Creativity Blooms and Colors Dance
Step into the enchanting realm of "Vivid Color," a coloring experience that goes beyond the ordinary. Immerse yourself in a world where each stroke of your virtual brush unveils a masterpiece waiting to be discovered. From intricate patterns to whimsical scenes, let your creativity flourish in a kaleidoscope of hues.
A Symphony of Features:
- Artistic Diversity: "Vivid Color" offers an extensive array of illustrations catering to every taste and mood. Discover detailed mandalas that challenge your precision, cute animals that warm your heart, and breathtaking landscapes that transport you to otherworldly realms. The diversity of designs ensures there's something for everyone.
- Infinite Color Possibilities: Dive into a sea of colors with an expansive palette that spans the entire spectrum. Unleash your imagination by experimenting with gradients, patterns, and textures. Whether you prefer a pastel dream or a bold burst of energy, "Vivid Color" empowers you to create a visual symphony that reflects your mood.
- Intuitive Controls: Enjoy a seamless coloring experience with an interface designed for both novices and seasoned artists. Effortlessly navigate through tools, brushes, and color options. The user-friendly design ensures that the focus remains on your artistic expression rather than grappling with complex controls.
- Sensory Bliss: Immerse yourself fully with a sensory-rich experience. The soothing background music and gentle sound effects create an ambiance that enhances your creative flow. Feel the virtual brush gliding over the canvas as you bring your artwork to life.
- Storytelling Through Colors: Each illustration tells a story, and with "Vivid Color," you're the storyteller. Let your emotions guide your palette, turning the canvas into a reflection of your feelings, thoughts, and dreams. Share the stories behind your creations and connect with a community that values the narrative in every stroke.
How to Craft Your Masterpiece:
- Explore the Gallery: Discover a treasure trove of designs. From enchanting florals to abstract wonders, find the perfect canvas that resonates with your artistic spirit.
- Paint with Passion: Experiment with a variety of brushes and tools to add depth and detail. Create gradients, blend colors, and let your creativity run wild. The canvas is your playground, and every stroke is an expression of your unique style.
- Gallery Showcase: Save your creations to your personal gallery and curate a collection that reflects your artistic evolution. Share your gallery with friends and marvel at the vibrant spectrum of your creativity.
Download "Vivid Color" and Paint Your Imagination to Life!
Embark on a journey where colors become the language of your soul. "Vivid Color" invites you to break free from the mundane and embrace a world where every color tells a story. Download now and let your imagination bloom in the most vivid hues imaginable!

In Vivid Color we offer you the following two subscription options:

3. A yearly subscription costs $59.99 (or equivalent in your currency) per year.
After buying the subscriptions, you will remove the non-optional banner and interstitial adverts from the game. In addition, you'll get unlimited hints, and remove watermarks from all completed pictures.

https://home.xlearning.group/terms_of_services.html

bluejetty:00174971:ios.summary: Work out smarter, not harder. obé cuts the guesswork and helps you look forward to moving your body—for good. Take a quiz to share your fitness goals, we’ll create a personalized, progressive at-home workout plan for you to follow (in minut
bluejetty:00174971:ios.description:
Work out smarter, not harder. obé cuts the guesswork and helps you look forward to moving your body—for good. Take a quiz to share your fitness goals, we’ll create a personalized, progressive at-home workout plan for you to follow (in minutes!). 
Like to do your own thing? Try out 20+ class types across 10,000+ on-demand classes with options from HIIT, Dance Cardio, and Boxing to Strength, Pilates, Sculpt, and more. Go for a progressive training program when you’re ready for something new (like learning Yoga or running a 5K), or reset your fitness routine with a 7-14 day challenge. 
Designed for women and their unique needs, obé is built to boost your body literacy and help you fall in love with movement. Explore features like cycle syncing workouts, class suggestions based on mood, Express options for busy days, and more. 
Try the obé workout app free for 7 days!
—------------
WORKOUT PLANS AS UNIQUE AS YOU: obé builds you a personalized, data-informed fitness plan based on your history, preferences, and the way you form habits. You’ll always have 2 weeks' worth of classes on your schedule with the flexibility to skip or move them around. 
20+ CLASS TYPES: Bye, boring exercise. Build your foundation with strength, sweat it out with cardio, and unwind with recovery. Filter classes by duration, equipment type, body focus, impact, level, or music type to find your perfect match. 
Sculpt | Strength | Dance Exercise | Pilates | Yoga | HIIT | Barre | Stretch | Cardio Boxing | Bounce | Ride | Step | Meditation | Run | Breathwork | Endurance | Foam Roll | Walk | Yoga Sculpt | Prenatal Workout | Kids Workout 
ONE-STOP FITNESS FOR WOMEN: Discover what works best for your body with cycle syncing, cycle tracking + insights, pelvic floor exercises, wellness practices, strength training for women, prenatal + postnatal workouts, and more. 
SUPERCHARGE YOUR HEALTH: Our class plans and programs can change your body composition, boost cardiovascular health, balance hormone health, and slow aging while boosting longevity. Tap into activity metrics, heart health stats, and more with Health Connect plus your wearable device. 
MASTER NEW SKILLS: Whether you’re ready to take up running, build a Yoga practice, try Pilates, or lose weight sustainably (spoiler: strength training is key!), our workout Programs and Challenges mix work with play to set you up for success.
PERSONAL TRAINING: Need more accountability? Add personal training to your membership for one-on-one support. We’ll match you with an exercise coach who’ll fine-tune your plan, check in regularly, and keep you motivated for the long haul.
IMPROVE YOUR MOOD: Need a mood boost? Log your daily mood, and we’ll recommend classes depending on how you’re feeling (or want to feel) that day.
TAKE CLASSES ANYWHERE: Do your daily workout at home, in the gym, on the trail, or at a rest stop. With obé, you can download classes to your offline library, tune in anywhere there’s service, or go for audio-guided options when you want to be hands-free. 
JOIN THE MOVEMENT: More than 60% of U.S. women don’t get enough exercise. Some of the reasons? Not knowing where to start, thinking fitness is all-or-nothing (thanks, diet culture), juggling endless responsibilities, and being told we all build habits the same way. obé is here to change that. 
A subscription is required to use the obé app. Sign up for an auto-renewable monthly or annual subscription to access all live and on-demand video content. Payment for this plan will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, at the cost of the monthly or annual plan that you subscribed to. Auto-renewal may be turned off in your Account Setting in iTunes after purchase. Terms of Service: https://www.obefitness.com/terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00026697:ios.description:
Babylist is the universal registry app with everything to help expecting parents plan, prepare and shop for their growing family.
With the Babylist app, the experience goes far beyond registry building, offering a weekly pregnancy tracker, price comparison across multiple retailers, a personalized checklist to help build a registry, helpful guides and resources about all the best expert and parent-approved baby gear, sales and deals from the best brands in the curated Babylist shop and more. The Babylist app grows with your family thanks to features like birthday and holiday wish lists, developmental toy suggestions, and milestone emails. Plus, you’ll find baby name inspiration to help you make your perfect pick. 
With the Babylist app, you can:
ADD ANY ITEM FROM ANY STORE TO YOUR REGISTRY - AND COMPARE PRICES! 
Our universal registry makes it easy to add items from your favorite stores including Amazon, Target, Etsy, Crate & Kids, Carters, Nordstrom, H&M, and Walmart– just to name a few. Plus, you can quickly combine and transfer registries you’ve already started so you can have everything you need all in one place. 
EASY FOR FRIENDS & FAMILY TO SHOP YOUR REGISTRY 
A stress-free and streamlined way to let your loved ones know what you want (and need)! With Babylist, friends and family can compare prices across multiple retailers and select where they want to purchase gifts. They can even contribute to group gifts, cash funds, or favors like home-cooked meals or help walking your pup.
DISCOVER 100s of GUIDES AND RESOURCES
Prepare for your baby to arrive with editorial guides that cover all your questions about how to build a registry, early parenthood and pregnancy. You’ll also get insights from our experts to help you pick the best strollers, car seats, carriers and more.
FIND THE BEST BABY GEAR
With over 8,000 expert-selected and real-parent-tested items, you’ll find great gear and top-rated baby products from brands like UPPAbaby, Nuna, Graco, Pampers, Lovevery, Frida, BabyBjorn, and hundreds more. Plus, find Babylist exclusives like try-it boxes for the most popular bottles, pacifiers, diapers, swaddles and more. 
Download the Babylist registry app now!
REAL REVIEWS FROM BABYLIST USERS
“Babylist makes it very easy to register for an upcoming baby shower. My friends and family loved being able to see everything in one place. Great app!"
“This app isn’t just a registry app that you download... No, you are downloading articles, other parent’s stories, and even the “what to do if...” newsletters.”
“Navigating pregnancy for the first time and of course having a baby is overwhelming but this app has been my go-to.”
"Babylist is so much more than a registry, they become a part of your journey into parenthood."
ABOUT US
In 2011, we created Babylist with one key goal: to build a better baby registry experience that truly puts parents first. Today, more than 9 million people make purchase decisions on Babylist each year. Babylist is the most trusted, go-to solution for growing families. 
DISCOUNTS AND OFFERS
• 15% multi-use registry discount in the Babylist Shop before and after your new baby arrives 
• Get a FREE premium Hello Baby Box when you complete your Babylist Registry setup
• Enjoy free shipping on orders over $45 from the Babylist Shop.
• Get free registry insert cards to let people know you’re registered at Babylist. 
PRIVACY PROTECTION

Terms of Service: https://www.babylist.com/terms
Your health data will never be sold or disclosed.
The Babylist app provides information for educational and entertainment purposes only. We do not accept any responsibility for any liability, loss or risk, personal or otherwise, incurred as a consequence, directly or indirectly, from any information or advice contained here. Hello new friends!
We’re so happy to finally launch whoo, and are grateful to all those who helped us during our test run.
We set out to make an app that was better than other location sharing apps on the market. There are many of them out there, yet we felt that they all lacked that certain something. But why is that?
The answer is simple - they aren’t any fun!
They look the same, and offer the same standard location sharing features.
whoo is different from other apps. We believe it’s important to have fun, and so we’ve packed a lot of fun into whoo. But whoo isn’t just a fun app, it’s also sleek, easy-to-use, and addictive, and we’re sure you’ll agree!
It’s never too late to start your adventure with us. 
See you on whoo!

bluejetty:00045145:ios.description:
With the Consultant App, you can easily share your way to success with tools that create word-of-mouth buzz and complement belly-to-belly efforts! Connect with new contacts and interact with your team by sharing exclusive, corporate-approved tools. You’ll have a vast array of marketing materials like videos, images, and more—all right at your fingertips! The powerful, yet beautifully simple design, along with compelling tools, makes growing your business simpler than ever.

bluejetty:00132544:ios.summary:

 FEATURES

**Onl
bluejetty:00132544:ios.description:
Ludo is a classic dice and race game, played with four pieces per house and a set of dice.
 FEATURES
More boards added: you can choose among three colourful boards.(use the more button from the first screen to access this feature). 
**Online multiplayer: you can play with any of you friends or family members any where in the world from the comfort of your home.
**Visual hand added
**Online Multiplayer supported
**Bluetooth multiplayer supported
**Difficulty level added(Easy, Normal, Hard and Advanced)
**Speed control added. You can control how fast a Piece move.
**You can enable or disable barrier
**You can enable or disable safe-house
**You can position board the way you like
**You can choose to play with one die or two dice
**You can decide to remove a piece when it captures opponent's piece or not
**You can decided to play again when you capture opponent's piece irrespective of the outcome.
All these features are accessible through Options.
--------SUPPORTED LANGUAGES------
** English
** French
** Italian
** Indonesian
** German
** Portuguese
** Spanish
------------HOW TO PLAY--------------
Ludo is a classic dice and race game, played with four pieces per player and a set of dice. This Ludo currently support two players with two houses each. In this game, each player controls eight pieces. The goal of the game is to move all eight pieces home before your opponent.
------------MOVEMENT OF PIECE--------
A player with red house starts the game (in a case of winning, the loser starts the game with red house).
A piece can only come out of house when a die outcome is 6 but a piece that is already on the track can move with any dice outcome. Pieces travel through the track starting from home to the middle of the board. A track contains 56 steps.
A piece can only be removed if it successfully travels through the 56 steps or if it captures opponent's piece.
----------------PIECE CAPTURE-------------------
A player's piece can capture opponent's piece if it ends in a block that is occupied by an opponent's. The captured piece must be returned home while the player's piece is removed from the board.
The secret of the game is to capture your opponent's piece as many as possible and avoid being captured by your opponent's piece.
A piece cannot capture opponent's piece if the remaining outcome cannot be used.
----------IMPORTANT NOTE-----------
1. A player can only roll dice twice consecutively or more as far as each dice outcome is 6 (first dice outcome = 6 and second dice outcome = 6).
2. Dice outcome must be played before rolling another one no matter the outcome.
3. For fast and smooth play, go to settings and turn on DIRECT COUNT.

bluejetty:00147058:ios.description:
IMPORTANT NOTE: This app is compatible only with SD-7000T1.
For additional information about T-Mobile SyncUP DRIVE please visit: https://www.t-mobile.com/iot-devices/syncup-drive-connected-car
For further assistance with T-Mobile SyncUP DRIVE, please visit https://support.t-mobile.com/community/contact-us/, or reach out via Twitter to @tmobilehelp, call 611 or 1-877-746-0909.
The T-Mobile SyncUP DRIVE app helps you keep your family safe, secure, and connected at all times. Get peace of mind about your cars and the people in them with T-Mobile SyncUP DRIVE.
NOTE: A SyncUP DRIVE OBD-II device, compatible vehicle, capable smartphone, and data plan are required to install and use the T-Mobile SyncUP DRIVE app. To check vehicle compatibility, please visit https://www.t-mobile.com/offers/syncup
T-Mobile SyncUP DRIVE provides the following features for customers:
WI-FI HOTSPOT
• Access America’s fastest nationwide 4G LTE network* from your in-car Wi-Fi hotspot
• Connect up to 5 devices to your in-car Wi-Fi hotspot
• Easily manage your in-car Wi-Fi hotspot and modify network details like SSID and password
FAMILY SAFETY
• Keep an eye on your loved ones without creating dangerous distractions.
• GPS enabled to locate your vehicles in real-time
• Check the location and status of multiple vehicles without contacting the drivers
• Receive alerts when the driver or passenger are not wearing their seatbelts
• Create virtual boundaries to get notified when your vehicles arrive and depart from common locations
VEHICLE SAFETY
• With real-time vehicle notifications about car trouble, T-Mobile SyncUP DRIVE works like a virtual mechanic to help keep your family safe.
• Know your fuel level**, battery voltage, and brake fluid levels before you hit the road
• Get alerts when your car’s battery is getting low
• Understand what’s wrong with your car so you can take action
• Quickly find nearby mechanics to get the help you need
ROADSIDE ASSISTANCE
• Need roadside assistance? You will get four roadside services you help when you need roadside assistance.***
VEHICLE SECURITY
• Help keep your car secure, even when you’re not with it
• Never forget where you’ve parked again with GPS location
• Get alerted if your parked car has been bumped or disturbed or if your device has been unplugged
• Track your car’s real-time driving loc

Discover a world where popping bubbles becomes a relaxing ritual. Let your mind rest as you gently tap, match, and clear colorful bubbles in beautifully crafted levels. No pressure. No rush. Just satisfying, mindful gameplay.
How to Play:
Tap to launch bubbles and match three or more of the same color
Clear all bubbles to complete the level
Use intuitive tools to pass through more thoughtful challenges
Features:
Soft, gentle visuals designed to ease visual stress
Over 20000 thoughtfully built levels with a calming difficulty curve
No countdowns or rush, play at your own pace
Works offline, perfect for breaks, travel, or quiet moments
Soothing sound design and smooth animations
Special tools and boosters to help you flow through puzzles
Whether you're taking a break, looking for a calm way to pass the time, or easing into your evening, Bubble Relax: Pop Shooter offers a tranquil bubble popping experience for puzzle lovers who needs a little peace.
Download now and enjoy moments of calm pop time.

bluejetty:00153782:android.description:
The best football game is here! The mobile football game of the official Kings League!
Enjoy now the fc Kings League Clash of Captains for free!
Are you ready to be the best football manager and win the soccer league with your online efootball team? You will compete against other football manager of the fantasy league to obtain the victory and become the online soccer star, to become the best manager with live sports.
To win a fantasy league more difficult than the MLS, you will compete vs others football managers at Kings League Clash of Captains and their soccer stars team: bai Llanos, Gerard Piqué, Kun Aguero, xBuyer Team, TheGrefg, Iker Casillas,,DjMaRiiO, Jijantes FC, Aniquiladores FC and more soccer stars. The football league will be harder than the Premier League!
Use the fantasy Kings League rules in your favor during the football games and get the best soccer scores, choose between different soccer cards to use: penalti card, x2 gol…and become the fantasy soccer crack. Use the football fantasy sports cards and reach the final rounds!
Kings League Clash of Captains is looking for the best captain on online soccer games.You will compete vs your friends at the fantasy league and people around the world because the free sports app is a multiplayer football soccer game. Could you defeat your fantasy football rivals in live football games? The best highlights will appear at the official Kings League football tv… so be the best mister in the dream league so as not to be humiliated.
Every football game day in Kings League Clash of Captains will be thrilling so share the sports news with your sport friends and play with them. Feel the emotion with the live soccer fantasy!
Every sport game week there will be new events, missions, the world cup tournament, live games… where just the champions league ones will get the victory. Do you obtain the best football stats? Don´t miss any sports game! 
You will be the captain of your sport team and due to that, you will adapt the strategy and tactics according to the superpower of your players. Study your sport rivals to get advantage on the field and conquer the best football scores.
To be competitive you need the best football players, use the draft to get the best ones and play fantasy games! Answer this question during the draft, what do you need to reach the best soccer stats?
Choose your favorite stadium and play: 1K FC, Kunisports… better than real fifa or uefa stadiums!
You need an internet connection on your mobile to enjoy the best sports app, even if your device is small you will feel the emotion of the mini football or mini soccer. Remember, it is not an American football game.
As captain, choose your top eleven and enjoy the best fantasy sports since pes!
Moreover, you can participate in raffles and get amazing rewards: football cards, free league pass to the finals and much more! Follow us on the game´s official social networks so you don´t miss anything!
Kings League Clash of Captains is your favorite manager football game and it will always be a free sport game.
The best league fantasy awaits you.

bluejetty:00071759:ios.description:
Worm game is an addicting puzzle game in which you have to rescue fruits from pests. This is a real brain teaser, where you will have to complete levels with color worms of various difficulties. Puzzle for kids will delight you with a variety of tasks and will definitely not let you get bored!
Games and simple brain teaser for kids are fun. Logic games about worms may seem monotonous and boring to you, but they are not! Of course, such puzzle for kids is perfect for the little ones, because this is a kind of brain test. A child can develop their strategic thinking by thinking through their own victory plan. Fruits & worms are understandable characters, there will be no difficulties with understanding the functionality. We recommend installing the Worm game for children from the age of four. At this age, a child will be able to play high-quality games on the phone and logic games about worms & fruits is no exception.
This is a real brain teaser, download worm games and see for yourself!
What is a puzzle game?
Our Tricky puzzle is a colorful game in which you have to pull a worm and snakes out of an apple or other food. The worms are not as stupid as they might seem. With each level there will be more of them, and they will grasp the victim more strongly. And also, depending on the complexity of the level, you will be offered different ways to get rid of pests. Find, grab, pull out! Simple brain teaser for kids is actually very easy to understand!
Determine for yourself the best winning strategy to beat the worm games as soon as possible. Fruits & worms are already waiting for you.
Worm game is made with a nice and bright interface, but it will not distract you from completing the levels. Every user, even the youngest, will understand the functionality exactly.
Who is our brain test suitable for?
Since this is very simple puzzle game, we thought of it as puzzle for kids. While you are busy with your own business, children have fun on their own, without giving you any trouble. This puzzle with fruits for children is a real find for parents. But if you want to complete the brain test yourself, you can also appreciate the number of levels, the variety of colors and many obstacles. Who doesn't love worm logic games?! Fruits & worms can quickly win the sympathy of both the smallest and adult gamers.
Simple jigsaw puzzles for children are also suitable in order to just while away your evening or the waiting process. After all, each of us will benefit from such a brain puzzle. Solving puzzles is of great benefit to a person at any stage of his life. The training of logic, memory allows not only to successfully solve puzzles for kids, but also to find the right solutions in difficult life situations. Such logic games develop spatial thinking very well.
Worm game is a puzzle game for kids and adults. Test your strategic thinking in a pest control. Fruits & worms are already waiting for you for an exciting brain test game!

bluejetty:00154069:ios.description:
Welcome to Retain – the AI-powered flashcard app that turns your personal learning materials into effective study tools. Whether you're in school, university, or pursuing self-learning, Retain helps you study faster, retain more, and stay on track.
How it works:
1. Upload your study material (PDF/image/video)
2. Verify the AI-generated flashcards
3. Select desired grade and exam date
4. Follow your personalized learning plan
What you can do with Retain:
→ Automatically generate flashcards from PDFs, slides, and handwritten notes.
→ Convert YouTube videos and online lectures into flashcards.
→ Set your exam date and goal and receive a personalized flashcard learning plan.
→ Track your daily study goals and visualize your progress.
→ Import Anki decks and sync learning progress across devices.
→ Use spaced repetition and active recall to improve long-term memory.
→ Share flashcard decks with friends or study groups.
Retain is based on the latest findings in learning science and artificial intelligence, using proven methods like spaced repetition and active recall. This gives you a focused, efficient learning experience tailored to your progress.
For anyone who wants to cut their study time in half:
Whether you're preparing for your next exam or learning a new topic – Retain helps you make the most of your study time. Just follow the daily assigned flashcard reviews to achieve your desired grade on exam day.
Terms of Service: https://app.retain.cards/terms
Privacy Policy: https://app.retain.cards/privacy

bluejetty:00184405:ios.description:
Trapped in a VR world powered by an ancient handheld device, you are forced to endlessly dream in a pixel world of just 4 colours! Doves have taken roost in your prison and though you don’t know it they are the key to your survival. The Doves subconsciously inspire dreams of flight, so take to the skies through the mazes of your imagination and find the exit.
Intuitive two button gameplay is all you need to steer your way through the sky. Fly through each stage and reach the exit. Get doves to follow you for extra bonus bragging rights on Game Center and Social Networking stuff. If walls aren’t enough challenge you may enjoy the variety of traps that get rapidly added including, moving walls, speed boost zones, growing walls and more!
By the team that brought you the award winning mobile hit Icebreaker: A Viking Voyage.
Features: 
• Expanded from the hit #Nitromejam game! 
• 3 level packs each with a different dream theme! (Sweet Dreams, Deep Sleep & Nightmare).
• A unique world realised in 4 Colours! (Great for that Game boy nostalgia fix)
• Don’t worry parents this game contains no In app purchases! 
• Stunning Pixel Art from the award winning Nitrome studio! 
• Simple two button gameplay, perfect for a touch screen!
Important Message for Parents
This game may include:
- Direct links to social networking websites that are intended for an audience over the age of 13.
- Direct links to the internet that can take players away from the game with the potential to browse any web page.
- Cross promotion of Nitrome products.

bluejetty:00011563:android.description:
"Rich Girl’s Secret Crush Story – A Romantic Journey of Choices & Emotions 💘
Step into Rich Girl’s Secret Crush Story, an engaging romance adventure filled with heartfelt moments, stylish makeovers, and meaningful choices. Follow the story of a fashionable girl who secretly falls for someone special—and help her navigate emotions, surprises, and second chances in the world of love.
From pajama parties and text conversations to movie outings, elegant dinners, and creative surprises, every chapter brings new activities and emotional twists that keep you hooked. 💞✨
🌸 A Crush Story Filled With Heartfelt Moments
A girl secretly admires her colleague but struggles to express her feelings.
When she finally gathers the courage to confess, things don’t go as hoped.
Over time, he realizes her importance and begins trying to win her heart back through thoughtful gestures and romantic efforts.
You guide both sides of the story through choices, style, and creativity.
🌟 What You’ll Explore in This Romance Game
💕 1. Girls’ Pajama Fun
- Share secrets
- Talk about crush feelings
- Style cute outfits for cozy moments
🎬 2. Cute Crush Interactions
- Chat and plan a casual hangout
- Buy movie tickets, popcorn & snacks
- Enjoy sweet moments during the film
💍 3. Confession & Emotional Twist
- Choose the perfect date outfit
- Prepare a heartfelt proposal scene
- Experience an unexpected rejection
💌 4. Heartfelt Apology & Second Chance
- Help him design a sorry card & romantic bouquet
- Dress up for a special dinner
- Explore gift shopping & jewelry picking
🏕️ 5. Adventure Trip Together
- Prepare luggage and essentials
- Set up tents, campfire & outdoor activities
- Capture warm memories together
💄 Core Gameplay Features
👗 Fashion dress-up & makeover choices
💬 Story-based texting & emotional decisions
🎁 Gift selection, jewelry shopping & crafting
🍽️ Dinner date preparation & décor
🏕️ Adventure trip tasks & fun activities
🎨 Create cards, bouquets & stylish romantic elements
💘 Why Players Enjoy This Game
The story combines romance, makeover, creativity, drama, and relationship choices, offering a relaxing yet emotional experience. Perfect for anyone who loves crush stories, girl games, makeover challenges, or heartfelt romance adventures.
💞 Download Rich Girl’s Secret Crush Story and explore an emotional crush journey filled with style, choices & unforgettable moments! 💐✨"

apple-macos:1665075144.name: Archi - Kids Read-Along Story
apple-macos:1665075144.description:
Welcome to the magnificent Island of Phi Phi, where Archi and the island puppers live and play. Archi has always struggled to fit in because he was born different—with a cute arched tail and an inability to speak a word. But when a drought strikes and Archi is unknowingly left alone on the island, he stumbles upon a miracle. One by one, his deepest prayers are answered. For his final prayer, Archi wishes for the one thing he has always longed for. Will Archi get his heart’s desire and finally find his place on the island?
— A HEARTWARMING JOURNEY OF HOPE AND ANSWERED PRAYERS
When the world feels quiet and lonely, where do we turn? Archi is a beautifully crafted interactive experience that follows a non-verbal hero who discovers the power of reaching out. It is a comforting tool for parents and educators to help children navigate hardships, find their voice through reflection, and see the miracles that happen when we keep a hopeful heart.
— WHY FAMILIES LOVE ARCHI:
* Read and Learn Together: Children can listen to the story with Read-to-Me narration, hear it read aloud, and follow along with the text. These features encourage reading practice, help children repeat new words, build confidence, and enjoy a shared reading experience.
* Active Participation: Kids don't just watch—they Tap, Pull, Pop, and Drag objects, making them active participants in Archi’s journey toward his heart's desire.
* A Pure Experience: 100% Kid-Safe. No ads, no in-app purchases, and no external links. It’s a secure, distraction-free environment for independent exploration.
* Literacy & Learning: Professional narration and Read-to-Me modes help preschool children and early readers build vocabulary, practice reading, and gain confidence as they learn to read.
* A gentle Christian storybook that helps beginner readers build vocabulary, explore Christian faith, and enjoy interactive family reading.
— KEY FEATURES
* Available Anywhere, Anytime: 100% offline functionality. Once downloaded, the story, animations, and audio—including read-aloud and read-along functions—work perfectly without an internet connection, making Archi ideal for travel.
* Great for Teachers and Students: Perfect for classroom reading, small-group activities, and discussions about faith, kindness, empathy, and personal growth.
* Great for Preschool & Early Readers: A gentle interactive book for preschool children and early readers who are beginning to develop reading skills.
* Read-Along Storybook: Children can listen to professional narration while following along with the words, making Archi an engaging read-along book for independent or family reading.
* A Children’s Book for Family Reading: Enjoy Archi together as a children’s book that encourages parents to read with kids and share meaningful moments.
* Bedtime Stories: The gentle pace, narration, music, and interactive elements make Archi a comforting choice for heartwarming tales and a peaceful bedtime routine.
* Bible Stories & Christian Faith: Archi incorporates Bible-inspired themes of prayer, hope, perseverance, and answered prayers, offering families an opportunity to explore Christian faith.
* Bible Verse: And I tell you, ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you. For everyone who asks receives, and the one who seeks finds, and to the one who knocks it will be opened. (Luke 11: 9-10, ESV)
— A STORY OF RESILIENCE
Archi’s journey reminds us that even when we feel alone, help is never far away. By focusing on the universal values of persistence and faith, Archi bridges the gap between feeling lost and finding a home. It is a celebration of the quiet strength found in every child’s heart.

apple-macos:6796871892.name: myHealthRoutine
apple-macos:6796871892.description:
Keep a daily food diary alongside your blood pressure readings, medications and vitamins.
Today guides sleep review, medications and vitamins, blood pressure and meals. The next unfinished step appears first; record in any order. Filter Timeline by one or more activity types.
Record blood pressure, pulse, notes and time, as one reading or a session of three with a labelled average. Between session readings you'll see a short health tip from public health sources.
Insights shows neutral 7-day, 30-day, 90-day and all-time averages and daily charts. Optional reference indicators compare readings and averages with common adult home-average bands. Each indicator pairs colour with a symbol and neutral text label, so colour is never the only way the information is communicated.
Reviewed adult reference bands are not changed based only on age group or gender, so myHealthRoutine does not collect either detail for this feature. The indicators are informational, do not set a personal treatment target, and are not intended for anyone under 18, during pregnancy, or in the six weeks after giving birth.
Find over 5,000 USDA foods offline or search branded packs online. Log portions by meal and review daily nutrition totals. Log caffeine, alcohol (standard drinks) and sugar, and see neutral daily totals in Insights. Amounts are self-reported estimates; myHealthRoutine does not set targets or give advice about them.
Keep medications, symptoms, stress moments, appointments, activity, meals, sleep and other events in a searchable Health Timeline. You can also keep up to 12 active reminders.
Print a standard report of averages, readings, neutral reference labels, source context and medical caveats to discuss with your healthcare provider, or export your readings and intake as CSV.
Compatible myDailyTasks versions support blood-pressure handoffs, planned-meal reminders and same-device routine completion. Routine updates appear when myDailyTasks next runs. Only workflow details are shared, never health measurements.
On iPhone and iPad, Apple Health is optional. myHealthRoutine can save blood pressure, pulse, caffeine, alcohol and sugar you enter, and can read workouts, steps, sleep, State of Mind, heart-rate information, high-heart-rate notifications and intake from other apps to show in Today, the Timeline and Insights. State of Mind and sleep are shown as recorded, without diagnosis or a clinical score, and myHealthRoutine never creates a medical alert. Displayed Apple Health context stays in Health; a confirmed sleep review saves your selected duration.
Your health journal stays on your device and is excluded from backups. An optional iCloud bridge exchanges limited companion completion receipts, not your health journal.
myHealthRoutine is ad-supported and may show one clearly labelled, contextual sponsor message on the Readings home and while you wait between session readings. Sponsor selection never uses health information, and myHealthRoutine does not provide sponsors with health data, user identifiers, impression data or click analytics. There is no subscription or in-app purchase.
Aggregate product analytics is optional and off by default. If you turn it on in the introduction or Settings, myHealthRoutine sends first-party grouped counts of app opens, feature views and completed actions, with the app version and platform. It does not send health values, notes, food or intake records, Apple Health data, individual action timestamps, account or device identifiers, or advertising identifiers, and it is not shared with sponsors or used for tracking.
Apple Watch is a reminder companion. myHealthRoutine is a personal record-keeping tool and does not diagnose conditions, recommend treatment, or provide emergency alerts.
Privacy Policy: https://myhealthroutine.app/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

firefox-addons:3104266.name: Twinread: Dual Subtitles & Translator
firefox-addons:3104266.summary: Two languages at once: dual subtitles on YouTube and other videos, and on-device translation under each paragraph of a page.
firefox-addons:3104266.description:
Watch YouTube with subtitles in two languages, and read any web page with its translation under each paragraph. Twinread is a dual subtitles extension and bilingual page translator for language learners: hear the original, read both lines, pause after each one, and keep the words you want to learn.
Translation runs on your computer. No account.
• Video on YouTube and other sites: each line in two languages, the whole video, a transcript beside the player, a pause after each line, a repeat, a click on any word for its translation
• Bilingual page translator: the translation under each paragraph, or the translation alone
• Saved words, each with the sentence it came from, reviewed as flashcards on a spaced schedule, and sent to Anki (Pro)
• PDFs, your own EPUB, text and HTML files, and your own subtitle files, read the same way
• Reading aids on subtitles: furigana and romaji for Japanese, pinyin for Chinese
• A sentence explained, its meaning and grammar, by your own key
• Anki cards with the picture and the sound of the line (Pro)
• The site's own second caption track beside the translation, slow replay of a line and Hear, which reads a word aloud with a voice on your computer
Translation: Bergamot, on your computer.
Free translates every page and video and covers saved words, a reader for your own files and a few sentence explanations a day. Pro lifts those limits and adds reading aids without a cap, Anki cards with picture and sound, transcript export, Anki and CSV word export, a bilingual copy of a PDF and article copies. Pro is a pass for a set time or one payment for Pro forever. Full refund within two weeks, no questions asked. Plans and refund terms: https://twinread.exotools.dev/pricing 
PRIVACY
Sent to our server: the licence key, the product name, a random id for this browser and the other fields in the privacy policy, when you activate Pro, about once a day after, and when you remove or replace a key; a diagnostics report, when you press Send. Each language pair's model downloads from Mozilla on first use, and only the name of the pair is sent. Text goes to a provider only for a language pair you route to your own DeepL or OpenAI-compatible key. Saved words go to Anki on your computer when you press Send to Anki. Firefox asks your permission before the key is sent. Privacy policy: https://twinread.exotools.dev/privacy 
PERMISSIONS
• activeTab: the page you are on, when you press the toolbar button or a shortcut
• scripting: adds the translation to the page you pick
• storage: settings, glossary, saved words, language models, licence key, kept in your browser
• unlimitedStorage: room for the language models and a long list of saved words
• alarms: removes a deleted word's card media once its Undo has passed
• firefox.settings.services.mozilla.com and firefox-settings-attachments.cdn.mozilla.net : Mozilla's model servers, where the language models come from
• optional access to any site you choose: asked one site at a time, when you switch on Always translate for it, or the player frame you turn subtitles on in
• optional access to www.youtube.com : asked when you switch on the player button on YouTube pages
• optional access to www.netflix.com , www.primevideo.com , www.amazon.com/gp/video and www.disneyplus.com : asked one site at a time, when you switch on dual subtitles there
• optional access to your translation provider's host: asked when you save an own-key setting
• optional access to 127.0.0.1: asked when you press Send to Anki, to reach AnkiConnect on your computer
Not affiliated with YouTube, Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+ or any other site.
Guides and updates: https://twinread.exotools.dev 
Roadmap: https://twinread.exotools.dev/roadmap 
Twinread is an independent tool and is not affiliated with Mozilla or Google.
